import React from 'react';
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom/client';
import App from './App';
import { ErrorBoundary } from './components/ErrorBoundary';

const rootElement = document.getElementById('root');
if (!rootElement) {
  throw new Error("Could not find root element to mount to");
}

const root = ReactDOM.createRoot(rootElement);
root.render(
  <React.StrictMode>
    <ErrorBoundary>
      <App />
    </ErrorBoundary>
  </React.StrictMode>
);

  "entities": {
    "User": {
      "title": "User",
      "description": "A user of the application.",
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "uid": { "type": "string" },
        "email": { "type": "string", "format": "email" },
        "displayName": { "type": "string" },
        "role": { "type": "string" },
        "createdAt": { "type": "string", "format": "date-time" }
      },
      "required": ["uid", "email"]
    },
    "Tactic": {
      "title": "Tactic",
      "description": "A football tactic plan.",
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "userId": { "type": "string" },
        "name": { "type": "string" },
        "mode": { "type": "string", "enum": ["FARAZI", "GERCEK"] },
        "size": { "type": "string" },
        "formation": { "type": "string" },
        "slots": { "type": "array" },
        "subs": { "type": "array" },
        "captainId": { "type": "string" },
        "notes": { "type": "string" },
        "opponents": { "type": "array" },
        "mentality": { "type": "string" },
        "tempo": { "type": "string" },
        "identity": { "type": "string" },
        "createdAt": { "type": "string", "format": "date-time" },
        "updatedAt": { "type": "string", "format": "date-time" }
      },
      "required": ["userId", "name", "mode", "size", "formation", "slots", "createdAt", "updatedAt"]
    }
  },
  "firestore": {
    "/users/{userId}": {
      "schema": { "$ref": "#/entities/User" },
      "description": "User profiles."
    },
    "/tactics/{tacticId}": {
      "schema": { "$ref": "#/entities/Tactic" },
      "description": "Tactic plans created by users."
    }
  }
}


--- FILE: ./App.tsx ---
import React, { useEffect, Suspense, lazy } from 'react';
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { UserRole, AppView, MatchListing, Goalkeeper, Referee, Match } from './types';
import { auth, db } from './firebase';
import { onAuthStateChanged } from 'firebase/auth';
import { doc, setDoc, getDoc, updateDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { useAppStore } from './store';

// ─── Page transition wrapper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
const PageTransition: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode; viewKey: string }> = ({ children, viewKey }) => (
  <motion.div
    key={viewKey}
    initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12, scale: 0.99 }}
    animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
    exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -8, scale: 0.995 }}
    transition={{ duration: 0.3, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
    style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, overflowY: 'auto' }}
  >
    {children}
  </motion.div>
);

// Eagerly loaded for immediate display
import SplashScreen from './views/SplashScreen';
import AuthScreen from './views/AuthScreen';

// Lazy loaded views to reduce initial bundle size
const RoleSelection = lazy(() => import('./views/RoleSelection'));
const Dashboard = lazy(() => import('./views/Dashboard'));
const PitchDiscovery = lazy(() => import('./views/PitchDiscovery'));
const PaymentScreen = lazy(() => import('./views/PaymentScreen'));
const MyTeam = lazy(() => import('./views/MyTeam'));
const Marketplace = lazy(() => import('./views/Marketplace'));
const MyListings = lazy(() => import('./views/MyListings'));
const ListingDetails = lazy(() => import('./views/ListingDetails'));
const ProfileScreen = lazy(() => import('./views/ProfileScreen'));
const Notifications = lazy(() => import('./views/Notifications'));
const BookingAddons = lazy(() => import('./views/BookingAddons'));
const SettingsScreen = lazy(() => import('./views/SettingsScreen'));
const VotingScreen = lazy(() => import('./views/VotingScreen'));
const MotmReveal = lazy(() => import('./views/MotmReveal'));
const OynaTv = lazy(() => import('./views/OynaTv'));
const MatchDiscovery = lazy(() => import('./views/MatchDiscovery'));
const MatchJoin = lazy(() => import('./views/MatchJoin'));
const PremiumScreen = lazy(() => import('./views/PremiumScreen'));
const ChatScreen = lazy(() => import('./views/ChatScreen'));
const MatchTicket = lazy(() => import('./views/MatchTicket'));
const ScoutDashboard = lazy(() => import('./views/ScoutDashboard'));
const PostMatchReport = lazy(() => import('./views/PostMatchReport'));
const MatchDiaryDetail = lazy(() => import('./views/MatchDiaryDetail'));
const Studio = lazy(() => import('./views/Studio'));
const WalletScreen = lazy(() => import('./views/WalletScreen'));
const MatchLobby = lazy(() => import('./views/MatchLobby'));
const OpponentFinder = lazy(() => import('./views/OpponentFinder'));
const LocationPrompt = lazy(() => import('./views/LocationPrompt'));
const MatchCalendar = lazy(() => import('./views/MatchCalendar'));
const AdminPanel = lazy(() => import('./views/AdminPanel'));
const TeamBuilder = lazy(() => import('./views/TeamBuilder').then(module => ({ default: module.TeamBuilder })));
const CommunityView = lazy(() => import('./views/CommunityView'));
const TeamCreator = lazy(() => import('./views/TeamCreator'));
const TransferCenter = lazy(() => import('./views/TransferCenter'));
const Leaderboards = lazy(() => import('./views/Leaderboards'));
const PostMatchEval = lazy(() => import('./views/PostMatchEval'));
const TournamentBracket = lazy(() => import('./views/TournamentBracket'));
const CommunityAdminDashboard = lazy(() => import('./views/CommunityAdminDashboard'));
const MatchCreate = lazy(() => import('./views/MatchCreate'));
const OwnerPanel = lazy(() => import('./views/OwnerPanel'));
const ServiceDashboard = lazy(() => import('./views/ServiceDashboard'));
const PartnerOnboarding = lazy(() => import('./views/PartnerOnboarding'));
const QRScannerView = lazy(() => import('./views/QRScannerView'));
const MatchesView = lazy(() => import('./views/MatchesView'));
import { BottomNav } from './components/BottomNav';

// Loading fallback component
const ViewLoader = () => (
  <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen bg-[#0A0E14]">
    <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-t-2 border-b-2 border-[#39FF14]"></div>
  </div>
);

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// 🛠️  GELİŞTİRME MODU — Yayına geçmeden önce false yap
// false yapınca: Splash → Auth → Location → Dashboard akışı
// true yapınca:  Direkt Dashboard (zaman kazandırır)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const DEV_MODE = false;

const App: React.FC = () => {
  const [matches, setMatches] = React.useState<Match[]>([]);
  const {
    view,
    role,
    isAuthReady,
    addOnTotal,
    hasMotmCoupon,
    selectedMatch,
    isUserPro,
    selectedDiaryId,
    selectedGk,
    selectedRef,
    marketplaceReturnView,
    setView,
    setRole,
    setIsAuthReady,
    setAddOnTotal,
    setHasMotmCoupon,
    setSelectedMatch,
    setIsUserPro,
    setSelectedDiaryId,
    setSelectedGk,
    setSelectedRef,
    setMarketplaceReturnView,
  } = useAppStore();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (DEV_MODE) {
      // 🛠️ Geliştirme: direkt Dashboard — login yok
      setRole(UserRole.CAPTAIN);
      setIsAuthReady(true);
      setView('DASHBOARD');
    } else {
      // 🚀 Prodüksiyon: normal akış
      setView('SPLASH');
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Start syncing with Firestore
    import('./firebaseSync').then(({ startFirebaseSync }) => startFirebaseSync());

    const unsubscribe = onAuthStateChanged(auth, async (user) => {
      if (user) {
        // Save user to Firestore
        const userRef = doc(db, 'users', user.uid);
        const userSnap = await getDoc(userRef);
        if (!userSnap.exists()) {
          try {
            await setDoc(userRef, {
              uid: user.uid,
              email: user.email,
              displayName: user.displayName || '',
              createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
            });
          } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error creating user profile:', error);
          }
        } else {
          const userData = userSnap.data();
          if (userData.role) {
            setRole(userData.role as UserRole);
          }
        }
        // If they were on SPLASH or AUTH, move them forward
        if (view === 'SPLASH' || view === 'AUTH') {
          setView('LOCATION_PROMPT');
        }
      } else {
        // User is logged out
        // if (view !== 'SPLASH' && view !== 'AUTH') {
        //   setView('SPLASH');
        // }
      }
      setIsAuthReady(true);
    });
    return () => unsubscribe();
  }, [view]);

  const navigateBasedOnRole = (currentRole: UserRole | null): AppView => {
    if (currentRole === UserRole.OWNER) return 'OWNER_PANEL';
    if (currentRole === UserRole.REFEREE || currentRole === UserRole.GOALKEEPER) return 'SERVICE_DASHBOARD';
    if (currentRole) return 'DASHBOARD';
    return 'ROLE_SELECTION';
  };

  const handleRoleSelect = async (selectedRole: UserRole, data?: any) => {
    setRole(selectedRole);
    if (auth.currentUser) {
      try {
        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', auth.currentUser.uid), {
          role: selectedRole,
          ...data
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error saving role:', error);
      }
      setView(navigateBasedOnRole(selectedRole));
    } else {
      setView('AUTH');
    }
  };

  const renderView = () => {
    if (!isAuthReady) {
      return (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen bg-[#0A0E14]">
          <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-t-2 border-b-2 border-[#39FF14]"></div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    switch (view) {
      case 'SPLASH':
        return <SplashScreen onStart={() => setView(auth.currentUser ? 'LOCATION_PROMPT' : 'ROLE_SELECTION')} />;
      case 'AUTH':
        return <AuthScreen role={role} onSuccess={() => setView('LOCATION_PROMPT')} onBack={() => setView('ROLE_SELECTION')} />;
      case 'LOCATION_PROMPT':
        return <LocationPrompt
          onPermissionGranted={() => setView(navigateBasedOnRole(role))}
          onSkip={() => setView(navigateBasedOnRole(role))}
        />;
      case 'ROLE_SELECTION':
        return <RoleSelection
          onSelect={handleRoleSelect}
          onBack={() => { }}
          onNavigate={(v) => setView(v)}
        />;
      case 'ADMIN_PANEL':
        return <AdminPanel onBack={() => setView('ROLE_SELECTION')} />;
      case 'OWNER_PANEL':
        return <OwnerPanel onBack={() => setView('ROLE_SELECTION')} onNavigate={(v) => setView(v as AppView)} />;
      case 'SERVICE_DASHBOARD':
        return <ServiceDashboard role={role!} onBack={() => setView('ROLE_SELECTION')} onNavigate={(v) => setView(v)} />;
      case 'PARTNER_ONBOARDING':
        return <PartnerOnboarding 
          onComplete={() => setView('OWNER_PANEL')} 
          onClose={() => setView('ROLE_SELECTION')}
        />;
      case 'QR_SCANNER':
        return <QRScannerView 
          onBack={() => setView('OWNER_PANEL')} 
          onResult={(res) => {
            setMatches(prev => [res, ...prev]);
          }} 
        />;
      case 'MATCHES':
        return <MatchesView onBack={() => setView('OWNER_PANEL')} matches={matches} />;
      case 'DASHBOARD':
        return <Dashboard
          onNavigate={(newView) => {
            if (newView === 'MARKETPLACE_GK' || newView === 'MARKETPLACE_REF') {
              setMarketplaceReturnView('DASHBOARD');
            }
            setView(newView);
          }}
          onBack={() => setView('ROLE_SELECTION')}
          selectedGk={selectedGk}
          selectedRef={selectedRef}
        />;
      case 'PITCH_DISCOVERY':
        return <PitchDiscovery
          onBack={() => setView('DASHBOARD')}
          onBook={() => setView('BOOKING_ADDONS')}
        />;
      case 'MARKETPLACE_GK':
        return <Marketplace
          type="GK"
          onBack={() => setView(marketplaceReturnView)}
          onSelect={(gk) => {
            setSelectedGk(gk as Goalkeeper);
            setView(marketplaceReturnView);
          }}
        />;
      case 'MARKETPLACE_REF':
        return <Marketplace
          type="REF"
          onBack={() => setView(marketplaceReturnView)}
          onSelect={(ref) => {
            setSelectedRef(ref as Referee);
            setView(marketplaceReturnView);
          }}
        />;
      case 'MY_LISTINGS':
        return <MyListings onBack={() => setView('DASHBOARD')} onNavigate={(v) => setView(v)} />;
      case 'LISTING_DETAILS':
        return <ListingDetails onBack={() => setView('MY_LISTINGS')} />;
      case 'BOOKING_ADDONS':
        return <BookingAddons
          onBack={() => setView('PITCH_DISCOVERY')}
          selectedGk={selectedGk}
          selectedRef={selectedRef}
          onRemoveGk={() => setSelectedGk(null)}
          onRemoveRef={() => setSelectedRef(null)}
          onNavigate={(newView) => {
            if (newView === 'MARKETPLACE_GK' || newView === 'MARKETPLACE_REF') {
              setMarketplaceReturnView('BOOKING_ADDONS');
            }
            setView(newView);
          }}
          onContinue={(total) => {
            setAddOnTotal(total);
            setView('PAYMENT');
          }}
        />;
      case 'PAYMENT':
        return <PaymentScreen
          extraFee={addOnTotal}
          hasMotmCoupon={hasMotmCoupon}
          onBack={() => setView('BOOKING_ADDONS')}
          onUpgradeRequest={() => setView('PREMIUM')}
          onViewTicket={() => setView('MATCH_TICKET')}
        />;
      case 'MY_TEAM':
        return <MyTeam onBack={() => setView('DASHBOARD')} onNavigate={(v) => setView(v)} />;
      case 'STUDIO':
        return <Studio onBack={() => setView('DASHBOARD')} onNavigate={(v) => setView(v)} />;
      case 'PROFILE':
        return <ProfileScreen
          role={role || UserRole.PLAYER}
          onBack={() => setView('DASHBOARD')}
          onNavigate={(v) => setView(v)}
          onOpenDiaryEntry={(id) => {
            setSelectedDiaryId(id);
            setView('MATCH_DIARY_DETAIL');
          }}
          isPro={isUserPro}
        />;
      case 'WALLET':
        return <WalletScreen onBack={() => setView('DASHBOARD')} />;
      case 'MATCH_LOBBY':
        return <MatchLobby onBack={() => setView('DASHBOARD')} onNavigate={(v) => setView(v)} />;
      case 'OPPONENT_FINDER':
        return <OpponentFinder onBack={() => setView('DASHBOARD')} onNavigate={(v) => setView(v)} />;
      case 'MATCH_CALENDAR':
        return <MatchCalendar onBack={() => setView('DASHBOARD')} onNavigate={(v) => setView(v)} />;
      case 'MATCH_DIARY_DETAIL':
        return <MatchDiaryDetail
          diaryId={selectedDiaryId}
          onBack={() => setView('PROFILE')}
        />;
      case 'NOTIFICATIONS':
        return <Notifications
          role={role}
          onBack={() => {
            // Return to correct view based on role
            if (role === UserRole.GOALKEEPER || role === UserRole.REFEREE) {
              setView('SERVICE_DASHBOARD');
            } else if (role === UserRole.OWNER) {
              setView('OWNER_PANEL');
            } else {
              setView('DASHBOARD');
            }
          }}
        />;
      case 'SETTINGS':
        return <SettingsScreen onBack={() => setView('DASHBOARD')} onNavigate={(v) => setView(v)} />;
      case 'VOTING':
        return <VotingScreen onBack={() => setView('DASHBOARD')} onComplete={() => setView('MOTM_REVEAL')} />;
      case 'MOTM_REVEAL':
        return <MotmReveal
          onClaim={() => {
            setHasMotmCoupon(true);
            setView('DASHBOARD');
          }}
          onBack={() => setView('DASHBOARD')}
        />;
      case 'OYNA_TV':
        return <OynaTv onBack={() => setView('DASHBOARD')} onNavigate={(v) => setView(v)} />;
      case 'MATCH_DISCOVERY':
        return <MatchDiscovery
          onBack={() => setView('DASHBOARD')}
          onSelect={(match) => {
            setSelectedMatch(match);
            setView('MATCH_JOIN');
          }}
        />;
      case 'MATCH_JOIN':
        return <MatchJoin
          match={selectedMatch}
          onBack={() => setView('MATCH_DISCOVERY')}
          onJoin={() => setView('MATCH_LOBBY')} // After payment, go to lobby / tactics
        />;
      case 'PREMIUM':
        return <PremiumScreen
          onBack={() => setView('DASHBOARD')}
          onUpgrade={() => {
            setIsUserPro(true);
            setView('PROFILE');
          }}
        />;
      case 'CHAT':
        return <ChatScreen onBack={() => setView('DASHBOARD')} />;
      case 'MATCH_TICKET':
        return <MatchTicket onBack={() => setView('DASHBOARD')} />;
      case 'SCOUT_DASHBOARD':
        return <ScoutDashboard onBack={() => setView('PROFILE')} />;
      case 'POST_MATCH':
        return <PostMatchReport onBack={() => setView('PROFILE')} />;
      case 'TEAM_BUILDER':
        return <TeamBuilder onBack={() => setView('PROFILE')} />;
      case 'COMMUNITY_VIEW':
        return <CommunityView
          onBack={() => setView('DASHBOARD')}
          onNavigate={(v) => setView(v)}
          community={{ id: 'c1', name: 'Boğaziçi Üniversitesi', domain: '@boun.edu.tr', memberCount: 1250, activeMatches: 12, isVerified: true }}
          currentUser={{ id: 'u1', name: 'Ahmet', email: 'ahmet@boun.edu.tr', roles: [], communities: ['c1'], fairPlayScore: 100, elo: 1200 }}
        />;
      case 'TEAM_CREATOR':
        return <TeamCreator
          onBack={() => setView('PROFILE')}
          onComplete={() => setView('PROFILE')}
          communities={[{ id: 'c1', name: 'Boğaziçi Üniversitesi', domain: '@boun.edu.tr', memberCount: 1250, activeMatches: 12, isVerified: true }]}
        />;
      case 'TRANSFER_CENTER':
        return <TransferCenter onBack={() => setView('COMMUNITY_VIEW')} />;
      case 'LEADERBOARDS':
        return <Leaderboards onBack={() => setView('COMMUNITY_VIEW')} />;
      case 'POST_MATCH_EVAL':
        return <PostMatchEval onBack={() => setView('COMMUNITY_VIEW')} onComplete={() => setView('COMMUNITY_VIEW')} />;
      case 'TOURNAMENT_BRACKET':
        return <TournamentBracket onBack={() => setView('COMMUNITY_VIEW')} />;
      case 'COMMUNITY_ADMIN_DASHBOARD':
        return <CommunityAdminDashboard onBack={() => setView('COMMUNITY_VIEW')} />;
      case 'MATCH_CREATE':
        return <MatchCreate onBack={() => setView('DASHBOARD')} onNavigate={(v) => setView(v)} />;
      default:
        return <SplashScreen onStart={() => setView('AUTH')} />;
    }
  };

  const showBottomNav = ['DASHBOARD', 'MATCH_DISCOVERY', 'STUDIO', 'PITCH_DISCOVERY', 'PROFILE'].includes(view);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#0A0E14] text-white font-['Inter'] relative overflow-hidden">
      {/* Mesh Gradient Background */}
      <div className="mesh-bg">
        <div className="mesh-blob mesh-blob-1"></div>
        <div className="mesh-blob mesh-blob-2"></div>
        <div className="mesh-blob mesh-blob-3"></div>
      </div>

      <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
        <motion.div
          key={view}
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16, scale: 0.99 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10, scale: 0.995 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.35, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
          className={`w-full h-full absolute inset-0 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar ${showBottomNav ? 'pb-24' : ''}`}
        >
          <Suspense fallback={<ViewLoader />}>
            {renderView()}
          </Suspense>
        </motion.div>
      </AnimatePresence>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {showBottomNav && (
          <BottomNav currentView={view} onNavigate={setView} />
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
};

export default App;

--- FILE: ./firebaseSync.ts ---
import { collection, onSnapshot, doc, setDoc, updateDoc, deleteDoc, query } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db } from './firebase';
import { useAppStore } from './store';
import { Pitch, MatchListing, Goalkeeper, Referee } from './types';
import { AdminUser, AdminNotification, AppSettings } from './store';

// ============================================================================
// FIREBASE -> ZUSTAND SYNC (LISTENERS)
// ============================================================================

let unsubscribers: (() => void)[] = [];

/**
 * Başlatıldığında Firestore'u dinlemeye başlar ve Zustand'ı günceller.
 * Uygulama açılışında App.tsx içinde çağrılmalıdır.
 */
export const startFirebaseSync = () => {
    stopFirebaseSync();

    const {
        setAdminPitches, setAdminMatches, setAdminUsers,
        setAdminGoalkeepers, setAdminReferees, setAdminNotifications,
        updateAppSettings, setGlobalText, setInitialLoadComplete
    } = useAppStore.getState();

    let loadedCount = 0;
    const checkLoaded = () => {
        loadedCount++;
        if (loadedCount >= 8) {
            setInitialLoadComplete(true);
        }
    };

    const handleFirebaseError = (error: any, fallbackData: any, setter: Function) => {
        console.warn("Firebase sync failed, using local fallback data:", error);
        setter(fallbackData);
        checkLoaded();
    };

    // We import constants inside to avoid top-level circular deps if any
    import('./constants').then(({ PITCHES, MATCH_LISTINGS, GOALKEEPERS, REFEREES }) => {
        import('./store').then(({ INITIAL_USERS }) => {

            // 1. Pitches
            unsubscribers.push(onSnapshot(collection(db, 'pitches'), (snapshot) => {
                const data = snapshot.docs.map(doc => ({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() } as Pitch));
                setAdminPitches(data.length > 0 ? data : PITCHES);
                checkLoaded();
            }, (error) => handleFirebaseError(error, PITCHES, setAdminPitches)));

            // 2. Matches
            unsubscribers.push(onSnapshot(collection(db, 'matches'), (snapshot) => {
                const data = snapshot.docs.map(doc => ({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() } as MatchListing));
                setAdminMatches(data.length > 0 ? data : MATCH_LISTINGS);
                checkLoaded();
            }, (error) => handleFirebaseError(error, MATCH_LISTINGS, setAdminMatches)));

            // 3. Users
            unsubscribers.push(onSnapshot(collection(db, 'users'), (snapshot) => {
                const data = snapshot.docs.map(doc => ({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() } as AdminUser));
                setAdminUsers(data.length > 0 ? data : INITIAL_USERS);
                checkLoaded();
            }, (error) => handleFirebaseError(error, INITIAL_USERS, setAdminUsers)));

            // 4. Goalkeepers
            unsubscribers.push(onSnapshot(collection(db, 'goalkeepers'), (snapshot) => {
                const data = snapshot.docs.map(doc => ({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() } as Goalkeeper));
                setAdminGoalkeepers(data.length > 0 && data[0].name ? data : GOALKEEPERS);
                checkLoaded();
            }, (error) => handleFirebaseError(error, GOALKEEPERS, setAdminGoalkeepers)));

            // 5. Referees
            unsubscribers.push(onSnapshot(collection(db, 'referees'), (snapshot) => {
                const data = snapshot.docs.map(doc => ({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() } as Referee));
                setAdminReferees(data.length > 0 && data[0].name ? data : REFEREES);
                checkLoaded();
            }, (error) => handleFirebaseError(error, REFEREES, setAdminReferees)));

            // 6. Notifications
            unsubscribers.push(onSnapshot(collection(db, 'notifications'), (snapshot) => {
                const data = snapshot.docs.map(doc => ({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() } as AdminNotification));
                if (data.length > 0) setAdminNotifications(data);
                checkLoaded();
            }, (error) => handleFirebaseError(error, [], setAdminNotifications)));

            // 7. AppSettings
            unsubscribers.push(onSnapshot(doc(db, 'settings', 'main'), (docSnap) => {
                if (docSnap.exists()) updateAppSettings(docSnap.data() as Partial<AppSettings>);
                checkLoaded();
            }, (error) => handleFirebaseError(error, null, () => { })));

            // 8. Global Texts
            unsubscribers.push(onSnapshot(doc(db, 'texts', 'global'), (docSnap) => {
                if (docSnap.exists()) {
                    const data = docSnap.data();
                    Object.keys(data).forEach(key => setGlobalText(key, data[key]));
                }
                checkLoaded();
            }, (error) => handleFirebaseError(error, null, () => { })));

        });
    });
};

export const stopFirebaseSync = () => {
};

import { PITCHES, MATCH_LISTINGS, GOALKEEPERS, REFEREES } from './constants';

export const seedFirestore = async () => {
    try {
        console.log("Seeding Firestore...");
        const { INITIAL_USERS } = await import('./store');

        // Pitches
        for (const p of PITCHES) {
            const newDoc = doc(db, 'pitches', p.id);
            await setDoc(newDoc, p);
        }
        // Matches
        for (const m of MATCH_LISTINGS) {
            const newDoc = doc(db, 'matches', m.id);
            await setDoc(newDoc, m);
        }
        // Goalkeepers
        for (const g of GOALKEEPERS) {
            const newDoc = doc(db, 'goalkeepers', g.id);
            await setDoc(newDoc, g);
        }
        // Referees
        for (const r of REFEREES) {
            const newDoc = doc(db, 'referees', r.id);
            await setDoc(newDoc, r);
        }

        // Users
        for (const u of INITIAL_USERS) {
            const newDoc = doc(db, 'users', u.id);
            await setDoc(newDoc, u);
        }

        console.log("Seed complete! Refresh the page.");
        alert("Veritabanı başarıyla tohumlandı! Lütfen sayfayı yenileyin.");
    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Seed error:", error);
        alert("Seed sırasında hata oluştu!");
    }
};

import { initializeApp } from 'firebase/app';
import { getAuth, GoogleAuthProvider, signInWithPopup, signOut } from 'firebase/auth';
import { initializeFirestore, persistentLocalCache, persistentMultipleTabManager, doc, getDocFromServer } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { getStorage } from 'firebase/storage';
import firebaseConfig from './firebase-applet-config.json';

const app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);

// Enable offline persistence for better UX on mobile/spotty networks
export const db = initializeFirestore(app, {
  localCache: persistentLocalCache({ tabManager: persistentMultipleTabManager() })
});

export const auth = getAuth(app);
export const storage = getStorage(app);
export const googleProvider = new GoogleAuthProvider();

export const loginWithGoogle = async () => {
  try {
    await signInWithPopup(auth, googleProvider);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error signing in with Google", error);
  }
};

export const logout = async () => {
  try {
    await signOut(auth);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error signing out", error);
  }
};

// Validate Connection to Firestore
async function testConnection() {
  try {
    await getDocFromServer(doc(db, 'test', 'connection'));
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof Error && error.message.includes('the client is offline')) {
      console.error("Please check your Firebase configuration. ");
    }
  }
}
testConnection();

  reviews: ServiceReview[];
}

export interface ChatMessage {
  id: string;
  sender: 'AI' | 'USER' | 'OWNER';
  text: string;
  timestamp: string;
}

export interface ServiceJob {
  id: string;
  date: string;
  time: string;
  location: string;
  pitchName: string;
  fee: number;
  status: 'CONFIRMED' | 'PENDING';
}

// OWNER PANEL TYPES
export interface Transaction {
  id: string;
  user: string;
  date: string;
  amount: number;
  type: 'BOOKING' | 'ADDON';
  status: 'COMPLETED' | 'PENDING';
}

export interface Review {
  id: string;
  user: string;
  rating: number;
  comment: string;
  date: string;
  metrics: { lighting: number; grass: number; goal: number };
  reply?: string;
}

export interface BusinessInsight {
  id: string;
  type: 'PRICING' | 'INVESTMENT' | 'INVENTORY';
  title: string;
  description: string;
  impact: string;
}

// SERVICE PROVIDER TYPES (Updated)
export interface JobListing {
  id: string;
  type: 'REF' | 'GK';
  pitchName: string;
  location: string;
  distance: string;
  date: string;
  time: string;
  offeredFee: number;
  captainName: string;
  teamName: string;
  minRating: number; // New: Constraint
  viewers: number; // New: FOMO
}

export interface DirectOffer {
  id: string;
  pitchName: string;
  teamName: string;
  captainName: string;
  offerAmount: number;
  time: string;
  date: string;
  message: string;
  expiresIn: string; // "30dk"
}

export interface IncomingBid {
  id: string;
  providerName: string;
  role: 'REFEREE' | 'GOALKEEPER';
  rating: number;
  matchCount?: number; // For Ref
  style?: string; // For GK
  bidAmount: number;
  note: string;
  avatar: string;
}

export interface WalletTransaction {
  id: string;
  date: string;
  description: string;
  amount: number;
  commission: number;
  status: 'CLEARED' | 'PENDING';
}

// FINANCIAL TYPES
export interface PaymentPool {
  totalAmount: number;
  paidAmount: number;
  deposit: number;
  contributors: { name: string; amount: number; time: string }[];
  status: 'COLLECTING' | 'COMPLETED' | 'FAILED';
}

// MATCH HISTORY / DIARY TYPE
export interface MatchHistoryItem {
  id: string;
  date: string;
  pitchName: string;
  score: string;
  result: 'WIN' | 'LOSS' | 'DRAW';
  formation: '2-3-1' | '3-2-1' | '3-1-2'; // Simple string representation
  rosterSnapshot: { name: string; avatar: string; x: number; y: number }[]; // Added coords for visual replay
  personalNote?: string;
}

--- FILE: ./firebaseMutations.ts ---
import { collection, doc, setDoc, updateDoc, deleteDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db } from './firebase';
import { Pitch, MatchListing, Goalkeeper, Referee } from './types';
import { AdminUser, AdminNotification, AppSettings } from './store';

// ============================================================================
// ZUSTAND -> FIREBASE WRITE (MUTATIONS)
// ============================================================================
// Store üzerinden her state değişiminde bu fonksiyonlar çağrılacak.

// -- Pitches --
export const fbAddPitch = async (pitch: Omit<Pitch, 'id'>) => {
    const newDoc = doc(collection(db, 'pitches'));
    await setDoc(newDoc, { ...pitch, id: newDoc.id });
};
export const fbUpdatePitch = async (pitch: Pitch) => {
    if (!pitch.id) return;
    await updateDoc(doc(db, 'pitches', pitch.id), { ...pitch });
};
export const fbDeletePitch = async (id: string) => {
    await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'pitches', id));
};

// -- Matches --
export const fbAddMatch = async (match: Omit<MatchListing, 'id'>) => {
    const newDoc = doc(collection(db, 'matches'));
    await setDoc(newDoc, { ...match, id: newDoc.id });
};
export const fbUpdateMatch = async (match: MatchListing) => {
    if (!match.id) return;
    await updateDoc(doc(db, 'matches', match.id), { ...match });
};
export const fbDeleteMatch = async (id: string) => {
    await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'matches', id));
};

// -- Users --
export const fbAddUser = async (user: Omit<AdminUser, 'id'>) => {
    const newDoc = doc(collection(db, 'users'));
    await setDoc(newDoc, { ...user, id: newDoc.id });
};
export const fbUpdateUser = async (user: AdminUser) => {
    if (!user.id) return;
    await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', user.id), { ...user });
};
export const fbDeleteUser = async (id: string) => {
    await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'users', id));
};
export const fbBanUser = async (id: string, isBanned: boolean) => {
    await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', id), { isBanned });
};
export const fbToggleUserPro = async (id: string, isPro: boolean) => {
    await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', id), { isPro });
};
export const fbVerifyUser = async (id: string) => {
    await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', id), { isVerified: true });
};

// -- Goalkeepers --
export const fbAddGoalkeeper = async (gk: Omit<Goalkeeper, 'id'>) => {
    const newDoc = doc(collection(db, 'goalkeepers'));
    await setDoc(newDoc, { ...gk, id: newDoc.id });
};
export const fbUpdateGoalkeeper = async (gk: Goalkeeper) => {
    if (!gk.id) return;
    await updateDoc(doc(db, 'goalkeepers', gk.id), { ...gk });
};
export const fbDeleteGoalkeeper = async (id: string) => {
    await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'goalkeepers', id));
};

// -- Referees --
export const fbAddReferee = async (ref: Omit<Referee, 'id'>) => {
    const newDoc = doc(collection(db, 'referees'));
    await setDoc(newDoc, { ...ref, id: newDoc.id });
};
export const fbUpdateReferee = async (ref: Referee) => {
    if (!ref.id) return;
    await updateDoc(doc(db, 'referees', ref.id), { ...ref });
};
export const fbDeleteReferee = async (id: string) => {
    await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'referees', id));
};

// -- Notifications --
export const fbAddNotification = async (notif: Omit<AdminNotification, 'id'>) => {
    const newDoc = doc(collection(db, 'notifications'));
    await setDoc(newDoc, { ...notif, id: newDoc.id });
};
export const fbDeleteNotification = async (id: string) => {
    await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'notifications', id));
};
export const fbToggleNotificationAlert = async (id: string, isActive: boolean) => {
    await updateDoc(doc(db, 'notifications', id), { isActive });
};

// -- App Settings --
export const fbUpdateAppSettings = async (settings: Partial<AppSettings>) => {
    await setDoc(doc(db, 'settings', 'main'), settings, { merge: true });
};

// -- Global Texts --
export const fbSetGlobalText = async (key: string, value: string) => {
    await setDoc(doc(db, 'texts', 'global'), { [key]: value }, { merge: true });
};

import path from 'path';
import { defineConfig, loadEnv } from 'vite';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';
import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite';

export default defineConfig(({ mode }) => {
    const env = loadEnv(mode, '.', '');
    return {
      server: {
        port: 4000,
        host: '0.0.0.0',
      },
      plugins: [react(), tailwindcss()],
      build: {
        rollupOptions: {
          output: {
            manualChunks: {
              'react-vendor': ['react', 'react-dom'],
              'firebase-vendor': ['firebase/app', 'firebase/auth', 'firebase/firestore'],
              'ui-vendor': ['framer-motion', 'lucide-react', 'recharts']
            }
          }
        }
      },
      define: {
        'process.env.API_KEY': JSON.stringify(env.GEMINI_API_KEY),
        'process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY': JSON.stringify(env.GEMINI_API_KEY)
      },
      resolve: {
        alias: {
          '@': path.resolve(__dirname, '.'),
        }
      }
    };
});

--- FILE: ./utils/justice.ts ---
import { ITeam } from '../types';

export function calculateMatchSuitability(teamA: ITeam, teamB: ITeam): { suitable: boolean; score: number; reason?: string } {
  const eloDiff = Math.abs(teamA.stats.elo - teamB.stats.elo);
  const fairPlayDiff = Math.abs(teamA.stats.fairPlayScore - teamB.stats.fairPlayScore);
  
  let score = 100;
  
  // ELO difference penalty (max 50 points if diff is 500)
  score -= Math.min(50, (eloDiff / 10));
  
  // FairPlay difference penalty (max 50 points if diff is 100)
  score -= Math.min(50, (fairPlayDiff / 2));
  
  if (score < 40) {
    return { suitable: false, score, reason: 'Güç veya FairPlay dengesizliği çok yüksek.' };
  }
  
  if (teamA.stats.fairPlayScore < 50 || teamB.stats.fairPlayScore < 50) {
    return { suitable: false, score, reason: 'Takımlardan birinin FairPlay puanı çok düşük.' };
  }
  
  return { suitable: true, score };
}

// ── Stat Row with bar ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
interface StatRowProps { label: string; value: number; hasVideo: boolean; theme: TierTheme; onPlay?: () => void; }
const StatRow: React.FC<StatRowProps> = ({ label, value, hasVideo, theme, onPlay }) => {
  const color = value >= 80 ? '#52e88a' : value >= 66 ? '#ffc840' : value >= 50 ? '#ff8c30' : '#ff4d4d';
  return (
    <div
      className={`flex items-center gap-2 ${hasVideo ? 'cursor-pointer' : ''}`}
      onClick={onPlay}
    >
      {/* Label */}
      <span className="text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest w-7 shrink-0" style={{ color: theme.label }}>
        {label}
      </span>
      {/* Bar */}
      <div className="flex-1 h-[3px] rounded-full" style={{ background: theme.track }}>
        <div
          className="h-full rounded-full"
          style={{
            width: `${Math.min(99, value)}%`,
            background: theme.bar,
            boxShadow: `0 0 6px ${theme.barGlow}`,
          }}
        />
      </div>
      {/* Value */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 w-7 justify-end shrink-0">
        {hasVideo && <Play size={6} fill="currentColor" style={{ color: theme.label, opacity: 0.6 }} />}
        <span className="text-[13px] font-black leading-none" style={{ color }}>{value}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export const PlayerCard: React.FC<PlayerCardProps> = ({ name, photo, position = 'OS', cardData, onShare }) => {
  const [activeVideo, setActiveVideo] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const cardRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const tier = (cardData.tier in TIERS ? cardData.tier : 'bronze') as keyof typeof TIERS;
  const t = TIERS[tier] as unknown as TierTheme;

  // 3D tilt
  const mx = useMotionValue(0);
  const my = useMotionValue(0);
  const rotX = useSpring(useTransform(my, [-0.5, 0.5], [7, -7]), { stiffness: 280, damping: 28 });
  const rotY = useSpring(useTransform(mx, [-0.5, 0.5], [-7, 7]), { stiffness: 280, damping: 28 });
  const gOpacity = useSpring(0, { stiffness: 280, damping: 28 });
  const gX = useTransform(mx, [-0.5, 0.5], ['10%', '90%']);
  const gY = useTransform(my, [-0.5, 0.5], ['10%', '90%']);

  const onMove = useCallback((e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!cardRef.current) return;
    const r = cardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    mx.set((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width - 0.5);
    my.set((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height - 0.5);
    gOpacity.set(0.3);
  }, []);
  const onLeave = useCallback(() => { mx.set(0); my.set(0); gOpacity.set(0); }, []);

  const stats = [
    { key: 'pace', label: 'HIZ', stat: cardData.stats.pace },
    { key: 'shooting', label: 'ŞUT', stat: cardData.stats.shooting },
    { key: 'passing', label: 'PAS', stat: cardData.stats.passing },
    { key: 'dribbling', label: 'DRİ', stat: cardData.stats.dribbling },
    { key: 'defense', label: 'DEF', stat: cardData.stats.defense },
    { key: 'physical', label: 'FİZ', stat: cardData.stats.physical },
  ];

  const overall = cardData.overall;

  return (

          <div

import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';

export const FifaCard: React.FC = () => {
    const [rotateX, setRotateX] = useState(0);
    const [rotateY, setRotateY] = useState(0);
    const [glareX, setGlareX] = useState(50);
    const [glareY, setGlareY] = useState(50);
    const cardRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

    const handleMouseMove = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        if (!cardRef.current) return;
        const rect = cardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
        const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
        
        const centerX = rect.width / 2;
        const centerY = rect.height / 2;
        
        const rotateXValue = ((y - centerY) / centerY) * -15; // Max 15 deg
        const rotateYValue = ((x - centerX) / centerX) * 15;
        
        setRotateX(rotateXValue);
        setRotateY(rotateYValue);
        setGlareX((x / rect.width) * 100);
        setGlareY((y / rect.height) * 100);
    };

    const handleMouseLeave = () => {
        setRotateX(0);
        setRotateY(0);
        setGlareX(50);
        setGlareY(50);
    };

    return (
        <div className="perspective-[1000px] w-full max-w-[260px] mx-auto my-4">
            <motion.div
                ref={cardRef}
                onMouseMove={handleMouseMove}
                onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
                animate={{ rotateX, rotateY }}
                transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 300, damping: 30, mass: 0.5 }}
                className="relative w-full aspect-[1/1.5] cursor-pointer group transform-style-3d shadow-[0_20px_50px_rgba(201,160,60,0.3)]"
                style={{
                    background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #f3d370 0%, #fff3b0 30%, #d4af37 70%, #aa7c11 100%)',

                <div

                {/* Card Content */}

--- FILE: ./components/Particles.tsx ---
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

interface Particle {
  id: number;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  size: number;
  color: string;
  duration: number;
}

interface ParticlesProps {
  count?: number;
  colors?: string[];
}

export const Particles: React.FC<ParticlesProps> = ({ 
  count = 30, 
  colors = ['#FFFF00', '#39FF14', '#FFFFFF', '#FF00FF'] 
}) => {
  const [particles, setParticles] = useState<Particle[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const newParticles: Particle[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      newParticles.push({
        id: i,
        x: Math.random() * 100, // percentage
        y: Math.random() * 100, // percentage
        size: Math.random() * 6 + 2, // 2px to 8px
        color: colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)],
        duration: Math.random() * 2 + 1, // 1s to 3s
      });
    }
    setParticles(newParticles);
  }, [count, colors]);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none z-50 overflow-hidden">
      {particles.map((p) => (
        <div
          key={p.id}
          className="particle"
          style={{
            left: `${p.x}%`,
            top: `${p.y}%`,
            width: `${p.size}px`,
            height: `${p.size}px`,
            backgroundColor: p.color,
            animationDuration: `${p.duration}s`,
            boxShadow: `0 0 ${p.size * 2}px ${p.color}`,
          }}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

    { id: 'MATCH_DISCOVERY', icon: Calendar, label: 'Maçlar' },
    { id: 'STUDIO', icon: Target, label: 'Taktik', isCenter: true },
    { id: 'PITCH_DISCOVERY', icon: Users, label: 'Sahalar' },
    { id: 'PROFILE', icon: User, label: 'Profil' },
  ];

  return (
    <motion.div 
      initial={{ y: 100 }}
      animate={{ y: 0 }}
      transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 300, damping: 30 }}
      className="fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 px-4 pt-2"
      style={{ paddingBottom: 'calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px) + 16px)' }}
    >
      <div className="bg-[#161B22]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-[32px] px-2 py-2 flex items-center justify-between shadow-[0_-10px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]">
        {navItems.map((item) => {
          const isActive = currentView === item.id;
          const Icon = item.icon;

          if (item.isCenter) {
            return (
              <button
                key={item.id}
                onClick={() => onNavigate(item.id as AppView)}
                className="relative -top-6 flex flex-col items-center justify-center group"
              >
                <motion.div 
                  whileHover={{ scale: 1.05 }}
                  whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
                  className={`w-14 h-14 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(57,255,20,0.3)] transition-colors ${
                    isActive ? 'bg-[#39FF14] text-black' : 'bg-[#0A0E14] border-2 border-[#39FF14] text-[#39FF14]'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Icon size={24} strokeWidth={isActive ? 3 : 2} />
                </motion.div>
                <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold mt-1 transition-colors ${isActive ? 'text-[#39FF14]' : 'text-gray-500'}`}>
                  {item.label}
                </span>
              </button>
            );
          }

          return (
            <button
              key={item.id}
              onClick={() => onNavigate(item.id as AppView)}
              className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 py-2 relative group"
            >
              {isActive && (
                <motion.div 
                  layoutId="bottomNavIndicator"
                  className="absolute inset-1 bg-gradient-to-b from-white/10 to-transparent rounded-xl border-t border-white/20"
                  initial={false}
                  transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 300, damping: 25 }}
                />
              )}
              <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
                <Icon 
                  size={20} 
                  className={`transition-colors duration-300 ${isActive ? 'text-white' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-gray-300'}`} 
                  strokeWidth={isActive ? 2.5 : 2}
                />
                <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold transition-colors duration-300 ${isActive ? 'text-white' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-gray-300'}`}>
                  {item.label}
                </span>
              </div>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
};

interface OynaLogoProps {
  className?: string;

export const OynaLogo: React.FC<OynaLogoProps> = ({
  className = "",
  width = 200,
  height = 200,
  animate = false

    hidden: { pathLength: 0, opacity: 0 },

        opacity: { delay: i * 0.1, duration: 0.2 }
      }
    })
  };

    <svg
      width={width}
      height={height}

--- FILE: ./components/LiveTacticBoard.tsx ---
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Users, Wifi, ChevronDown, X, Check, MapPin, Calendar, Clock, Plus, Star, Shield } from 'lucide-react';
import { db, auth } from '../firebase';
import { doc, setDoc, onSnapshot } from 'firebase/firestore';

// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
interface SlotPlayer { id: string; name: string; avatar: string; role: string; rating: number; }
interface TacticSlot { id: string; role: string; x: number; y: number; player?: SlotPlayer; archetype?: string; }

// ─── Formations (Extracted from Studio.tsx) ───────────────────────────────────
const FORMATIONS: Record<string, TacticSlot[]> = {

  ],
};

const MOCK_SQUAD: SlotPlayer[] = [
  { id:'p1', name:'Kerem Y.',  avatar:'https://api.dicebear.com/7.x/avataaars/svg?seed=Kerem',  role:'FWD', rating:83 },
  { id:'p2', name:'Ahmet K.', avatar:'https://api.dicebear.com/7.x/avataaars/svg?seed=Ahmet',  role:'MID', rating:78 },
  { id:'p3', name:'Mert Ş.',  avatar:'https://api.dicebear.com/7.x/avataaars/svg?seed=Mert',   role:'DEF', rating:80 },

  { id:'p6', name:'Emre B.',  avatar:'https://api.dicebear.com/7.x/avataaars/svg?seed=Emre',   role:'MID', rating:74 },
  { id:'p7', name:'Sinan T.', avatar:'https://api.dicebear.com/7.x/avataaars/svg?seed=Sinan',  role:'DEF', rating:79 },
];

interface LiveTacticBoardProps { matchId: string; }

const LiveTacticBoard: React.FC<LiveTacticBoardProps> = ({ matchId }) => {
  const [formation, setFormation] = useState('2-3-1');
  const [slots, setSlots] = useState<TacticSlot[]>(FORMATIONS['2-3-1']);
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectModal, setSelectModal] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [synced, setSynced] = useState(false);
  const [lastEditor, setLastEditor] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showFormPicker, setShowFormPicker] = useState(false);
  const pitchRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const docRef = doc(db, 'matchTactics', matchId);

  // ── Firestore real-time listener ──────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    const unsub = onSnapshot(docRef, snap => {
      if (snap.exists()) {
        const d = snap.data();
        setFormation(d.formation);
        setSlots(JSON.parse(d.slots));
        setLastEditor(d.editorName || null);
        setSynced(true);
      }
    }, () => setSynced(false));
    return () => unsub();
  }, [matchId]);

  const push = async (newFormation: string, newSlots: TacticSlot[]) => {
    try {
      await setDoc(docRef, {
        formation: newFormation,
        slots: JSON.stringify(newSlots),
        editorName: auth.currentUser?.displayName || 'Sen',
        updatedAt: Date.now(),
      }, { merge: true });
      setSynced(true);
    } catch { setSynced(false); }
  };

  const changeFormation = (f: string) => {
    const base = FORMATIONS[f].map(slot => ({ ...slot }));
    slots.forEach(old => {
      const match = base.find(b => b.id === old.id);
      if (match && old.player) match.player = old.player;
    });
    setFormation(f);
    setSlots(base);
    push(f, base);
    setShowFormPicker(false);
  };

  const onPointerDown = (e: React.PointerEvent, slotId: string) => {
    if (!(slots.find(s => s.id === slotId)?.player)) return;
    e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    setDragging(slotId);
  };

  const rafRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  const onPointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if (!dragging || !pitchRef.current) return;
    const rect = pitchRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = Math.max(5, Math.min(95, ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100));
    const y = Math.max(5, Math.min(95, ((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100));
    
    if (rafRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
    rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      setSlots(prev => prev.map(s => s.id === dragging ? { ...s, x, y } : s));
    });
  };

  const onPointerUp = () => {
    if (dragging) { push(formation, slots); setDragging(null); }
  };

  const assignPlayer = (player: SlotPlayer) => {
    if (!selectModal) return;
    const updated = slots.map(s => ({
      ...s,
      player: s.player?.id === player.id ? undefined : s.player,
    })).map(s => s.id === selectModal ? { ...s, player } : s);
    setSlots(updated);
    push(formation, updated);
    setSelectModal(null);
  };

  const removePlayer = (slotId: string) => {
    const updated = slots.map(s => s.id === slotId ? { ...s, player: undefined } : s);
    setSlots(updated);
    push(formation, updated);
    setSelectModal(null);
  };

  const assignedIds = slots.filter(s => s.player).map(s => s.player!.id);
  const bench = MOCK_SQUAD.filter(p => !assignedIds.includes(p.id));

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      
      {/* ── Match Info Header (Date, Time, Location) ───────────────────────── */}
      <div className="bg-[#161B22] p-4 rounded-2xl border border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-gradient-to-br from-[#39FF14] to-emerald-600 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg">
             <Shield size={24} className="text-black" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-white font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center gap-1"><MapPin size={14} className="text-blue-400"/> Vadi Spor Tesisleri</h2>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1">
               <span className="bg-white/10 text-gray-300 text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded flex items-center gap-1"><Calendar size={10} /> 12 Mayıs Cuma</span>
               <span className="bg-[#39FF14]/20 text-[#39FF14] text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-bold flex items-center gap-1"><Clock size={10} /> 21:00</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── Top bar ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${synced ? 'bg-[#39FF14] shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(57,255,20,0.8)]' : 'bg-red-500'} animate-pulse`} />
          <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-gray-400">
            {synced ? 'Canlı Eşzamanlı' : 'Bağlantı Yok'}
          </span>
        </div>
        {/* Formation picker */}
        <button
          onClick={() => setShowFormPicker(v => !v)}
          className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/50 px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest hover:bg-blue-500/30 transition-colors"
        >
          {formation} <ChevronDown size={14} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {showFormPicker && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -8 }}
            className="flex flex-wrap gap-2"
          >
            {Object.keys(FORMATIONS).map(f => (
              <button
                key={f}
                onClick={() => changeFormation(f)}
                className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest transition-all ${
                  formation === f
                    ? 'bg-blue-500 text-white shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(59,130,246,0.5)]'
                    : 'bg-white/5 text-gray-400 hover:text-white'
                }`}
              >
                {f}
              </button>
            ))}
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {/* ── Pitch Area (From Studio.tsx Gerçek Mode) ────────────────────────── */}
      <div
        ref={pitchRef}
        onPointerMove={onPointerMove}
        onPointerUp={onPointerUp}
        onPointerLeave={onPointerUp}
        className="relative w-full aspect-[3/4] bg-[#0B2815] rounded-[24px] border-4 border-[#161B22] shadow-[inset_0_0_60px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] overflow-hidden"
      >
        {/* Grass Stripes */}
        <div className="absolute inset-0 opacity-10 pointer-events-none" style={{ backgroundImage: 'repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent, transparent 10%, rgba(0,0,0,0.2) 10%, rgba(0,0,0,0.2) 20%)' }}></div>

        {/* Pitch Markings — viewBox matches 3:4 aspect ratio for perfect symmetry */}
        <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none opacity-40">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 600 800" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" className="w-full h-full" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                <g stroke="white" strokeWidth="4" fill="none" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                    {/* Outer boundary */}
                    <rect x="20" y="20" width="560" height="760" />
                    {/* Center line */}
                    <line x1="20" y1="400" x2="580" y2="400" />
                    {/* Center circle */}
                    <circle cx="300" cy="400" r="70" />
                    {/* Center dot */}
                    <circle cx="300" cy="400" r="3" fill="white" />

                    {/* Top penalty area */}
                    <rect x="130" y="20" width="340" height="120" />
                    {/* Top goal area */}
                    <rect x="210" y="20" width="180" height="45" />
                    {/* Top penalty dot */}
                    <circle cx="300" cy="100" r="3" fill="white" />
                    {/* Top penalty arc */}
                    <path d="M 230 140 A 70 70 0 0 0 370 140" />

                    {/* Bottom penalty area */}
                    <rect x="130" y="660" width="340" height="120" />
                    {/* Bottom goal area */}
                    <rect x="210" y="735" width="180" height="45" />
                    {/* Bottom penalty dot */}
                    <circle cx="300" cy="700" r="3" fill="white" />
                    {/* Bottom penalty arc */}
                    <path d="M 230 660 A 70 70 0 0 1 370 660" />

                    {/* Corner arcs */}
                    <path d="M 20 50 A 30 30 0 0 0 50 20" />
                    <path d="M 550 20 A 30 30 0 0 0 580 50" />
                    <path d="M 20 750 A 30 30 0 0 1 50 780" />
                    <path d="M 580 750 A 30 30 0 0 0 550 780" />
                </g>
            </svg>
        </div>

        {/* Slots */}
        {slots.map(slot => (
          <div
            key={slot.id}
            onPointerDown={e => slot.player ? onPointerDown(e, slot.id) : undefined}
            className={`absolute transform -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-20 ${slot.player ? 'cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing touch-none' : ''}`}
            style={{ left: `${slot.x}%`, top: `${slot.y}%` }}
          >
            <div className="relative flex flex-col items-center">
              {slot.player ? (
                <motion.div
                    whileHover={{ scale: 1.1 }}
                    whileTap={{ scale: 0.9 }}
                    className={`relative w-12 h-12 rounded-full border-2 flex items-center justify-center shadow-[0_4px_15px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] ${slot.role === 'GK' ? 'bg-gradient-to-br from-orange-400 to-orange-600 border-orange-300' : 'bg-gradient-to-br from-[#1e2532] to-[#11151c] border-white/30'}`}
                >
                    {/* Replaced initial with image for more personal feel like original join */}
                    {slot.player.avatar ? (
                        <img src={slot.player.avatar} className="w-full h-full rounded-full object-cover" alt={slot.player.name}/>

              ) : (
                <motion.button
                    whileHover={{ scale: 1.1 }}
                    whileTap={{ scale: 0.9 }}
                    onClick={() => !dragging && setSelectModal(slot.id)}
                    className={`relative w-12 h-12 rounded-full border-2 border-dashed flex items-center justify-center bg-black/20 backdrop-blur-sm transition-colors ${slot.role === 'GK' ? 'border-orange-500/50 text-orange-500 hover:border-orange-400' : 'border-blue-500/50 text-blue-400/70 hover:border-blue-400 hover:text-blue-400'}`}

              {slot.player && (
                 <div className="absolute top-full mt-1 flex flex-col items-center pointer-events-none">

            </div>

        ))}

      {bench.length > 0 && (
        <div className="bg-[#161B22] border border-white/5 rounded-2xl p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-black text-white uppercase tracking-widest mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Users size={16} className="text-blue-400" /> KADRODAKİ DİĞER İNSANLAR

                key={p.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  const empty = slots.find(s => !s.player);
                  if (empty) {
                    const updated = slots.map(s => s.id === empty.id ? { ...s, player: p } : s);
                    setSlots(updated);
                    push(formation, updated);
                  }
                }}
                className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 bg-white/5 rounded-xl border border-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 hover:border-blue-500/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >

                    <Plus size={16} />
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Player select modal ───────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {selectModal && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
            className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md flex flex-col"
            onClick={() => setSelectModal(null)}
          >
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6 pt-20" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
                 <div>
                    <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-white uppercase tracking-widest">Oyuncu Seç</h2>
                    <p className="text-xs font-mono text-blue-400">Takım Arkadaşları</p>
                 </div>
                 <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    {slots.find(s => s.id === selectModal)?.player && (
                        <button
                        onClick={() => removePlayer(selectModal)}
                        className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20 text-red-400 text-xs font-bold"
                        >
                        Kaldır
                        </button>
                    )}
                    <button onClick={() => setSelectModal(null)} className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-white/10 flex items-center justify-center text-white hover:bg-white/20">
                        <X size={20} />
                    </button>
                 </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-3">
                {MOCK_SQUAD.map(player => {
                  const isAssigned = assignedIds.includes(player.id) && slots.find(s => s.id === selectModal)?.player?.id !== player.id;
                  const isCurrent = slots.find(s => s.id === selectModal)?.player?.id === player.id;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={player.id}
                      onClick={() => !isAssigned && assignPlayer(player)}
                      disabled={isAssigned}
                      className={`w-full flex items-center gap-4 p-4 rounded-2xl border transition-all text-left ${
                        isCurrent
                          ? 'bg-blue-500/20 border-blue-500'
                          : isAssigned
                          ? 'bg-white/5 border-white/5 opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed'
                          : 'bg-[#161B22] border-white/5 hover:border-blue-500/50'
                      }`}
                    >

                      <div className="flex-1">
                        <h4 className="text-white font-bold text-sm">{player.name}</h4>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1">
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-black px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-white/10 text-gray-300">{player.role}</span>
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-yellow-400 flex items-center gap-0.5"><Star size={10} className="fill-current"/> {player.rating}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      {isCurrent && <Check size={20} className="text-blue-500" />}
                      {isAssigned && !isCurrent && <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase">Sahada</span>}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
};

export default LiveTacticBoard;


--- FILE: ./components/AnimatedButton.tsx ---
import React, { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { motion, HTMLMotionProps } from 'framer-motion';

type AnimatedElementProps<T extends React.ElementType> = {
  as?: T;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  haptic?: boolean;
} & React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<T> & HTMLMotionProps<any>;

export const AnimatedButton = <T extends React.ElementType = 'button'>({
  as,
  children,
  className = '',
  haptic = true,
  onClick,
  ...props
}: AnimatedElementProps<T>) => {
  const [ripples, setRipples] = useState<{ x: number; y: number; id: number }[]>([]);
  const elementRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);

  const Component = as === 'div' ? motion.div : motion.button;

  const handleClick = (e: any) => {
    // Haptic feedback
    if (haptic && typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.vibrate) {
      navigator.vibrate(50); // Light tap
    }

    // Ripple effect
    if (elementRef.current) {
      const rect = elementRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
      const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
      const id = Date.now();
      
      setRipples((prev) => [...prev, { x, y, id }]);
      
      // Clean up ripple after animation
      setTimeout(() => {
        setRipples((prev) => prev.filter((r) => r.id !== id));
      }, 600);
    }

    if (onClick) {
      onClick(e);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Component
      ref={elementRef}
      whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
      transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 400, damping: 17 }}
      className={`relative overflow-hidden ${className}`}
      onClick={handleClick}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
      {ripples.map((ripple) => (
        <span
          key={ripple.id}
          className="ripple"
          style={{
            left: ripple.x,
            top: ripple.y,
            width: 20,
            height: 20,
            marginLeft: -10,
            marginTop: -10,
          }}
        />
      ))}
    </Component>
  );
};


--- FILE: ./components/ErrorBoundary.tsx ---
import React, { Component, ErrorInfo, ReactNode } from 'react';

interface Props {
  children?: ReactNode;
}

interface State {
  hasError: boolean;
  error: Error | null;
}

export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {
  public state: State = {
    hasError: false,
    error: null
  };

  public static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): State {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  public componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
    console.error('Uncaught error:', error, errorInfo);
  }

  public render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return (
        <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#0A0E14] text-white flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6">
          <div className="bg-[#161B22] p-8 rounded-2xl border border-red-500/30 max-w-md w-full text-center">
            <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-red-500/20 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4">
              <svg className="w-8 h-8 text-red-500" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M12 9v2m0 4h.01m-6.938 4h13.856c1.54 0 2.502-1.667 1.732-3L13.732 4c-.77-1.333-2.694-1.333-3.464 0L3.34 16c-.77 1.333.192 3 1.732 3z" />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-2">Oops! Bir şeyler ters gitti.</h1>
            <p className="text-gray-400 mb-6 text-sm">
              Uygulamada beklenmeyen bir hata oluştu. Lütfen sayfayı yenileyin veya daha sonra tekrar deneyin.
            </p>
            <button
              onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
              className="w-full py-3 bg-[#FFFF00] text-black font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-[#e6e600] transition-colors"
            >
              Sayfayı Yenile
            </button>
            {process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' && this.state.error && (
              <div className="mt-6 p-4 bg-black/50 rounded-lg text-left overflow-auto text-xs text-red-400">
                <p className="font-mono">{this.state.error.toString()}</p>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return (this as any).props.children;
  }
}

--- FILE: ./hooks/useImageUpload.ts ---
import { useState } from 'react';
import { ref, uploadBytesResumable, getDownloadURL } from 'firebase/storage';
import { storage } from '../firebase';

export const useImageUpload = (folder: string = 'uploads') => {
    const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
    const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);

    const uploadImage = async (file: File): Promise<string> => {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            if (!file) {
                reject('No file provided');
                return;
            }

            setUploading(true);
            const fileRef = ref(storage, `${folder}/${Date.now()}_${file.name}`);
            const uploadTask = uploadBytesResumable(fileRef, file);

            uploadTask.on(
                'state_changed',
                (snapshot) => {
                    const prog = (snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100;
                    setProgress(prog);
                },
                (error) => {
                    console.error('Upload error:', error);
                    setUploading(false);
                    reject(error);
                },
                async () => {
                    try {
                        const downloadURL = await getDownloadURL(uploadTask.snapshot.ref);
                        setUploading(false);
                        setProgress(0);
                        resolve(downloadURL);
                    } catch (error) {
                        console.error('Download URL error:', error);
                        setUploading(false);
                        reject(error);
                    }
                }
            );
        });
    };

    return { uploadImage, uploading, progress };
};

  </div>

const ServiceSettings: React.FC<ServiceSettingsProps> = ({ role, onBack, onLogout }) => {
  const isRef = role === UserRole.REFEREE;
  const accentColor = isRef ? '#ef4444' : '#22c55e';
  const accentBg = isRef ? 'rgba(239,68,68,0.10)' : 'rgba(34,197,94,0.10)';

  const [openSection, setOpenSection] = useState<SectionKey>(null);
  const [confirmLogout, setConfirmLogout] = useState(false);

  // Notification toggles — individual state keys to avoid full re-render
  const [notifNewOffer, setNotifNewOffer] = useState(true);
  const [notifReminder, setNotifReminder] = useState(true);
  const [notifPayment, setNotifPayment] = useState(true);
  const [notifMarketing, setNotifMarketing] = useState(false);
  const [notifWeekly, setNotifWeekly] = useState(true);

  // Privacy
  const [showProfile, setShowProfile] = useState(true);
  const [showRating, setShowRating] = useState(true);
  const [hidePhone, setHidePhone] = useState(false);
  const [allowOffer, setAllowOffer] = useState(true);

  // Appearance
  const [darkMode, setDarkMode] = useState(true);
  const [language, setLanguage] = useState<'TR' | 'EN'>('TR');

  // Apply dark/light mode to document
  useEffect(() => {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    if (darkMode) {
      root.classList.add('dark');
      root.style.colorScheme = 'dark';
      document.body.style.background = '#060A12';
    } else {
      root.classList.remove('dark');
      root.style.colorScheme = 'light';
      document.body.style.background = '#f1f5f9';
    }
    return () => {
      root.style.colorScheme = '';
      document.body.style.background = '';
    };
  }, [darkMode]);

  const toggleSection = useCallback((key: SectionKey) => {
    setOpenSection(prev => prev === key ? null : key);
  }, []);

  const SectionCard = ({
    sectionKey, icon, title, subtitle, color, children
  }: {
    sectionKey: SectionKey; icon: React.ReactNode; title: string;
    subtitle: string; color: string; children: React.ReactNode;
  }) => {
    const isOpen = openSection === sectionKey;
    return (
      <div className="rounded-[24px] overflow-hidden border border-white/8 bg-[#0d1420]">
        <button
          onClick={() => toggleSection(sectionKey)}
          className="w-full flex items-center justify-between p-5"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center"
              style={{ background: color + '18', color }}>
              {icon}
            </div>

              <p className="font-black text-sm text-white">{title}</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-medium">{subtitle}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <ChevronRight
            size={18}
            className="text-gray-600 transition-transform duration-300"
            style={{ transform: isOpen ? 'rotate(90deg)' : 'rotate(0deg)' }}
          />
        </button>
        {isOpen && (
          <div className="px-5 pb-5 border-t border-white/5 pt-3">
            {children}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  };

  const screenBg = darkMode ? 'bg-[#060A12]' : 'bg-slate-100';
  const textColor = darkMode ? 'text-white' : 'text-gray-900';
  const cardBg = darkMode ? 'bg-[#0d1420]' : 'bg-white';

  return (
    <div className={`min-h-screen ${screenBg} ${textColor} transition-colors duration-500`}>

      {/* Ambient */}

      </div>

      {/* Header */}

        <button onClick={onBack} className="p-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10">

          <p className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest" style={{ color: accentColor }}>
            {isRef ? 'Hakem' : 'Kaleci'} Hesabı
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="px-4 pb-24 space-y-3 mt-4">

        {/* Account summary */}
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 14 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          className={`rounded-[24px] p-5 flex items-center gap-4 border border-white/8`}
          style={{ background: accentBg }}
        >
          <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center text-black font-black text-xl"
            style={{ background: accentColor }}>
            {isRef ? '⚖️' : '🧤'}

            <p className="font-black">{isRef ? 'CÜNEYT A.' : 'UĞURCAN Ç.'}</p>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-medium">
              {isRef ? 'FIFA Lisanslı Hakem' : 'Elit Kaleci'}
            </p>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 mt-1">
              <Star size={10} className="text-yellow-400" fill="currentColor" />
              <span className="text-[10px] font-black">4.9</span>
