const RoleHeroCard: React.FC<{ 
  role: UserRole;
  title: string; 
  subtitle: string;
  icon: React.ReactNode; 
  glowColor: string;
  gradientFrom: string;
  gradientTo: string;
  borderActive: string;
  iconBg: string;
  onComplete: () => void;
  delayMs: number;
}> = ({ role, title, subtitle, icon, glowColor, gradientFrom, gradientTo, borderActive, iconBg, onComplete, delayMs }) => {
  const [isEntering, setIsEntering] = useState(false);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [isHovered, setIsHovered] = useState(false);

  const getRoleLabel = (r: UserRole) => {
    if (r === UserRole.PLAYER) return 'OYUNCU KİMLİĞİ';
    if (r === UserRole.GOALKEEPER) return 'KALECİ KİMLİĞİ';
    if (r === UserRole.REFEREE) return 'HAKEM KİMLİĞİ';
    if (r === UserRole.OWNER) return 'SAHİP PANELİ';
    return `${r} ID`;
  };

  const handleEntry = () => {
    if (isEntering) return;
    setIsEntering(true);
    if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(15);
    let p = 0;
    const iv = setInterval(() => {
      p += Math.random() * 22 + 12;
      if (p >= 100) {
        p = 100; clearInterval(iv); setProgress(100);
        if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate([40, 80, 180]);
        setTimeout(onComplete, 280);
      } else { setProgress(p); }
    }, 35);
  };

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 32, scale: 0.94 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: isEntering ? 0.97 : 1 }}
      transition={{
        opacity: { duration: 0.5, delay: delayMs / 1000 },
        y: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 280, damping: 24, delay: delayMs / 1000 },
        scale: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 400, damping: 22 }
      }}
      onClick={handleEntry}
      onHoverStart={() => setIsHovered(true)}
      onHoverEnd={() => setIsHovered(false)}
      className="group relative w-full rounded-[28px] overflow-hidden cursor-pointer select-none" style={{ minHeight: 112,
        boxShadow: isHovered || isEntering
          ? `0 0 0 1.5px ${glowColor}80, 0 8px 40px ${glowColor}30, inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06)`
          : '0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.07), 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.04)',
        transition: 'box-shadow 0.35s ease'
      }}
    >
      {/* Glass base */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0" style={{
        background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${gradientFrom} 0%, #0d1420 60%, ${gradientTo} 100%)`,
        opacity: isHovered ? 1 : 0.88,
        transition: 'opacity 0.35s ease'
      }} />

      {/* Progress fill */}
      <motion.div
        className="absolute inset-0 origin-left"
        style={{
          scaleX: progress / 100,
          background: `linear-gradient(90deg, ${glowColor}18, ${glowColor}40)`
        }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.05 }}
      />

      {/* Animated scan line on hover */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {isHovered && !isEntering && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ x: '-100%' }}
            animate={{ x: '200%' }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.7, ease: 'easeInOut' }}
            className="absolute inset-y-0 w-1/3 pointer-events-none"
            style={{ background: `linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, ${glowColor}25, transparent)` }}
          />
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {/* Giant watermark icon */}
      <motion.div
        className="absolute -right-3 -bottom-3 pointer-events-none"
        animate={{ rotate: isHovered ? 8 : 0, scale: isHovered ? 1.12 : 1 }}
        transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 200, damping: 20 }}
        style={{ color: glowColor, opacity: isHovered ? 0.12 : 0.06 }}
      >
        {React.cloneElement(icon as React.ReactElement<any>, { size: 130 })}
      </motion.div>

      {/* Content row */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 px-5 flex items-center gap-4 z-10">
        {/* Icon box */}
        <motion.div
          animate={{ scale: isEntering ? 0.9 : isHovered ? 1.08 : 1 }}
          transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 350, damping: 22 }}
          className="shrink-0 w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center"
          style={{
            background: iconBg,
            boxShadow: isHovered ? `0 0 18px ${glowColor}50` : `0 0 0 1px ${glowColor}25`,
            color: glowColor
          }}
        >
          {React.cloneElement(icon as React.ReactElement<any>, { size: 24, strokeWidth: 2.2 })}
        </motion.div>

        {/* Text */}
        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
          <p className="text-[8.5px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.25em] mb-0.5" style={{ color: glowColor, opacity: 0.75 }}>{getRoleLabel(role)}</p>
          <motion.h2
            animate={{ x: isEntering ? 6 : 0 }}
            transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 400, damping: 25 }}
            className="text-[22px] font-black text-white italic tracking-tight leading-none mb-1"
          >{title}</motion.h2>
          <p className="text-[10.5px] text-gray-300 font-medium leading-snug" style={{ maxWidth: 200 }}>{subtitle}</p>
        </div>

        {/* Right indicator */}
        <div className="shrink-0">
          {isEntering ? (
            <motion.div
              animate={{ rotate: 360 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.8, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'linear' }}
              className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full border-2 border-transparent"
              style={{ borderTopColor: glowColor }}
            />
          ) : (
            <motion.div
              animate={{ x: isHovered ? 3 : 0 }}
              className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center"
              style={{
                background: isHovered ? `${glowColor}20` : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)',
                border: `1px solid ${isHovered ? glowColor + '60' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)'}`,
                color: isHovered ? glowColor : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)',
                transition: 'all 0.25s ease'
              }}
            >
              <ArrowRight size={15} />
            </motion.div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
};

const RoleSelection: React.FC<RoleSelectionProps> = ({ onSelect, onBack, onPartnerInvite, onNavigate }) => {
  const [selectedRole, setSelectedRole] = useState<UserRole | null>(null);
  const [step, setStep] = useState<1 | 2 | 3>(1); // 1: Role, 2: Contact, 3: Physical
  const [isVerifying, setIsVerifying] = useState(false);
  
  // Data States
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
      fullName: '',
      phone: '',
      email: '',
      tcNumber: '', // Added for Ref/Owner
      age: '',
      height: '',
      weight: '',
      position: ''
  });

  const handleCardClick = (role: UserRole) => {
    onSelect(role, formData);
  };

  const handleBack = () => {
    if (step === 3) {
        setStep(2);
    } else if (step === 2) {
        setStep(1);
        setSelectedRole(null);
    } else {
        onBack();
    }
  };

  // Determine if this is a "Professional" role (Ref/Owner) that skips physical attributes
  const isProfessionalRole = selectedRole === UserRole.REFEREE || selectedRole === UserRole.OWNER;

  const handleNextAction = () => {
      if (isProfessionalRole) {
          // For Pros: Step 2 is the final step. Validate TC & Phone then complete.
          if (formData.tcNumber && formData.phone) {
              handleComplete();
          }
      } else {
          // For Players: Go to Step 3 (Physical Attributes)
          if (formData.fullName && formData.phone) {
              setStep(3);
          }
      }
  };

  const handleComplete = () => {
    if (selectedRole) {
       setIsVerifying(true);
       setTimeout(() => {
           onSelect(selectedRole, formData);
       }, 1500);
    }
  };

  const getRoleTheme = () => {
      switch(selectedRole) {
          case UserRole.OWNER: return { color: 'text-blue-400', border: 'border-blue-500', bg: 'bg-blue-600' };
          case UserRole.REFEREE: return { color: 'text-red-500', border: 'border-red-500', bg: 'bg-red-600' };
          case UserRole.GOALKEEPER: return { color: 'text-green-400', border: 'border-green-500', bg: 'bg-green-600' };
          default: return { color: 'text-[#FFFF00]', border: 'border-[#FFFF00]', bg: 'bg-[#FFFF00]' };
      }
  };

  const positions = ['Forvet', 'Orta Saha', 'Defans', 'Kaleci', 'Libero'];
  const theme = getRoleTheme();

  // --- STEP 2 & 3 CONTAINER ---
  if (step > 1) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 bg-[#0A0E14] relative overflow-hidden">
         {/* Background Grid */}
         <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.02)_1px,transparent_1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,0.02)_1px,transparent_1px)] bg-[size:40px_40px]"></div>
         
         {/* Dynamic Glow */}
         <div className={`absolute top-[-20%] right-[-20%] w-[500px] h-[500px] blur-[150px] rounded-full opacity-20 pointer-events-none ${theme.bg}`}></div>

         <div className="w-full max-w-md bg-[#161B22]/90 backdrop-blur-2xl rounded-[40px] border border-white/10 p-8 relative shadow-2xl z-10">
            
            {/* Header / Back */}
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-8">
                <button onClick={handleBack} className="p-3 bg-[#0A0E14] rounded-full text-white border border-white/5 hover:border-white/20 transition-colors">
                   <ArrowLeft size={20} />
                </button>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    {/* Progress Dots */}
                    <div className={`h-1.5 w-12 rounded-full transition-colors ${step === 2 ? theme.bg : 'bg-gray-800'}`}></div>
                    {!isProfessionalRole && (
                        <div className={`h-1.5 w-12 rounded-full transition-colors ${step === 3 ? theme.bg : 'bg-gray-800'}`}></div>
                    )}
                </div>
                <div className={`text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0E14] border ${theme.border} ${theme.color}`}>
                    {selectedRole}
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="mb-8">
                <h2 className="text-3xl font-black text-white italic tracking-tight">
                    {step === 2 ? (isProfessionalRole ? 'HIZLI DOĞRULAMA' : 'KİMLİK BİLGİLERİ') : 'FİZİKSEL KÜNYE'}
                </h2>
                <p className="text-gray-400 text-xs mt-2 font-medium">
                    {step === 2 
                        ? (isProfessionalRole ? 'Ödeme ve güvenlik işlemleri için gereklidir.' : 'Seni tanımamız ve iletişime geçebilmemiz için gerekli.')

  iconRetinaUrl: 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet/1.7.1/images/marker-icon-2x.png',

  shadowUrl: 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet/1.7.1/images/marker-shadow.png',
});

const createPitchPin = (pitch: Pitch, isSelected: boolean) => {
  const priceLabel = pitch.totalPrice ? `${pitch.totalPrice}₺` : pitch.name.split(' ')[0];
  return L.divIcon({
    className: 'oyna-pitch-pin',
    html: `
      <div style="position:relative;display:inline-block;">
        <div class="pin-bubble ${isSelected ? 'selected' : ''}">
          <svg width="8" height="8" viewBox="0 0 8 8" fill="${isSelected ? '#000' : '#39FF14'}"><circle cx="4" cy="4" r="4"/></svg>
          ${priceLabel}
        </div>
        <div class="pin-nub ${isSelected ? 'selected' : ''}"></div>
      </div>
    `,
    iconSize: [0, 0],
    iconAnchor: [0, 0],
  });
};

interface MapViewProps { pitches: Pitch[]; selectedPitch: Pitch | null; onPitchSelect: (p: Pitch) => void; }

const PitchMapResizer = () => {
  const map = useMap();
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => { map.invalidateSize(); }, 200);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [map]);
  return null;
};

const MapViewComponent = ({ pitches, selectedPitch, onPitchSelect }: MapViewProps) => {
  const center: [number, number] = [41.0082, 28.9784];

  return (
    <div className="absolute inset-0 z-0">
      <style>{AIRBNB_MAP_CSS}</style>
      <MapContainer center={center} zoom={12} className="w-full h-full" zoomControl={false}>
        <TileLayer
          url="https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png"
          attribution=""
        />
        <PitchMapResizer />
        {pitches.map(pitch => {
          if (!pitch.coordinates?.lat || !pitch.coordinates?.lng) return null;
          const isSel = selectedPitch?.id === pitch.id;
          return (
            <Marker
              key={pitch.id}
              position={[pitch.coordinates.lat, pitch.coordinates.lng]}
              icon={createPitchPin(pitch, isSel)}
              eventHandlers={{ click: () => onPitchSelect(pitch) }}
            >
              <Popup closeButton={false} offset={[0, -30]}>
                <div
                  onClick={() => onPitchSelect(pitch)}
                  style={{
                    width: 200,
                    background: 'rgba(13,17,26,0.96)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
                    border: '1px solid rgba(57,255,20,0.2)',
                    borderRadius: 20,
                    overflow: 'hidden',
                    boxShadow: '0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.8)',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  <div style={{ position: 'relative', height: 100 }}>
                    <img src={pitch.image} alt={pitch.name} style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }} />
                    <div style={{
                      position: 'absolute', inset: 0,
                      background: 'linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 40%, rgba(13,17,26,0.95))',
                    }} />
                    <div style={{
                      position: 'absolute', top: 8, right: 8,
                      background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)', backdropFilter: 'blur(8px)',
                      borderRadius: 100, padding: '3px 8px',
                      display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4,
                      fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 900, color: '#FACC15',
                    }}>
                      ★ {pitch.rating}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ padding: '10px 12px 12px' }}>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 900, color: '#fff', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>{pitch.name}</div>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginTop: 6 }}>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)' }}>{pitch.district}</div>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 900, color: '#39FF14' }}>{pitch.totalPrice}₺</div>
                    </div>
                    <div style={{
                      marginTop: 8, padding: '6px 10px',
                      background: 'rgba(57,255,20,0.12)', borderRadius: 10,
                      border: '1px solid rgba(57,255,20,0.2)',
                      textAlign: 'center', fontSize: 9, fontWeight: 900,
                      color: '#39FF14', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: 1,
                    }}>
                      İncele →
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </Popup>
            </Marker>
          );
        })}
      </MapContainer>
    </div>
  );
};


interface PitchDiscoveryProps {
  onBack: () => void;
  onBook?: () => void;
}

// --- HELPERS ---

const getGrade = (score: number): string => {
  if (score >= 95) return 'A+';
  if (score >= 90) return 'A';
  if (score >= 85) return 'A-';
  if (score >= 80) return 'B+';
  if (score >= 75) return 'B';
  if (score >= 70) return 'B-';
  if (score >= 60) return 'C+';
  if (score >= 50) return 'C';
  return 'D';
};

const getGradeColor = (grade: string): string => {
  if (grade.startsWith('A')) return 'text-emerald-400';
  if (grade.startsWith('B')) return 'text-yellow-400';
  if (grade.startsWith('C')) return 'text-orange-400';
  return 'text-red-400';
};

// --- COMPONENTS ---

const GradeBadge: React.FC<{ label: string; score: number; icon: any }> = ({ label, score, icon: Icon }) => {
  const grade = getGrade(score);
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
      <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-white/5 flex items-center justify-center text-gray-400 mb-1">
        <Icon size={18} />
      </div>
      <span className="text-[8px] font-black text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-tighter">{label}</span>
      <span className={`text-sm font-black ${getGradeColor(grade)}`}>{grade}</span>
    </div>
  );
};

const PitchCard: React.FC<{ pitch: Pitch; onClick: (pitch: Pitch) => void }> = ({ pitch, onClick }) => {
  const [isFavorite, setIsFavorite] = useState(false);

  return (
    <motion.div
      layout
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      className="flex flex-col gap-3 mb-8 cursor-pointer group"
      onClick={() => onClick(pitch)}
    >
      {/* Image Container */}
      <div className="relative w-full aspect-[4/3] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-lg border border-white/5">
        <img
          src={pitch.image}
          className="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-105"
          alt={pitch.name}
        />
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/10 group-hover:bg-transparent transition-colors"></div>
        
        {/* Favorite Button */}
        <button 
          onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setIsFavorite(!isFavorite); }}
          className="absolute top-3 right-3 p-2 rounded-full hover:scale-110 transition-transform z-10"
        >
          <Heart 
            size={24} 
            className={isFavorite ? 'fill-[#FF385C] text-[#FF385C]' : 'fill-black/30 text-white'} 
            strokeWidth={1.5}
          />
        </button>

        {/* Optional Badge */}
        {pitch.occupancy > 80 && (
          <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 px-2 py-1 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md text-black text-[10px] font-bold rounded-lg shadow-sm tracking-wide uppercase">
            Popüler
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Info Container */}
      <div className="flex flex-col px-1">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-start">
          <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-white truncate pr-4">{pitch.name}</h3>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0 pt-0.5">
            <Star size={13} className="fill-white text-white" />
            <span className="text-sm text-white font-medium">{pitch.rating}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p className="text-[14px] text-gray-400 mt-0.5">{pitch.district} • {pitch.distance}</p>
        <div className="mt-1 flex items-baseline gap-1">
          <span className="text-[15px] font-bold text-white tracking-tight">{pitch.totalPrice} ₺</span>
          <span className="text-[14px] text-gray-400">/ saat</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
};

const PitchDiscovery: React.FC<PitchDiscoveryProps> = ({ onBack, onBook }) => {
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<'LIST' | 'MAP'>('LIST');
  const [showFilters, setShowFilters] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [selectedPitch, setSelectedPitch] = useState<Pitch | null>(null);
  const [isDetailOpen, setIsDetailOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedCourtId, setSelectedCourtId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [expandedCourtId, setExpandedCourtId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedSlot, setSelectedSlot] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState(0); // 0 = Today

  // Quick Rent States
  const [quickRentCourt, setQuickRentCourt] = useState<Court | null>(null);
  const [isProcessingPayment, setIsProcessingPayment] = useState(false);
  const [paymentSuccess, setPaymentSuccess] = useState(false);

  // Filters
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({
    district: 'Tümü',
    minRating: 0,
    maxPrice: 4000,
    hasAmenities: [] as string[],
    type: 'Tümü',
    availability: 'Tümü'
  });
  const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState<'DEFAULT' | 'PRICE_ASC'>('DEFAULT');

  const handleOpenDetail = (pitch: Pitch) => {
    setSelectedPitch(pitch);
    setIsDetailOpen(true);
    setSelectedCourtId(pitch.courts?.[0]?.id || null);
    setExpandedCourtId(null);
    setSelectedSlot(null);
  };

  const selectedCourt = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedPitch || !selectedCourtId) return null;
    return selectedPitch.courts?.find(c => c.id === selectedCourtId) || null;
  }, [selectedPitch, selectedCourtId]);

  const handleQuickRentSubmit = () => {
    setIsProcessingPayment(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setIsProcessingPayment(false);
      setPaymentSuccess(true);
      if (selectedPitch && quickRentCourt) {
        useAppStore.getState().addUserNotification({
          id: `rent-${Date.now()}`,
          title: 'Saha Kiralandı!',
          desc: `${selectedPitch.name} tesisinde ${quickRentCourt.name} rezervasyonu onaylandı.`,
          time: 'Şimdi',
          type: 'success',
          iconName: 'CheckCircle',
          color: 'bg-[#39FF14]',
          textColor: 'text-[#39FF14]'
        });
      }
      setTimeout(() => {
        setPaymentSuccess(false);
        setQuickRentCourt(null);
        setIsDetailOpen(false);
      }, 2000);
    }, 1500);
  };

  const calculateTotal = () => {
    if (!selectedCourt) return selectedPitch?.totalPrice || 0;
    return selectedCourt.price;
  };

  const { adminPitches, addUserNotification } = useAppStore();
  const districts = useMemo(() => ['Tümü', ...Array.from(new Set(adminPitches.map(p => p.district)))], [adminPitches]);

  const filteredPitches = useMemo(() => {
    let result = adminPitches.filter(p => {
      const matchesSearch = p.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
        p.district.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
      const matchesDistrict = filters.district === 'Tümü' || p.district === filters.district;
      const matchesRating = p.rating >= filters.minRating;
      const matchesPrice = p.totalPrice <= filters.maxPrice;

      let matchesType = true;
      if (filters.type === 'Kapalı') {
        matchesType = p.courts?.some(c => c.type === 'CLOSED') || false;
      } else if (filters.type === 'Açık') {
        matchesType = p.courts?.some(c => c.type === 'OPEN') || false;
      }

      let matchesAvailability = true;
      if (filters.availability === 'Şu an Boş') {
        matchesAvailability = p.occupancy < 80;
      }

      return matchesSearch && matchesDistrict && matchesRating && matchesPrice && matchesType && matchesAvailability;
    });

    if (sortOrder === 'PRICE_ASC') {
      result.sort((a, b) => a.totalPrice - b.totalPrice);
    }

    return result;
  }, [searchQuery, filters, sortOrder]);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#0A0E14] text-white flex flex-col font-sans overflow-hidden">

      {/* Header Section */}
      <header className="px-6 pt-8 pb-4 space-y-6 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#0A0E14] to-transparent sticky top-0 z-40 backdrop-blur-md">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <button
            onClick={onBack}
            className="w-12 h-12 flex items-center justify-center bg-[#161B22] border border-white/5 rounded-full text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition-all"
          >
            <ArrowLeft size={24} />
          </button>

          {/* View Toggle */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-[#161B22] p-1 rounded-2xl border border-white/5 shadow-inner">
            <button
              onClick={() => setViewMode('LIST')}
              className={`px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-[10px] font-black transition-all flex items-center gap-2 ${viewMode === 'LIST' ? 'bg-[#FFFF00] text-black shadow-lg shadow-yellow-900/20' : 'text-gray-500'}`}
            >
              <LayoutGrid size={14} /> LİSTE
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setViewMode('MAP')}
              className={`px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-[10px] font-black transition-all flex items-center gap-2 ${viewMode === 'MAP' ? 'bg-[#FFFF00] text-black shadow-lg shadow-yellow-900/20' : 'text-gray-500'}`}
            >
              <MapIcon size={14} /> HARİTA
            </button>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={() => setShowFilters(true)}
            className={`w-12 h-12 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full transition-all ${showFilters ? 'bg-[#FFFF00] text-black' : 'bg-[#161B22] border border-white/5 text-white'}`}
          >
            <Filter size={24} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Search Bar */}
        <div className="relative group">
          <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-5 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-gray-500 group-focus-within:text-[#FFFF00] transition-colors">
            <Search size={20} />
          </div>
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Saha veya bölge ara..."
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full h-16 bg-[#161B22] border border-white/5 rounded-[24px] pl-14 pr-6 text-sm font-bold outline-none focus:border-[#FFFF00]/50 focus:bg-[#1C232B] transition-all shadow-inner"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Quick Filters */}
        <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto custom-scrollbar pb-2 mt-4 -mx-6 px-6">
          <button
            onClick={() => setFilters({ ...filters, type: filters.type === 'Kapalı' ? 'Tümü' : 'Kapalı' })}
            className={`shrink-0 px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase transition-all border ${filters.type === 'Kapalı' ? 'bg-[#FFFF00] text-black border-[#FFFF00]' : 'bg-[#161B22] text-gray-400 border-white/5'}`}
          >
            Kapalı Saha
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setFilters({ ...filters, type: filters.type === 'Açık' ? 'Tümü' : 'Açık' })}
            className={`shrink-0 px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase transition-all border ${filters.type === 'Açık' ? 'bg-[#FFFF00] text-black border-[#FFFF00]' : 'bg-[#161B22] text-gray-400 border-white/5'}`}
          >
            Açık Saha
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setFilters({ ...filters, availability: filters.availability === 'Şu an Boş' ? 'Tümü' : 'Şu an Boş' })}
            className={`shrink-0 px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase transition-all border ${filters.availability === 'Şu an Boş' ? 'bg-[#FFFF00] text-black border-[#FFFF00]' : 'bg-[#161B22] text-gray-400 border-white/5'}`}
          >
            Şu an Boş
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setSortOrder(sortOrder === 'PRICE_ASC' ? 'DEFAULT' : 'PRICE_ASC')}
            className={`shrink-0 px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase transition-all border ${sortOrder === 'PRICE_ASC' ? 'bg-[#FFFF00] text-black border-[#FFFF00]' : 'bg-[#161B22] text-gray-400 border-white/5'}`}
          >
            Ucuzdan Pahalıya
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* Main Content */}
      <main className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-6 pb-32 custom-scrollbar">
        {viewMode === 'LIST' ? (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-6 px-2">
              <h2 className="text-xs font-black text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-[0.2em]">
                {filteredPitches.length} TESİS BULUNDU
              </h2>
              {filters.district !== 'Tümü' && (
                <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-[#FFFF00] bg-[#FFFF00]/10 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg">
                  {filters.district}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
              {filteredPitches.map((pitch) => (
                <PitchCard key={pitch.id} pitch={pitch} onClick={() => handleOpenDetail(pitch)} />
              ))}
            </AnimatePresence>

            {filteredPitches.length === 0 && (
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 text-center">
                <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-[#161B22] rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-4 border border-white/5">
                  <Search size={32} className="text-gray-600" />
                </div>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-black italic text-white">SONUÇ BULUNAMADI</h3>
                <p className="text-gray-500 text-xs mt-2">Filtreleri temizleyip tekrar dene.</p>
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    setFilters({ district: 'Tümü', minRating: 0, maxPrice: 4000, hasAmenities: [] });
                    setSearchQuery('');
                  }}
                  className="mt-6 text-[#FFFF00] text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest underline"
                >
                  FİLTRELERİ SIFIRLA
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="w-full h-[calc(100vh-280px)] relative rounded-[40px] overflow-hidden border border-white/5 shadow-2xl">
            <MapViewComponent pitches={filteredPitches} selectedPitch={selectedPitch} onPitchSelect={(p) => { setSelectedPitch(p); setIsDetailOpen(true); }} />
          </div>
        )}
      </main>

      {/* Filter Modal */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {showFilters && (
          <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-end justify-center">
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
              onClick={() => setShowFilters(false)}
              className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm"
            />
            <motion.div
              initial={{ y: '100%' }}
              animate={{ y: 0 }}
              exit={{ y: '100%' }}
              transition={{ type: 'spring', damping: 25, stiffness: 200 }}
              className="relative w-full max-w-md bg-[#161B22] border-t border-white/10 rounded-t-[40px] p-8 shadow-2xl"
            >
              <div className="w-12 h-1.5 bg-gray-800 rounded-full mx-auto mb-8"></div>

              <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-8">
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-white italic tracking-tighter uppercase">FİLTRELE</h2>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setShowFilters(false)}
                  className="w-10 h-10 bg-[#0A0E14] rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-gray-400"
                >
                  <X size={20} />
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-8">
                {/* District Filter */}
                <div>
                  <p className="text-[10px] font-black text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-widest mb-4">BÖLGE SEÇİMİ</p>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    {districts.map(d => (
                      <button
                        key={d}
                        onClick={() => setFilters({ ...filters, district: d })}
                        className={`px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-[10px] font-black transition-all border ${filters.district === d ? 'bg-[#FFFF00] text-black border-[#FFFF00]' : 'bg-[#0A0E14] text-gray-400 border-white/5'}`}
                      >
                        {d.toUpperCase()}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Price Filter */}
                <div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
                    <p className="text-[10px] font-black text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-widest">MAKSİMUM FİYAT</p>
                    <span className="text-sm font-black text-[#FFFF00]">{filters.maxPrice}₺</span>
                  </div>
                  <input
                    type="range"
                    min="2800"
                    max="4000"
                    step="100"
                    value={filters.maxPrice}
                    onChange={(e) => setFilters({ ...filters, maxPrice: parseInt(e.target.value) })}
                    className="w-full h-2 bg-[#0A0E14] rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer accent-[#FFFF00]"
                  />
                </div>

                {/* Rating Filter */}
                <div>
                  <p className="text-[10px] font-black text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-widest mb-4">MİNİMUM PUAN</p>
                  <div className="flex gap-2">
                    {[0, 3.5, 4.0, 4.5].map(r => (
                      <button
                        key={r}
                        onClick={() => setFilters({ ...filters, minRating: r })}
                        className={`flex-1 py-3 rounded-xl text-[10px] font-black transition-all border flex items-center justify-center gap-1 ${filters.minRating === r ? 'bg-[#FFFF00] text-black border-[#FFFF00]' : 'bg-[#0A0E14] text-gray-400 border-white/5'}`}
                      >
                        {r === 0 ? 'HEPSİ' : <><Star size={10} fill="currentColor" /> {r}+</>}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={() => setShowFilters(false)}
                  className="w-full h-16 bg-[#FFFF00] text-black rounded-2xl font-black text-sm tracking-widest uppercase shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(255,255,0,0.2)]"
                >
                  UYGULA
                </button>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          </div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {/* Detail Overlay */}
      <AnimatePresence>

                    <div className="h-px w-full bg-white/10 mb-6" />

                        <p className="text-[10px] font-black text-[#39FF14] tracking-widest uppercase mb-1">TAMAMI ÖDENECEK</p>
                        <p className="text-3xl font-black text-white">{quickRentCourt.price}₺</p>
                      </div>
                      <CreditCard size={32} className="text-[#39FF14]" />
                    </div>

                    <Shield size={16} className="text-green-500" />
                    <p>Güvenli ödeme altyapısı. Tutarın tamamı tahsil edilecektir.</p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <motion.button 
                  disabled={isProcessingPayment} 
                  whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }} 
                  onClick={handleQuickRentSubmit}
                  className={`w-full h-16 font-black text-base rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center gap-3 transition-colors shadow-2xl ${isProcessingPayment ? 'bg-gray-800 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed' : 'bg-[#39FF14] text-black shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(57,255,20,0.3)] hover:bg-[#32E612]'}`}

                  {isProcessingPayment ? <Activity className="animate-spin" size={24} /> : <><CheckCircle size={20} /> ONAYLA VE ÖDE</>}
                </motion.button>
              </div>
            ) : (
                <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center px-4 -mt-10">
                  <motion.div
                    initial={{ scale: 0 }}
                    animate={{ scale: 1 }}

                    className="w-32 h-32 bg-[#39FF14]/10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-8 relative"
                  >
                    <motion.div
                      animate={{ scale: [1, 1.2, 1] }}
                      transition={{ duration: 2, repeat: Infinity }}
                      className="absolute inset-0 bg-[#39FF14]/20 rounded-full blur-2xl"
                    />
                    <Check size={64} className="text-[#39FF14] relative z-10" />
                  </motion.div>

                  <motion.h2
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                    transition={{ delay: 0.2 }}

                  >
                    ŞİMDİ<br/>OYNAMA VAKTİ!
                  </motion.h2>

                    initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
                    transition={{ delay: 0.4 }}
                    className="text-gray-400 font-medium max-w-xs"
                  >
                    Ödemeniz başarıyla alındı. Rezervasyonunuz onaylandı.
                  </motion.p>
                </div>
            )}
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

    </div>
  );
};

export default PitchDiscovery;

import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { MatchListing, PositionSlot } from '../types';

interface MatchJoinProps {
  match: MatchListing | null;
  onBack: () => void;
  onJoin: () => void;
}

// Mock player data — hasCard: true = FIFA-style card popup, false = simple profile popup
interface MockPlayer {
  name: string; avatar: string; rating: number; position: string;
  pace: number; shoot: number; pass: number; def: number; phys: number;
  style: string; hasCard: boolean;
}
const mockPlayers: Record<string, MockPlayer> = {

  'p2': { name: 'Ahmet Karahan', avatar: 'https://api.dicebear.com/7.x/avataaars/svg?seed=Ahmet', rating: 78, position: 'CM', pace: 75, shoot: 70, pass: 82, def: 68, phys: 72, style: 'BÜYÜCÜ', hasCard: true },
  'p3': { name: 'Mert Şahin', avatar: 'https://api.dicebear.com/7.x/avataaars/svg?seed=Mert', rating: 80, position: 'CB', pace: 72, shoot: 55, pass: 71, def: 85, phys: 80, style: 'SAVAŞÇI', hasCard: false },
  'p4': { name: 'Burak Doğan', avatar: 'https://api.dicebear.com/7.x/avataaars/svg?seed=Burak', rating: 75, position: 'GK', pace: 60, shoot: 40, pass: 65, def: 80, phys: 74, style: 'DUVAR', hasCard: false },
  'p5': { name: 'Can Öztürk', avatar: 'https://api.dicebear.com/7.x/avataaars/svg?seed=Can', rating: 81, position: 'LW', pace: 90, shoot: 76, pass: 78, def: 52, phys: 70, style: 'KRAL', hasCard: true },

};

// Assign mock players to slots based on index
const slotPlayerMap: Record<number, string> = { 0: 'p1', 1: 'p2', 2: 'p3', 3: 'p4', 4: 'p5', 5: 'p6' };

const MatchJoin: React.FC<MatchJoinProps> = ({ match, onBack, onJoin }) => {
  const [selectedSlotId, setSelectedSlotId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [hireModalType, setHireModalType] = useState<'GK' | 'REF' | null>(null);
  const [hiringState, setHiringState] = useState<{ gk: 'IDLE' | 'BROADCASTING'; ref: 'IDLE' | 'BROADCASTING' }>({ gk: 'IDLE', ref: 'IDLE' });
  const [budget, setBudget] = useState(100);
  const [activePlayerSlot, setActivePlayerSlot] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (!match) return null;

  // Enrich slots with mock player data based on TAKEN status
  const enrichedSlots = match.slots.map((slot, idx) => ({
    ...slot,
    mockPlayer: slot.status === 'TAKEN' ? mockPlayers[slotPlayerMap[idx] || 'p1'] : null,
  }));

  const handleSlotClick = (slot: typeof enrichedSlots[0]) => {
    if (slot.status === 'TAKEN' && slot.mockPlayer) {
      setActivePlayerSlot(activePlayerSlot === slot.id ? null : slot.id);
      return;
    }
    if (slot.status === 'OPEN') setSelectedSlotId(slot.id === selectedSlotId ? null : slot.id);
  };

  const handleJoin = () => {
    setIsProcessing(true);
    setTimeout(() => { setIsProcessing(false); onJoin(); }, 1500);
  };

  const submitHire = () => {
    if (hireModalType === 'GK') setHiringState(p => ({ ...p, gk: 'BROADCASTING' }));
    else setHiringState(p => ({ ...p, ref: 'BROADCASTING' }));
    setHireModalType(null);
  };

  const activePlayer = activePlayerSlot
    ? enrichedSlots.find(s => s.id === activePlayerSlot)?.mockPlayer ?? null
    : null;

      {/* Ambient glow */}
      <div className="absolute top-20 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-72 h-72 bg-[#39FF14]/5 blur-[100px] rounded-full pointer-events-none" />

      {/* Hire Modal */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {hireModalType && (
          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }}

                  {/* Stats grid */}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 p-5">
                    {[['HIZ', activePlayer.pace], ['GOL', activePlayer.shoot], ['PAS', activePlayer.pass], ['DEF', activePlayer.def], ['FİZ', activePlayer.phys], ['TOP', Math.round((activePlayer.pace + activePlayer.shoot) / 2)]].map(([label, val]) => (
                      <div key={label as string} className="bg-white/5 rounded-xl p-2.5 text-center border border-white/5">
                        <div className="text-lg font-black text-white leading-none">{val}</div>
                        <div className="text-[8px] text-[#39FF14] font-black tracking-widest uppercase mt-0.5">{label}</div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  {/* Footer */}
                  <div className="px-5 pb-5">
                    <div className="bg-[#39FF14]/10 border border-[#39FF14]/20 rounded-2xl px-4 py-2.5 text-center">
                      <p className="text-[9px] text-[#39FF14] font-black uppercase tracking-widest">⚡ Oyuncu Kartı Mevcut</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                /* ── SIMPLE PROFILE CARD (no card data) ── */
                <div className="bg-[#0D1117] border border-white/10">
                  <div className="h-1.5 w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-white/20 to-white/5" />
                  <div className="p-6 flex flex-col items-center text-center">
                    <div className="relative mb-4">
                      <img src={activePlayer.avatar} className="w-24 h-24 rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-[#161B22] shadow-[0_8px_25px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]" alt={activePlayer.name} />
                      <div className="absolute -bottom-2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-[#161B22] border border-white/10 px-3 py-1 rounded-full">
                        <span className="text-[9px] font-black text-white uppercase tracking-widest">{activePlayer.position}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <h3 className="text-lg font-black text-white uppercase tracking-tight mt-2">{activePlayer.name}</h3>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-medium mt-1">{activePlayer.style} • {activePlayer.rating} Puan</p>
                    <div className="mt-4 w-full bg-white/5 border border-white/5 rounded-2xl px-4 py-2.5">
                      <p className="text-[9px] text-gray-600 font-bold uppercase tracking-widest">Bu oyuncunun kartı henüz yok</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
              <button onClick={() => setActivePlayerSlot(null)}
                className="absolute top-4 right-4 w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center text-gray-400 hover:text-white border border-white/10 transition-colors">
                <X size={13} />
              </button>
            </motion.div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {/* Header */}
      <header className="p-5 flex items-center gap-4 sticky top-0 bg-[#080C10]/90 backdrop-blur-2xl z-20 border-b border-white/5">
        <button onClick={onBack} className="w-10 h-10 flex items-center justify-center bg-white/5 rounded-full text-white border border-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 active:scale-95 transition-all">
          <ArrowLeft size={18} />
        </button>
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-lg font-black text-white italic uppercase tracking-tight leading-none">Kadroya Gir</h1>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 mt-0.5">{match.title}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#39FF14]/10 border border-[#39FF14]/20 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full">
          <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#39FF14] animate-pulse" />
          <span className="text-[9px] font-black text-[#39FF14] uppercase tracking-widest">{match.difficulty}</span>
        </div>
      </header>

      <main className="flex-1 px-5 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar pb-44 space-y-6 pt-5">

        {/* PITCH */}
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-black text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-widest">Pozisyonunu Seç</p>
            {selectedSlotId && (
              <motion.span initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
                className="text-[9px] font-black text-[#39FF14] uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <CheckCircle2 size={10} /> Slot seçildi
              </motion.span>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Pitch Container */}
          <div className="relative w-full max-w-sm mx-auto rounded-[28px] overflow-hidden shadow-[0_20px_60px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)] border border-white/5"
            style={{ aspectRatio: '2/3' }}>
            {/* Grass base */}
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#0d3320] via-[#0f3d25] to-[#0d3320]" />
            {/* Grass stripes */}
            <div className="absolute inset-0 opacity-20" style={{
              backgroundImage: 'repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent, transparent 8%, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 8%, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 16%)'
            }} />
            {/* Ambient field glow center */}
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-radial-gradient pointer-events-none" style={{
              background: 'radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%, rgba(57,255,20,0.08) 0%, transparent 70%)'
            }} />

            {/* SVG Pitch Lines */}
            <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none opacity-50">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 680 1050" preserveAspectRatio="none" className="w-full h-full" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                <g stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.8)" strokeWidth="5" fill="none" strokeLinecap="round">
                  <rect x="20" y="20" width="640" height="1010" />
                  <line x1="20" y1="525" x2="660" y2="525" />
                  <circle cx="340" cy="525" r="90" />
                  <circle cx="340" cy="525" r="5" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.8)" />
                  <rect x="140" y="20" width="400" height="150" />
                  <rect x="240" y="20" width="200" height="55" />
                  <circle cx="340" cy="120" r="5" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.8)" />
                  <path d="M 270 170 A 90 90 0 0 0 410 170" />
                  <rect x="140" y="880" width="400" height="150" />
                  <rect x="240" y="978" width="200" height="52" />
                  <circle cx="340" cy="930" r="5" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.8)" />
                  <path d="M 270 880 A 90 90 0 0 1 410 880" />
                  <path d="M 20 60 A 40 40 0 0 0 60 20" /><path d="M 620 20 A 40 40 0 0 0 660 60" />
                  <path d="M 20 990 A 40 40 0 0 1 60 1030" /><path d="M 660 1030 A 40 40 0 0 0 620 990" />
                  {/* Goals */}
                  <rect x="280" y="5" width="120" height="20" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.5)" />
                  <rect x="280" y="1025" width="120" height="20" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.5)" />
                </g>
              </svg>
            </div>

            {/* Player Slots */}
            {enrichedSlots.map(slot => {
              const isSelected = selectedSlotId === slot.id;
              const isOpen = slot.status === 'OPEN';
              const isTaken = slot.status === 'TAKEN';
              const player = slot.mockPlayer;

              return (
                <button
                  key={slot.id}
                  onClick={() => handleSlotClick(slot)}
                  disabled={!isOpen && !isTaken}
                  className="absolute transform -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 transition-all duration-300 z-10"
                  style={{ left: `${slot.x}%`, top: `${slot.y}%` }}
                >
                  {isTaken && player ? (
                    <motion.div whileHover={{ scale: 1.15 }} whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }} className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
                      <div className={`w-11 h-11 rounded-full border-2 bg-[#161B22] overflow-hidden shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)] transition-colors ${player.hasCard ? 'border-[#39FF14]/60 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(57,255,20,0.4)]' : 'border-white/20'}`}>
                        <img src={player.avatar} className="w-full h-full object-cover" alt={player.name} />
                      </div>

                      )}
                    </motion.div>
                  ) : isOpen ? (
                    <motion.div
                      whileHover={{ scale: 1.2 }}
                      whileTap={{ scale: 0.9 }}

                    </motion.div>
                  ) : (

                      <X size={12} className="text-gray-600" />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
          <p className="text-center text-[9px] text-gray-600 font-medium mt-3 uppercase tracking-widest">Dolu slotlara tıklayarak oyuncuyu görüntüle</p>
        </div>

        {/* PRO DESTEK */}
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-black text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-widest">Profesyonel Destek</p>
          {/* GK */}
          <button onClick={() => { setHiringState(p => ({ ...p, gk: 'IDLE' })); setHireModalType('GK'); }}
            disabled={hiringState.gk === 'BROADCASTING'}
            className={`w-full p-4 rounded-2xl flex items-center gap-4 transition-all border ${hiringState.gk === 'BROADCASTING'
              ? 'bg-[#39FF14]/5 border-[#39FF14]/30'
              : 'bg-white/5 border-white/5 hover:border-[#39FF14]/30 hover:bg-[#39FF14]/5'}`}>
            {hiringState.gk === 'BROADCASTING' && <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[#39FF14]/5 animate-pulse rounded-2xl" />}
            <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl shrink-0 ${hiringState.gk === 'BROADCASTING' ? 'bg-[#39FF14]/20 text-[#39FF14]' : 'bg-[#39FF14]/10 text-[#39FF14]'}`}>
              {hiringState.gk === 'BROADCASTING' ? <Loader2 size={18} className="animate-spin" /> : <Hand size={18} />}
            </div>
            <div className="text-left flex-1">
              <h4 className={`font-black text-sm ${hiringState.gk === 'BROADCASTING' ? 'text-[#39FF14]' : 'text-white'}`}>
                {hiringState.gk === 'BROADCASTING' ? 'Teklif Yayında ⚡' : 'Profesyonel Kaleci Davet'}
              </h4>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500">{hiringState.gk === 'BROADCASTING' ? '3 kaleci teklifini inceliyor...' : '12 aktif kaleci bölgede'}</p>
            </div>
            {hiringState.gk === 'IDLE' && <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#39FF14] animate-pulse shrink-0" />}
          </button>

          {/* REF */}
          <button onClick={() => hiringState.ref !== 'BROADCASTING' && setHireModalType('REF')}
            className={`w-full p-4 rounded-2xl flex items-center gap-4 transition-all border ${hiringState.ref === 'BROADCASTING'
              ? 'bg-[#FFFF00]/5 border-[#FFFF00]/30'
              : 'bg-white/5 border-white/5 hover:border-[#FFFF00]/30 hover:bg-[#FFFF00]/5'}`}>
            <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl shrink-0 ${hiringState.ref === 'BROADCASTING' ? 'bg-[#FFFF00]/20 text-[#FFFF00]' : 'bg-white/5 text-gray-400'}`}>
              {hiringState.ref === 'BROADCASTING' ? <Loader2 size={18} className="animate-spin" /> : <Scale size={18} />}
            </div>
            <div className="text-left flex-1">
              <h4 className={`font-black text-sm ${hiringState.ref === 'BROADCASTING' ? 'text-[#FFFF00]' : 'text-white'}`}>
                {hiringState.ref === 'BROADCASTING' ? 'Hakem Aranıyor ⚡' : 'Resmi Hakem Talebi'}
              </h4>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500">{hiringState.ref === 'BROADCASTING' ? 'Bölgesel hakemlere iletildi' : 'Lisanslı hakem, adil maç'}</p>
            </div>
            {hiringState.ref === 'IDLE' && (
              <span className="text-[9px] font-black text-[#FFFF00] bg-[#FFFF00]/10 border border-[#FFFF00]/20 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg shrink-0">LİSANSLI</span>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Match Info */}
        <div className="bg-white/5 rounded-[24px] border border-white/5 overflow-hidden">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4 p-4 border-b border-white/5">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 bg-blue-500/10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center text-blue-400 shrink-0"><MapPin size={18} /></div>

            <div>
              <h4 className="font-black text-white text-sm">{match.time}</h4>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 mt-0.5">{match.date} • 60 Dakika</p>
            </div>
          </div>

        <div className="flex gap-3 p-4 bg-blue-500/5 border border-blue-500/15 rounded-2xl">
          <ShieldCheck className="text-blue-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" size={16} />
          <p className="text-[10px] text-blue-300/70 leading-relaxed">
            Maça katıldığında <span className="font-bold text-white">Oyuncu Kuralları</span>'nı kabul etmiş sayılırsın. Maç saatinden 2 saat öncesine kadar ücretsiz iptal edebilirsin.
          </p>
        </div>
      </main>

      {/* Footer CTA */}
      <div className="fixed bottom-0 left-0 w-full bg-[#080C10]/95 backdrop-blur-2xl border-t border-white/5 px-5 pt-4 pb-8 z-30">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
          <div>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-widest">Kişi Başı</p>
            <p className="text-2xl font-black text-white leading-none">{match.price}₺</p>
          </div>
          {selectedSlotId && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#39FF14]/10 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full border border-[#39FF14]/20">
              <CheckCircle2 size={12} className="text-[#39FF14]" />
              <span className="text-[9px] font-black text-[#39FF14] uppercase tracking-widest">Slot Hazır</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <button
          disabled={!selectedSlotId || isProcessing}
          onClick={handleJoin}
          className={`relative overflow-hidden group w-full h-16 rounded-2xl font-black text-base flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all duration-300 uppercase tracking-widest ${selectedSlotId
            ? 'text-black shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(57,255,20,0.8),0_12px_40px_rgba(57,255,20,0.5)] hover:shadow-[0_0_60px_rgba(57,255,20,1),0_16px_50px_rgba(57,255,20,0.7)] active:scale-[0.98]'
            : 'bg-white/5 text-gray-600 cursor-not-allowed border border-white/5'}`}
          style={selectedSlotId ? { background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #FFFF00 0%, #39FF14 50%, #00ff88 100%)' } : {}}
        >
          {selectedSlotId && !isProcessing && (
            <>
              {/* Shimmer */}
              <div className="absolute inset-0 -translate-x-full group-hover:translate-x-full transition-transform duration-700 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/40 to-transparent skew-x-12" />
              {/* Breathing inner glow */}
              <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-2xl opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300" style={{ boxShadow: 'inset 0 0 30px rgba(255,255,255,0.2)' }} />
            </>
          )}
          <span className="relative z-10 font-black tracking-[0.15em]">
            {isProcessing ? 'ONAYLANIYOR...' : selectedSlotId ? 'KADROYA GİR' : 'ÖNCE POZİSYON SEÇ'}
          </span>
          {selectedSlotId && !isProcessing && <ChevronRight size={18} className="relative z-10" />}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default MatchJoin;

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { ArrowLeft, Bot, Send, Sparkles, Trophy, ShieldAlert, Zap } from 'lucide-react';
import { ChatMessage, Team } from '../types';
import { MY_TEAM } from '../constants';

interface AICoachProps {
  onBack: () => void;
}

const AICoach: React.FC<AICoachProps> = ({ onBack }) => {
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([
    {
      id: '1',
      sender: 'AI',
      text: `Merhaba Kaptan! **${MY_TEAM.name}** için analizlerim hazır. Kadronuzda belirgin bir **${MY_TEAM.playStyle}** yapısı görüyorum. Bugün nasıl yardımcı olabilirim?`,
      timestamp: 'Simdi'
    }
  ]);
  const [isTyping, setIsTyping] = useState(false);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (scrollRef.current) {
      scrollRef.current.scrollTop = scrollRef.current.scrollHeight;
    }
  }, [messages, isTyping]);

  const handleQuickAction = (action: 'TACTIC' | 'MOTIVATION' | 'WEAKNESS') => {
    let userText = '';
    let aiResponse = '';

    switch (action) {
      case 'TACTIC':
        userText = 'Bize uygun bir taktik öner.';
        aiResponse = `Kadronuzda **Büyücü (Can)** ve **Kral (Burak)** rolleri çok baskın. \n\nÖnerdiğim Diziliş: **2-3-1**\n\n1. **Defans:** Kaya ve Ali (Savaşçılar) geride çakılı kalmalı.\n2. **Orta Saha:** Mert ve Emre kanatlardan içeri kat etmeli, Can (Büyücü) pas dağıtımını üstlenmeli.\n3. **Hücum:** Burak (Kral) bitirici vuruşlar için ceza sahasında beklemeli.\n\n*Hızlı paslarla rakibi yorun, Büyücü'nün yaratıcılığını kullanın.*`;
        break;
      case 'MOTIVATION':
        userText = 'Maç öncesi motivasyon konuşması yap.';
        aiResponse = `Dinleyin Kara Kartallar! Bugün sahaya sadece kazanmak için değil, kim olduğumuzu göstermek için çıkıyoruz.\n\nSizin farkınız tutkunuz. Burak, liderliğini konuştur. Kaya, duvar ol. Mert, rüzgar gibi es.\n\n**Kaybetmek bir seçenek değil, sadece bir ders olabilir. Ama bugün ders alma günü değil, ders verme günü!**`;
        break;
      case 'WEAKNESS':
        userText = 'Zayıf yönlerimiz neler?';
        aiResponse = `Analizlerime göre:\n\n1. **Defansif Derinlik:** Savaşçılarınız yorulursa yedek defans oyuncunuz yok.\n2. **Geri Dönüşler:** Aşık rolündeki oyuncularınız (Mert, Emre) hücuma çok çıkıyor, kontratak yiyebilirsiniz.\n\n*Çözüm: Can (Büyücü) top rakipteyken daha defansif pozisyon almalı.*`;
        break;
    }

    // Add User Message
    const userMsg: ChatMessage = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      sender: 'USER',
      text: userText,
      timestamp: 'Simdi'
    };
    setMessages(prev => [...prev, userMsg]);
    setIsTyping(true);

    // Simulate AI Delay
    setTimeout(() => {
      setIsTyping(false);
      const aiMsg: ChatMessage = {
        id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),
        sender: 'AI',
        text: aiResponse,
        timestamp: 'Simdi'
      };
      setMessages(prev => [...prev, aiMsg]);
    }, 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="h-screen flex flex-col bg-[#0A0E14]">
      {/* Header */}
      <header className="p-4 bg-[#161B22] border-b border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between sticky top-0 z-10">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button onClick={onBack} className="p-2 rounded-full hover:bg-white/5 text-gray-400">
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
          </button>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
             <div className="w-10 h-10 bg-gradient-to-tr from-indigo-500 to-purple-500 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/30">
                <Bot size={20} className="text-white" />
             </div>
             <div>
               <h1 className="font-bold text-white text-sm">AI Takım Koçu</h1>
               <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                 <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-green-500 rounded-full animate-pulse"></span>
                 <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">Gemini Powered</span>
               </div>
             </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button className="text-gray-500">
            <Sparkles size={20} />
        </button>
      </header>

      {/* Chat Area */}
      <div ref={scrollRef} className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-6 custom-scrollbar">
        <div className="text-center py-4">
           <span className="text-[10px] bg-white/5 text-gray-500 px-3 py-1 rounded-full">Bugün, 14:30</span>
        </div>

        {messages.map((msg) => (
          <div key={msg.id} className={`flex ${msg.sender === 'USER' ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'}`}>
             <div className={`max-w-[85%] rounded-2xl p-4 ${
               msg.sender === 'USER' 
                 ? 'bg-[#FFFF00] text-black rounded-tr-none' 
                 : 'bg-[#161B22] text-gray-200 border border-white/5 rounded-tl-none'
             }`}>
                {msg.sender === 'AI' && (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2 text-indigo-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest">
                        <Bot size={12} /> Koç Analizi
                    </div>
                )}
                <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line">
                    {/* Simple parser for bold text in simulation */}
                    {msg.text.split('**').map((part, i) => 
                        i % 2 === 1 ? <span key={i} className="font-black">{part}</span> : part
                    )}
                </p>
                <p className={`text-[10px] mt-2 text-right ${msg.sender === 'USER' ? 'text-black/50' : 'text-gray-600'}`}>
                    {msg.timestamp}
                </p>
             </div>
          </div>
        ))}

        {isTyping && (
          <div className="flex justify-start">
             <div className="bg-[#161B22] border border-white/5 rounded-2xl rounded-tl-none p-4 flex gap-1">
                <div className="w-2 h-2 bg-indigo-500 rounded-full animate-bounce"></div>
                <div className="w-2 h-2 bg-indigo-500 rounded-full animate-bounce delay-100"></div>
                <div className="w-2 h-2 bg-indigo-500 rounded-full animate-bounce delay-200"></div>
             </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Quick Actions / Input */}

                >
                    <Trophy size={14} className="text-yellow-400" /> Taktik Ver
                </button>
                <button 
                  onClick={() => handleQuickAction('WEAKNESS')}
                  className="shrink-0 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 border border-white/10 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2 transition-colors"
                >
                    <ShieldAlert size={14} className="text-red-400" /> Zayıf Yönler
                </button>
                <button 
                  onClick={() => handleQuickAction('MOTIVATION')}
                  className="shrink-0 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 border border-white/10 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2 transition-colors"
                >
                    <Zap size={14} className="text-blue-400" /> Motivasyon
                </button>
             </div>
         )}

         <div className="relative">
            <input 
              type="text" 
              placeholder="Koç'a bir şey sor..." 
              className="w-full bg-[#0A0E14] text-white rounded-2xl pl-4 pr-12 py-4 border border-white/10 focus:border-[#FFFF00] outline-none text-sm transition-colors"
              disabled={isTyping}
            />
            <button className="absolute right-2 top-2 p-2 bg-[#FFFF00] text-black rounded-xl hover:bg-yellow-300 transition-colors disabled:opacity-50">
                <Send size={18} />
            </button>
         </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

  onBack: () => void;

  { id: 'p3', name: 'Emre D.',  pos: 'Defans',    initials: 'ED', color: '#EF4444' },

  { id: 'argue', label: '😤 Tartışmacıydı', positive: false },

  const [playerRatings, setPlayerRatings] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
  const [motm, setMotm] = useState<string | null>(null);

                    className="p-1">

                 </motion.div>
              )}
            </motion.button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10 p-5 bg-[#161B22]/90 backdrop-blur-xl border border-[#FFFF00]/20 rounded-3xl flex items-center gap-4 shadow-2xl">
        <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[#FFFF00] to-yellow-600 p-[2px] shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,255,0,0.3)] flex-shrink-0">
           <div className="w-full h-full bg-[#0A0E14] rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center text-3xl">⚽</div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <p className="text-base font-black text-white italic uppercase tracking-tight">{FORMATS.find(f => f.v === selected)?.label} SEÇİLDİ</p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 font-bold tracking-wide">Her takımda {parseInt(selected) || 7} oyuncu yer alacak.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }} onClick={() => onSelect(FORMATS.find(f => f.v === selected)!)}
        className="relative z-10 w-full h-16 bg-[#FFFF00] hover:bg-[#FFFF00]/90 text-black font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center gap-3 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(255,255,0,0.4)] transition-all mt-4">
        TAKIMLARI KUR <ChevronRight size={20} strokeWidth={3} />
      </motion.button>
    </motion.div>
  );
};

// ─── STEP 2: TEAMS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const TeamsStep: React.FC<{ format: typeof FORMATS[0]; onNext: (c: number) => void }> = ({ format, onNext }) => {
  const { friends, userTeams } = useAppStore();
  const perTeam = parseInt(format.v.split('v')[0]);
  const [myPlayers, setMyPlayers] = useState<{ id: string; name: string; avatar: string }[]>([]);
  const [showFriendPicker, setShowFriendPicker] = useState(false);
  const [quickName, setQuickName] = useState('');
  const [showQuickInput, setShowQuickInput] = useState(false);
  const [showTeamPicker, setShowTeamPicker] = useState(false);
  const [opponentCode] = useState(() => Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8).toUpperCase());
  const [codeCopied, setCodeCopied] = useState(false);

  const confirmedFriends = friends.filter(f => f.status === 'FRIEND');
  const slots = Array.from({ length: perTeam });

  const addFriend = (f: typeof confirmedFriends[0]) => {
    if (myPlayers.find(p => p.id === f.id) || myPlayers.length >= perTeam) return;
    setMyPlayers(prev => [...prev, { id: f.id, name: f.name, avatar: f.avatar }]);
    setShowFriendPicker(false);
  };
  const addQuick = () => {
    if (!quickName.trim() || myPlayers.length >= perTeam) return;
    setMyPlayers(prev => [...prev, { id: `q-${Date.now()}`, name: quickName.trim(), avatar: '' }]);
    setQuickName(''); setShowQuickInput(false);
  };
  const copyCode = () => {
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(opponentCode).catch(() => {});
    setCodeCopied(true); setTimeout(() => setCodeCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <motion.div key="teams" initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 40 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -40 }}
      className="flex-1 px-5 py-5 space-y-5 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
      <div>
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-white italic uppercase">Takımları Kur</h2>
        <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">Her takıma {perTeam} oyuncu • Format: {format.label}</p>
      </div>

      {/* BENİM TAKIM */}
      <div className="relative bg-[#06080A]/80 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-[24px] border border-white/10 overflow-hidden shadow-[0_10px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] group">
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br from-white/5 to-transparent pointer-events-none" />
        <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 w-full h-[1px] bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-[#FFFF00]/40 to-transparent opacity-50" />

        <div className="px-4 py-3 bg-black/40 border-b border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between relative z-10">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="w-2 h-2 bg-[#FFFF00] rounded-full shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(255,255,0,0.8)]" />
            <span className="text-xs font-black text-[#FFFF00] uppercase tracking-widest drop-shadow-md">BENİM TAKIM</span>
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-bold">{myPlayers.length}/{perTeam} Oyuncu</span>
        </div>
        
        <div className="p-3 space-y-2 relative z-10">
          {slots.map((_, i) => {
            const p = myPlayers[i];
            return (
              <div key={i} className={`relative flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-[16px] border transition-all overflow-hidden ${p ? 'border-[#FFFF00]/30 bg-[#FFFF00]/10 shadow-[inset_0_0_20px_rgba(255,255,0,0.05)]' : 'border-dashed border-white/10 bg-white/5'}`}>
                {p && <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FFFF00]/5 to-transparent pointer-events-none" />}
                {p ? (
                  <>
                    {p.avatar ? <img src={p.avatar} className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full border border-[#FFFF00]/30 shadow-md relative z-10" alt="" /> : <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-black/50 border border-[#FFFF00]/30 flex items-center justify-center text-sm relative z-10 shadow-md font-black">{p.name[0]}</div>}
                    <span className="text-sm font-black text-white flex-1 relative z-10 drop-shadow-sm tracking-tight">{p.name}</span>
                    <button onClick={() => setMyPlayers(prev => prev.filter(pl => pl.id !== p.id))} className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20 text-red-400 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-red-500/30 hover:scale-105 transition-all relative z-10"><X size={12} /></button>
                  </>
                ) : <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-black relative z-10">Oyuncu {i + 1}</span>}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        
        <div className="px-3 pb-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 relative z-10">
          <button onClick={() => { setShowTeamPicker(true); setShowFriendPicker(false); setShowQuickInput(false); }}
            className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 h-12 bg-[#161B22]/80 backdrop-blur-md text-white border border-white/10 rounded-2xl text-[11px] font-black uppercase hover:bg-white/10 hover:border-white/20 transition-all shadow-md group">
            <Users size={14} className="text-gray-400 group-hover:text-white transition-colors" /> Takımlarım
          </button>
          <button onClick={() => { setShowFriendPicker(true); setShowTeamPicker(false); setShowQuickInput(false); }}
            className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 h-12 bg-[#FFFF00]/10 backdrop-blur-md text-[#FFFF00] border border-[#FFFF00]/20 rounded-2xl text-[11px] font-black uppercase hover:bg-[#FFFF00]/20 hover:border-[#FFFF00]/40 transition-all shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,255,0,0.1)] group">
            <UserPlus size={14} className="group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform" /> Arkadaşını Ekle
          </button>
        </div>
        
        <AnimatePresence>
          {showTeamPicker && (
            <motion.div initial={{ height: 0 }} animate={{ height: 'auto' }} exit={{ height: 0 }} className="overflow-hidden relative z-10">
              <div className="border-t border-white/5 p-3 space-y-2 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar bg-black/20">
                <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-widest px-1">Kayıtlı Takımlarım</p>
                {userTeams.map(t => (
                  <button key={t.id} 
                    onClick={() => {
                      const newPlayers = t.roster.slice(0, perTeam).map(p => ({ id: p.id, name: p.name, avatar: p.avatar }));
                      setMyPlayers(newPlayers);
                      setShowTeamPicker(false);
                    }}
                    className="w-full flex items-center justify-between p-2.5 rounded-2xl border border-white/5 bg-[#161B22]/50 hover:border-[#FFFF00]/30 hover:bg-[#FFFF00]/5 transition-all group">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-black/60 border border-white/10 p-1 flex items-center justify-center group-hover:border-[#FFFF00]/30 transition-colors shadow-inner">
                        <img src={t.logo} className="w-full h-full object-contain drop-shadow-md" alt="" />
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-left">
                        <p className="text-sm font-black text-white italic tracking-tighter uppercase drop-shadow-sm">{t.name}</p>
                        <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-bold">{t.roster.length} Oyuncu</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <ChevronRight size={16} className="text-gray-500 group-hover:text-[#FFFF00] transition-colors" />
                  </button>
                ))}
                {userTeams.length === 0 && <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 text-center py-4 font-bold">Henüz kayıtlı takımın yok.</p>}
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          )}
          
          {showFriendPicker && (
            <motion.div initial={{ height: 0 }} animate={{ height: 'auto' }} exit={{ height: 0 }} className="overflow-hidden relative z-10">
              <div className="border-t border-white/5 p-4 space-y-4 bg-black/20">
                
                {/* Temporary name input integrated here */}
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <input type="text" value={quickName} onChange={e => setQuickName(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && addQuick()}
                    placeholder="..." className="flex-1 bg-[#0A0E14] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 text-sm font-black text-white outline-none focus:border-[#FFFF00]/50 shadow-inner transition-colors placeholder:text-gray-600" />
                  <button onClick={addQuick} className="px-5 bg-[#FFFF00] text-black font-black text-xs tracking-widest uppercase rounded-2xl hover:bg-yellow-300 hover:scale-105 transition-all shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,255,0,0.2)]">EKLE</button>
                </div>
                
                <div>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-widest px-1 mb-2">Arkadaşlarım</p>
                  <div className="space-y-2 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
                    {confirmedFriends.map(f => {
                      const already = myPlayers.some(p => p.id === f.id);
                      return (
                        <button key={f.id} onClick={() => addFriend(f)} disabled={already || myPlayers.length >= perTeam}
                          className={`w-full flex items-center gap-3 p-2.5 rounded-2xl border border-transparent transition-all ${already ? 'opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed bg-black/30' : 'hover:bg-white/5 hover:border-white/10 bg-[#161B22]/50'}`}>
                          <img src={f.avatar} className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full border border-white/5" alt="" />
                          <div className="text-left flex-1">
                            <p className="text-sm font-black text-white tracking-tight">{f.name}</p>
                            <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-bold">{f.position}</p>
                          </div>
                          <div className={`w-6 h-6 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center ${already ? 'bg-[#FFFF00]/20 text-[#FFFF00]' : 'bg-black/50 text-gray-400'}`}>
                            {already ? <Check size={12} /> : <Plus size={12} />}
                          </div>
                        </button>
                      );
                    })}
                    {confirmedFriends.length === 0 && <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 text-center py-4 font-bold">Henüz arkadaşın yok.</p>}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          )}
        </AnimatePresence>
      </div>

      <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }} onClick={() => onNext(myPlayers.length)}
        className="w-full h-14 bg-[#FFFF00] text-black font-black text-sm rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,255,0,0.25)] hover:bg-yellow-300 transition-all uppercase tracking-widest">
        SAHAYA GEÇ <ChevronRight size={18} />
      </motion.button>
    </motion.div>
  );
};

// SHARED HELPERS
// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const getGrade = (s: number) => {
  if (s >= 95) return 'A+'; if (s >= 90) return 'A'; if (s >= 85) return 'A-';
  if (s >= 80) return 'B+'; if (s >= 75) return 'B'; if (s >= 70) return 'B-'; return 'C';
};
const gradeColor = (g: string) =>
  g.startsWith('A') ? 'text-emerald-400' : g.startsWith('B') ? 'text-yellow-400' : 'text-orange-400';

const SkillBar: React.FC<{ label: string; value: number; color: string }> = ({ label, value, color }) => (
  <div className="space-y-1">
    <div className="flex justify-between items-center px-1">
      <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-tighter">{label}</span>
      <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-white">{value}</span>
    </div>
    <div className="h-1.5 bg-white/5 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
      <motion.div initial={{ width: 0 }} animate={{ width: `${value}%` }} transition={{ duration: 1, ease: 'easeOut' }} className={`h-full ${color} rounded-full`} />
    </div>
  </div>
);
