                                        {player.paymentStatus === 'PENDING' && <span className="text-yellow-500 text-[10px] font-black flex items-center gap-1 bg-yellow-500/10 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-yellow-500/20"><Clock size={11} /> BEKLİYOR</span>}
                                        {player.paymentStatus === 'UNPAID' && <button className="text-red-400 text-[10px] font-black flex items-center gap-1 bg-red-500/10 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-red-500/20 hover:bg-red-500/20 transition-colors"><AlertCircle size={11} /> HATIRLAT</button>}
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            ))}
                        </div>
                    </motion.div>
                )}

                {/* ── LOBİ TAB ───────────────────────────────────────── */}
                {activeTab === 'LOBI' && <div className="space-y-6">

                {/* 2. Side-by-Side VS Payment Bars */}
                <section>
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-3 px-1 mt-2">
                        <h3 className="font-black text-white text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
                            <Scale size={16} className="text-[#39FF14]" /> TAKIM ÖDEMELERİ
                        </h3>
                        <div className="bg-[#FFFF00]/10 text-[#FFFF00] text-[10px] font-black px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full border border-[#FFFF00]/30 hidden sm:flex items-center gap-1">
                            <CheckCircle2 size={12} /> TOPLAM {MATCH_DATA.totalPrice}₺
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="bg-[#161B22] rounded-[32px] border border-white/5 relative overflow-hidden shadow-[0_10px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] p-5 pb-6 mb-4">
                        {/* Background glow */}
                        <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 w-32 h-32 bg-[#39FF14]/5 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none"></div>
                        <div className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-32 h-32 bg-[#FF3366]/5 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none"></div>
                        
                        <div className="flex items-end justify-between gap-2 h-[260px]">
                            
                            {/* TEAM A (Left) */}
                            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center h-full pb-0 relative">
                                {/* Hired GK Float */}
                                <div className="absolute -left-3 top-10 bg-[#0A0E14] border border-green-500/30 rounded-2xl p-2 z-20 flex flex-col items-center shadow-2xl">
                                    <div className="p-1 bg-green-500/10 rounded-full mb-1">
                                        <img src={MATCH_DATA.hiredGk.avatar} className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full border border-green-500/50" />
                                    </div>
                                    <span className="text-[7px] font-black text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-widest">Kaleci</span>
                                    <span className="text-[9px] font-black text-[#39FF14] bg-[#39FF14]/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-sm mt-0.5">+{MATCH_DATA.hiredGk.price}₺</span>
                                </div>

                                <div className="text-center mb-3 z-10 w-full relative pt-2">
                                    <h4 className="text-[11px] font-black text-white uppercase tracking-widest bg-[#0A0E14] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl inline-block border border-[#39FF14]/20 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(57,255,20,0.1)]">BİZİM TAKIM</h4>
                                    <p className="text-[9px] text-gray-500 font-bold mt-1.5">Hedef: {MATCH_DATA.teamATarget}₺</p>
                                </div>

                                {/* Vertical Bar */}
                                <div className="relative w-14 sm:w-16 flex-1 bg-[#0A0E14] rounded-t-[20px] rounded-b-[8px] border border-white/10 overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-end shadow-[inset_0_4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] z-10">
                                    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center z-20 pointer-events-none">
                                        <span className="text-sm font-black text-white drop-shadow-[0_2px_4px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)]">%{Math.round(teamAProgress)}</span>

                                        initial={{ height: 0 }}

                                        transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 50, damping: 15 }}
                                        className="w-full bg-gradient-to-t from-green-700 via-[#39FF14] to-yellow-300 relative rounded-t-[12px]"
                                    >
                                        <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 w-full h-8 bg-gradient-to-b from-white/40 to-transparent animate-pulse blur-[1px]"></div>
                                    </motion.div>
                                </div>
                                <div className="mt-3 text-center bg-[#0A0E14] w-full py-2 rounded-xl border border-white/5">
                                    <span className={`text-sm font-black block leading-none mb-1 ${teamARemaining === 0 ? 'text-[#39FF14]' : 'text-white'}`}>{teamARemaining === 0 ? 'ÖDENDİ' : `${teamAPaid}₺`}</span>
                                    {teamARemaining > 0 && <span className="text-[9px] text-[#FF3366] font-bold block leading-none">Kalan: {teamARemaining}₺</span>}

                                <div className="bg-[#0A0E14] border border-[#FFFF00]/30 rounded-[24px] p-2 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(255,255,0,0.15)] relative flex flex-col items-center mt-8">
                                    <div className="bg-[#161B22] border border-[#FFFF00]/20 rounded-2xl w-14 h-16 sm:w-16 sm:h-20 flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden mb-2">
                                        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-yellow-500/10 animate-[pulse_3s_ease-in-out_infinite]"></div>
                                        <img src={MATCH_DATA.hiredReferee.avatar} className="w-8 h-8 sm:w-10 sm:h-10 rounded-full border border-yellow-500/50 object-cover relative z-10 mb-1 shadow-md" />
                                        <div className="bg-yellow-500/20 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[8px] font-black text-[#FFFF00] relative z-10">+{MATCH_DATA.hiredReferee.price}₺</div>
                                    </div>
                                    <span className="text-[8px] font-black text-gray-500 block uppercase tracking-widest mb-0.5">Hakem</span>
                                    <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-yellow-500 bg-yellow-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full">{MATCH_DATA.hiredReferee.name}</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            {/* TEAM B (Right) */}
                            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center h-full pb-0 relative">
                                <div className="text-center mb-3 z-10 w-full relative pt-2">
                                    <h4 className="text-[11px] font-black text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest bg-[#0A0E14] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl inline-block border border-red-500/20 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,51,102,0.1)]">RAKİP TAKIM</h4>
                                    <p className="text-[9px] text-gray-500 font-bold mt-1.5">Hedef: {MATCH_DATA.teamBTarget}₺</p>
                                </div>

                                <div className="relative w-14 sm:w-16 flex-1 bg-[#0A0E14] rounded-t-[20px] rounded-b-[8px] border border-white/10 overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-end shadow-[inset_0_4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] z-10 opacity-90">
                                    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center z-20 pointer-events-none">
                                        <span className="text-sm font-black text-white/80 drop-shadow-[0_2px_4px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)]">%{Math.round(teamBProgress)}</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <motion.div 
                                        initial={{ height: 0 }}
                                        animate={{ height: `${teamBProgress}%` }}
                                        transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 50, damping: 15 }}
                                        className="w-full bg-gradient-to-t from-red-900 via-[#FF3366] to-pink-400 relative rounded-t-[12px]"
                                    >
                                        <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 w-full h-8 bg-gradient-to-b from-white/20 to-transparent animate-pulse blur-[1px]"></div>
                                    </motion.div>
                                </div>
                                <div className="mt-3 text-center bg-[#0A0E14] w-full py-2 rounded-xl border border-white/5 opacity-80">
                                    <span className={`text-sm font-black block leading-none mb-1 text-gray-300`}>{teamBPaid}₺</span>
                                    <span className="text-[9px] text-gray-600 font-bold block leading-none">Kalan: {MATCH_DATA.teamBTarget - teamBPaid}₺</span>

                    {/* Quick Payment Action Buttons */}

                            whileHover={{ scale: 1.05 }}
                            whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
                            onClick={() => setPendingPayment({ amount: MATCH_DATA.pricePerPerson, label: 'Kendi Payım' })}
                            disabled={teamARemaining === 0}
                            className="w-full bg-[#0A0E14] border border-[#FFFF00]/20 p-3 rounded-2xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 hover:bg-[#FFFF00]/10 hover:border-[#FFFF00] transition-colors group disabled:opacity-50 disabled:pointer-events-none"

                                <div className="text-[9px] text-[#FFFF00]/70 font-bold uppercase leading-none mb-1">Kendi Payım</div>
                                <div className="text-sm font-black text-[#FFFF00] leading-none">{MATCH_DATA.pricePerPerson}₺</div>

                            disabled={teamARemaining === 0}
                            className="w-full bg-[#0A0E14] border border-[#FFFF00]/20 p-3 rounded-2xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 hover:bg-[#FFFF00]/10 hover:border-[#FFFF00] transition-colors group disabled:opacity-50 disabled:pointer-events-none"
                        >
                            <Users size={18} className="text-[#FFFF00] group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform" />
                            <div className="text-center">
                                <div className="text-[9px] text-[#FFFF00]/70 font-bold uppercase leading-none mb-1">+1 Misafir</div>
                                <div className="text-sm font-black text-[#FFFF00] leading-none">{MATCH_DATA.pricePerPerson * 2}₺</div>
                            </div>
                        </motion.button>

                            whileHover={{ scale: 1.05 }}
                            whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}

                            className="w-full bg-[#0A0E14] border border-[#FFFF00]/20 p-3 rounded-2xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 hover:bg-[#FFFF00]/10 hover:border-[#FFFF00] transition-colors group disabled:opacity-50 disabled:pointer-events-none"

                                <div className="text-[9px] text-[#FFFF00]/70 font-bold uppercase leading-none mb-1">Kalanı Kapat</div>

                        >

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Shirt, Footprints, Droplets, Info, 
  CheckCircle2, Hand, Scale, Users, Shield, Plus, ListFilter, 
  Sliders, X, Zap, Star, CreditCard, Handshake, ChevronRight, Award
} from 'lucide-react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { GOALKEEPERS, REFEREES } from '../constants';
import { Goalkeeper, Referee } from '../types';

interface BookingAddonsProps {
  onBack: () => void;
  onContinue: (total: number) => void;
  onNavigate: (view: any) => void;
  selectedGk: Goalkeeper | null;
  selectedRef: Referee | null;
  onRemoveGk: () => void;
  onRemoveRef: () => void;
}

const BookingAddons: React.FC<BookingAddonsProps> = ({ 
  onBack, 
  onContinue, 
  onNavigate,
  selectedGk,
  selectedRef,
  onRemoveGk,
  onRemoveRef
}) => {
  // Equipment State
  const [bootsCount, setBootsCount] = useState(0);
  const [vestsCount, setVestsCount] = useState(0);
  const [waterCount, setWaterCount] = useState(0);

  const prices = {
      boots: 50,
      vests: 10,
      water: 15,
      gk: selectedGk ? selectedGk.fee : 0,
      ref: selectedRef ? selectedRef.fee : 0,
  };

  const calculateTotal = () => {
      let total = (bootsCount * prices.boots) + (vestsCount * prices.vests) + (waterCount * prices.water);
      total += prices.gk;
      total += prices.ref;
      return total;
  };

  const handleContinue = () => {
      onContinue(calculateTotal());
  };

  const EquipmentItem = ({ icon, title, count, setCount, price }: any) => (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-[#161B22] border border-white/5 rounded-2xl">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-[#0A0E14] flex items-center justify-center text-gray-400">
                  {icon}
              </div>
              <div>
                  <p className="text-xs font-bold text-white">{title}</p>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-[#FFFF00] font-black">+{price}₺</p>
              </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#0A0E14] rounded-lg p-1">
              <button onClick={() => setCount(Math.max(0, count - 1))} className="w-6 h-6 flex items-center justify-center text-gray-400 hover:text-white">-</button>
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-white w-3 text-center">{count}</span>
              <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)} className="w-6 h-6 flex items-center justify-center text-gray-400 hover:text-white">+</button>
          </div>
      </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#0A0E14] flex flex-col relative font-sans">
       
       {/* Header */}
       <header className="p-6 flex items-center gap-4 sticky top-0 bg-[#0A0E14]/90 backdrop-blur-xl z-20 border-b border-white/5">
           <button onClick={onBack} className="w-11 h-11 flex items-center justify-center bg-[#161B22] rounded-full text-white hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors border border-white/5">
               <ArrowLeft size={20} />
           </button>
           <div>
               <h1 className="text-xl font-black text-white">KADRO TAKVİYESİ</h1>
               <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-widest">Maç Öncesi Hazırlık</p>
           </div>
       </header>

       <main className="flex-1 p-6 space-y-6 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar pb-40">
            
            {/* Section 1: Talent Modules (Side-by-Side Buttons) */}
            <div className="space-y-4">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                    <Users size={16} className="text-[#FFFF00]" />
                    <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider">Profesyonel Destek</h3>
                </div>
                
                <div className="flex gap-3">
                  <button 
                    onClick={() => onNavigate('MARKETPLACE_GK')}
                    className={`flex-1 h-24 rounded-3xl border flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all relative overflow-hidden ${selectedGk ? 'bg-green-500/10 border-green-500 text-green-400' : 'bg-[#161B22] border-white/5 text-gray-400 hover:border-white/20'}`}
                  >
                    <Hand size={24} className={selectedGk ? 'text-green-400' : 'text-gray-500'} />
                    <span className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest">KALECİ</span>
                    {selectedGk && <CheckCircle2 size={14} className="absolute top-2 right-2 text-green-400" />}
                  </button>

                  <button 
                    onClick={() => onNavigate('MARKETPLACE_REF')}
                    className={`flex-1 h-24 rounded-3xl border flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all relative overflow-hidden ${selectedRef ? 'bg-yellow-500/10 border-yellow-500 text-yellow-400' : 'bg-[#161B22] border-white/5 text-gray-400 hover:border-white/20'}`}
                  >
                    <Scale size={24} className={selectedRef ? 'text-yellow-400' : 'text-gray-500'} />
                    <span className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest">HAKEM</span>
                    {selectedRef && <CheckCircle2 size={14} className="absolute top-2 right-2 text-yellow-400" />}
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Status Indicators */}
                {(selectedGk || selectedRef) && (
                  <div className="bg-[#161B22] p-4 rounded-2xl border border-white/5 space-y-2">
                    {selectedGk && (
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-green-500/30">
                            <img src={selectedGk.avatar} className="w-full h-full object-cover" referrerPolicy="no-referrer" />
                          </div>
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-white uppercase">{selectedGk.name} Atandı</span>
                        </div>
                        <button onClick={onRemoveGk} className="text-gray-500 hover:text-red-400"><X size={14} /></button>
                      </div>
                    )}
                    {selectedRef && (
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-yellow-500/30">
                            <img src={selectedRef.avatar} className="w-full h-full object-cover" referrerPolicy="no-referrer" />
                          </div>
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-white uppercase">{selectedRef.name} Atandı</span>
                        </div>
                        <button onClick={onRemoveRef} className="text-gray-500 hover:text-red-400"><X size={14} /></button>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
            </div>

           {/* Section 2: Essentials */}
           <div>
               <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3 mt-6">
                   <Shirt size={16} className="text-blue-400" />
                   <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider">Ekipman & İçecek</h3>
               </div>
               <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3">
                   <EquipmentItem icon={<Footprints size={18} />} title="Krampon" price={prices.boots} count={bootsCount} setCount={setBootsCount} />
                   <EquipmentItem icon={<Shirt size={18} />} title="Yelek" price={prices.vests} count={vestsCount} setCount={setVestsCount} />
                   <EquipmentItem icon={<Droplets size={18} />} title="Su (1.5L)" price={prices.water} count={waterCount} setCount={setWaterCount} />
               </div>
           </div>

           <div className="bg-blue-900/10 border border-blue-500/20 p-4 rounded-2xl flex items-start gap-3 mt-4">
               <Info className="text-blue-400 shrink-0" size={20} />
               <p className="text-xs text-blue-200 leading-relaxed">
                   Seçilen hizmetler ve ekipmanlar maç saatinde sahada hazır olacaktır.
               </p>
           </div>
       </main>

       {/* Footer */}
       <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-full bg-[#0A0E14] border-t border-white/10 p-6 pb-8 z-30 shadow-[0_-10px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]">
           <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
               <div>
                   <p className="text-gray-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase">Ekstra Tutar</p>

               <span className="text-3xl font-black text-white">+{calculateTotal()}₺</span>
           </div>
           <button 
            onClick={handleContinue}
            className="w-full h-16 bg-[#FFFF00] text-black font-black text-lg rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 hover:bg-yellow-300 transition-all shadow-lg shadow-yellow-900/20 active:scale-95"
           >
               REZERVASYONU VE KADROYU ONAYLA
               <ArrowRight size={20} />

interface Player {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    role: string;
    rating: number;
    code?: string;
    isOpponent?: boolean;
    isCustom?: boolean;
}

type GameIdentity = 'BALANCED' | 'HIGH_PRESS' | 'PARK_BUS' | 'COUNTER_ATTACK';
type Archetype = 'NONE' | 'FAKE' | 'GOL' | 'GUCLU' | 'TEHLIKELI' | 'SERT' | 'ASIST' | 'HIZLI' | 'KORUYUCU';

interface Slot {
    id: string;
    x: number;
    y: number;
    role: string;
    player?: Player;
    instruction?: string;
    archetype?: Archetype;
}

type SquadSize = '5v5' | '6v6' | '7v7' | '8v8' | '9v9' | '10v10' | '11v11';
type FormationType = '1-2-1' | '2-1-1' | '2-2-1' | '3-1-1' | '2-3-1' | '3-2-1' | '2-2-2' | '3-3-1' | '4-2-1' | '3-3-2' | '4-3-1' | '4-4-1' | '4-3-2' | '4-4-2' | '4-3-3' | '3-5-2';

interface TacticState {
    id?: string;
    teamName?: string;
    name: string;
    size: SquadSize;
    formation: FormationType;
    slots: Slot[];
    subs: Player[];
    captainId: string | null;
    notes: string;
    opponents: Slot[];
    mentality: 'Defensive' | 'Balanced' | 'Attacking';
    tempo: 'Slow' | 'Normal' | 'Fast';
    identity: GameIdentity;
    groupColor?: 'DEFAULT' | 'RED' | 'NAVY' | 'GREEN';
    drawings?: DrawingLine[];
}

interface DrawingLine {
    id: string;
    points: { x: number, y: number }[];
    color: string;
    type: 'arrow' | 'line';
    attachedTo?: string; // ID of the slot or opponent this line is attached to
    seqStep: number;
}

const getSmoothPathStr = (points: {x: number, y: number}[], width: number, height: number): string => {
    if (!points || points.length === 0) return '';
    const mapped = points.map(p => ({ x: (p.x * width) / 100, y: (p.y * height) / 100 }));
    if (mapped.length === 1) return `M ${mapped[0].x},${mapped[0].y}`;
    if (mapped.length === 2) return `M ${mapped[0].x},${mapped[0].y} L ${mapped[1].x},${mapped[1].y}`;
    
    let path = `M ${mapped[0].x},${mapped[0].y}`;
    for (let i = 1; i < mapped.length - 1; i++) {
        const xc = (mapped[i].x + mapped[i + 1].x) / 2;
        const yc = (mapped[i].y + mapped[i + 1].y) / 2;
        path += ` Q ${mapped[i].x},${mapped[i].y} ${xc},${yc}`;
    }
    path += ` L ${mapped[mapped.length - 1].x},${mapped[mapped.length - 1].y}`;
    return path;
};

const getPathLength = (points: {x: number, y: number}[]): number => {
    let dist = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < points.length - 1; i++) {
        dist += Math.hypot(points[i+1].x - points[i].x, points[i+1].y - points[i].y);
    }
    return dist;
};

const getAnimationProps = (path: DrawingLine, isSimulating: boolean, playMode: 'SYNC' | 'SEQ', seqInfo: {startTime: number, duration: number}, totalSeqDur: number) => {
    if (!isSimulating || !path) return { animate: {}, transition: {} };
    const pathDur = seqInfo.duration;
    const totalCycle = playMode === 'SEQ' ? Math.max(0.1, totalSeqDur) : pathDur;
    const startTime = playMode === 'SEQ' ? seqInfo.startTime : 0;
    
    let times: number[] = [];
    let lefts: string[] = [];
    let tops: string[] = [];
    
    if (playMode === 'SEQ') {
        const normalizedStart = startTime / totalCycle;
        const normalizedEnd = (startTime + pathDur) / totalCycle;
        
        if (normalizedStart > 0) {
            times.push(0);
            lefts.push(`${path.points[0].x}%`);
            tops.push(`${path.points[0].y}%`);
        }
        
        path.points.forEach((p, idx) => {
            const fraction = idx / Math.max(1, path.points.length - 1);
            times.push(normalizedStart + fraction * (normalizedEnd - normalizedStart));
            lefts.push(`${p.x}%`);
            tops.push(`${p.y}%`);
        });
        
        if (normalizedEnd < 1) {
            times.push(1);
            lefts.push(`${path.points[path.points.length - 1].x}%`);
            tops.push(`${path.points[path.points.length - 1].y}%`);
        }
    } else {
        lefts = path.points.map(p => `${p.x}%`);
        tops = path.points.map(p => `${p.y}%`);
    }
    
    return {
        animate: { left: lefts, top: tops },
        transition: {
            duration: totalCycle,
            ease: "linear",
            repeat: Infinity,
            repeatType: "loop" as const,
            ...(playMode === 'SEQ' && { times })
        }
    };
};

    const preservePlayersAndSubs = (newSlots: Slot[], currentSubs: Player[]) => {
        const currentPlayers = activeTactic.slots.filter(s => s.player).map(s => s.player);
        let playerIndex = 0;
        newSlots.forEach((s: any) => {
            if (playerIndex < currentPlayers.length) {
                let selectedPlayer = null;
                if (s.role === 'GK') {
                    const gkIndex = currentPlayers.findIndex((p: any, idx: number) => p.role === 'GK' && idx >= playerIndex);
                    if (gkIndex !== -1) {
                         selectedPlayer = currentPlayers[gkIndex];
                         currentPlayers[gkIndex] = currentPlayers[playerIndex];
                         currentPlayers[playerIndex] = selectedPlayer;
                    }
                }
                if (!selectedPlayer) {
                    selectedPlayer = currentPlayers[playerIndex];
                }
                s.player = selectedPlayer;
                playerIndex++;
            }
        });

        const leftovers = currentPlayers.slice(playerIndex);
        const newSubs = [...currentSubs];
        leftovers.forEach(p => {
            if (p && !newSubs.some(sub => sub.id === p.id)) {
                newSubs.push(p);
            }
        });
        
        return { newSlots, newSubs };

        const { newSlots, newSubs } = preservePlayersAndSubs(baseSlots, activeTactic.subs);
        let captainId = activeTactic.captainId;
        if (captainId && !newSlots.some((s:any) => s.player?.id === captainId)) captainId = null;
        setActiveTactic({ ...activeTactic, size, formation: defaultFormation, slots: newSlots, subs: newSubs, captainId, drawings: [] });

    const handleIdentityChange = (identity: GameIdentity) => {
        const baseSlots = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(FORMATIONS[activeTactic.size][activeTactic.formation]));
        const newSlots = baseSlots.map((slot: Slot) => {
            // Keep existing player and archetype

            if (existingSlot) {
                slot.player = existingSlot.player;
                slot.archetype = existingSlot.archetype;

                if (identity === 'HIGH_PRESS') {
                    // Push everyone up
                    slot.y = Math.max(10, slot.y - 15);

                    // Pull everyone back

                    // FWD stays up, others drop back

                        slot.y = 15;
                    } else {
                        slot.y = Math.min(85, slot.y + 10);
                    }
                }
            }
            return slot;

            }
        }
    };

        try {

    };

    const handlePointerDown = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
        if (!canvasRef.current) return;
        
        const rect = canvasRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100;
        const y = ((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100;

        if (tool.startsWith('draw')) {
            setIsDrawing(true);
            
            // Find nearest slot or opponent (within 5% radius)
            let attachedTo: string | undefined;
            const threshold = 5;
            let minDistance = Infinity;

            activeTactic.slots.forEach(slot => {
                const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(slot.x - x, 2) + Math.pow(slot.y - y, 2));
                if (dist < threshold && dist < minDistance) {
                    minDistance = dist;
                    attachedTo = slot.id;
                }
            });

            activeTactic.opponents.forEach(opp => {
                const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(opp.x - x, 2) + Math.pow(opp.y - y, 2));
                if (dist < threshold && dist < minDistance) {
                    minDistance = dist;
                    attachedTo = opp.id;
                }
            });

            // Check if there is already a line attached to this item of the same type.
            // A player can have a run and a pass simultaneously.
            if (attachedTo) {
                const lineType = tool === 'draw_pass' ? 'arrow' : 'line';
                setDrawings(prev => prev.filter(d => d.attachedTo !== attachedTo || d.type !== lineType));
            }

            const maxSeq = drawings.reduce((max, d) => Math.max(max, d.seqStep), 0);
            setCurrentLine({
                id: `l${Date.now()}`,
                points: [{ x, y }],
                color: attachedTo ? (activeTactic.slots.find(s => s.id === attachedTo) ? '#39FF14' : '#ef4444') : '#39FF14',
                type: tool === 'draw_pass' ? 'arrow' : 'line',
                attachedTo,
                seqStep: maxSeq + 1
            });
        } else if (tool === 'opponent') {
            const newOpponent: Slot = {
                id: `opp_${Date.now()}`,
                x,
                y,
                role: 'OPP',
                player: {
                    id: `opp_p_${Date.now()}`,
                    name: `Rakip ${activeTactic.opponents.length + 1}`,
                    role: 'OPP',
                    rating: 0,
                    isOpponent: true
                }
            };
            setActiveTactic({ ...activeTactic, opponents: [...activeTactic.opponents, newOpponent] });
            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(10);
        }
    };

    const rafRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

    const handlePointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
        if (!canvasRef.current) return;
        
        const rect = canvasRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100;
        const y = ((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100;

        if (isDrawing && currentLine) {
            if (rafRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
            rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                setCurrentLine(prev => {
                    if (!prev) return null;
                    const lastPoint = prev.points[prev.points.length - 1];
                    if (prev.points.length > 0) {
                        const dist = Math.hypot(x - lastPoint.x, y - lastPoint.y);
                        // Add point ONLY if it moved at least somewhat (2% distance)
                        if (dist < 2.0) return prev;
                    }
                    return {
                        ...prev,
                        points: [...prev.points, { x, y }]
                    };
                });
            });
        } else if (draggedItem && tool === 'move') {
            const clampedX = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, x - draggedItem.offsetX));
            const clampedY = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, y - draggedItem.offsetY));

            if (rafRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
            rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                if (draggedItem.type === 'slot') {
                    setActiveTactic({
                        ...activeTactic,
                        slots: activeTactic.slots.map(s => 
                            s.id === draggedItem.id ? { ...s, x: clampedX, y: clampedY } : s
                        )
                    });
                } else if (draggedItem.type === 'opponent') {
                    setActiveTactic({
                        ...activeTactic,
                        opponents: activeTactic.opponents.map(o => 
                            o.id === draggedItem.id ? { ...o, x: clampedX, y: clampedY } : o
                        )
                    });
                }
            });
        }
    };

    const handlePointerUp = () => {
        if (rafRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
        
        if (isDrawing && currentLine) {
            const finalLine = { ...currentLine } as DrawingLine;
            setDrawings([...drawings, finalLine]);
            setIsDrawing(false);
            setCurrentLine(null);
        }
        setDraggedItem(null);
    };

    const handleDragStart = (type: 'slot' | 'opponent', id: string, e: React.PointerEvent) => {
        if (tool !== 'move' || !canvasRef.current) return;
        e.stopPropagation();
        e.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);

        let currentX = 0;
        let currentY = 0;
        if (type === 'slot') {
            const slot = activeTactic.slots.find(s => s.id === id);
            if (slot) { currentX = slot.x; currentY = slot.y; }
        } else {
            const opp = activeTactic.opponents.find(o => o.id === id);
            if (opp) { currentX = opp.x; currentY = opp.y; }
        }

        const rect = canvasRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
        const pointerX = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100;
        const pointerY = ((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100;

        setDraggedItem({ type, id, offsetX: pointerX - currentX, offsetY: pointerY - currentY });
        if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(10);
    };

    const handleRemoveOpponent = (id: string) => {
        setActiveTactic({ ...activeTactic, opponents: activeTactic.opponents.filter(o => o.id !== id) });
    };



    const isSquadComplete = activeTactic.slots.every(s => !!s.player);
    const hasGK = activeTactic.slots.some(s => s.role === 'GK' && !!s.player);
    const canSave = isSquadComplete && hasGK;

    // Get all players on the pitch (own team + opponents)
    const allPlayersOnPitch = [
        ...activeTactic.slots.filter(s => s.player).map(s => ({ ...s, type: 'slot' as const })),
        ...activeTactic.opponents.map(o => ({ ...o, type: 'opponent' as const }))
    ];

    return (
        <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col font-sans selection:bg-[#39FF14] selection:text-black pb-10">
            <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
                {viewMode === 'SELECTION' ? (
                    <motion.div 
                        key="selection"
                        initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
                        animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
                        exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 1.05 }}
                        className="flex-1 flex flex-col p-6"
                    >
                        {/* Selection Header */}
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-12">
                            <button onClick={onBack} className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition-all">
                                <ChevronLeft size={24} />
                            </button>
                            <div>
                                <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-widest uppercase italic">MERKEZ</h1>
                                <p className="text-xs text-[#39FF14] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest">Gelişim & Taktik</p>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4">
                            {/* Option 1: Eğitim (LOCKED) */}
                            <div className="group relative h-40 bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-600/10 to-indigo-600/10 rounded-[32px] border border-white/5 overflow-hidden text-left p-6 transition-all opacity-60">
                                <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-32 h-32 bg-blue-500/5 blur-3xl rounded-full" />
                                <div className="absolute top-4 right-6 bg-black/50 border border-white/10 px-3 py-1 rounded-full flex items-center gap-2">
                                    <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-red-500 animate-pulse"></span>
                                    <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-white tracking-widest uppercase">YAKINDA</span>
                                </div>
                                <div className="relative z-10 h-full flex flex-col justify-between grayscale">
                                    <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-white/5 flex items-center justify-center text-white/40 border border-white/10">
                                        <Dumbbell size={24} />
                                    </div>
                                    <div>
                                        <h3 className="text-2xl font-black text-white italic uppercase tracking-tighter">EĞİTİM</h3>
                                        <p className="text-xs text-white/40 font-medium">Taktiksel zekanı geliştir, yeni metodlar öğren.</p>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <Dumbbell size={120} className="absolute -right-8 -bottom-8 text-white/5 -rotate-12 transition-all" />
                            </div>

                            {/* Option 2: Güncel (LOCKED) */}
                            <div className="group relative h-40 bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-600/10 to-orange-600/10 rounded-[32px] border border-white/5 overflow-hidden text-left p-6 transition-all opacity-60">
                                <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-32 h-32 bg-amber-500/5 blur-3xl rounded-full" />
                                <div className="absolute top-4 right-6 bg-black/50 border border-white/10 px-3 py-1 rounded-full flex items-center gap-2">
                                    <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-red-500 animate-pulse"></span>
                                    <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-white tracking-widest uppercase">YAKINDA</span>
                                </div>
                                <div className="relative z-10 h-full flex flex-col justify-between grayscale">
                                    <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-white/5 flex items-center justify-center text-white/40 border border-white/10">
                                        <Zap size={24} />
                                    </div>
                                    <div>
                                        <h3 className="text-2xl font-black text-white italic uppercase tracking-tighter">GÜNCEL</h3>
                                        <p className="text-xs text-white/40 font-medium">Dünya futbolundan en yeni dizilişler ve trendler.</p>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <Zap size={120} className="absolute -right-8 -bottom-8 text-white/5 -rotate-12 transition-all" />
                            </div>

                            {/* Option 3: Studio (Existing) */}
                            <button 
                                onClick={() => setViewMode('STUDIO')}
                                className="group relative h-40 bg-gradient-to-br from-[#39FF14]/10 to-emerald-600/10 rounded-[32px] border border-[#39FF14]/20 overflow-hidden text-left p-6 transition-all hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98]"
                            >
                                <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-32 h-32 bg-[#39FF14]/10 blur-3xl rounded-full" />
                                <div className="relative z-10 h-full flex flex-col justify-between">
                                    <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-[#39FF14]/20 flex items-center justify-center text-[#39FF14] border border-[#39FF14]/30">
                                        <Layout size={24} />
                                    </div>
                                    <div>
                                        <h3 className="text-2xl font-black text-white italic uppercase tracking-tighter">STÜDYO</h3>
                                        <p className="text-xs text-[#39FF14]/60 font-medium">Kendi dizilişini oluştur, takımını yönet.</p>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <Layout size={120} className="absolute -right-8 -bottom-8 text-white/5 -rotate-12 group-hover:text-[#39FF14]/10 transition-all" />
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </motion.div>
                ) : viewMode === 'EDUCATION' ? (
                    <motion.div 
                        key="education"
                        initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }}
                        animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
                        exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
                        className="flex flex-col flex-1 relative"
                    >
                        {academyState === 'MENU' ? (
                            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col pt-2 max-w-lg mx-auto w-full">
                                {/* Top Header: Profile & Back */}
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-8">
                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                                        <button onClick={() => setViewMode('SELECTION')} className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-white/5 flex items-center justify-center text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition-all border border-white/10 backdrop-blur-md shrink-0">
                                            <ChevronLeft size={24} />
                                        </button>
                                        <div>
                                            <h2 className="text-3xl font-black text-white uppercase italic tracking-tighter leading-none mb-1">IQ ACADEMY</h2>
                                            <p className="text-[10px] text-[#39FF14] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] leading-none">Futbol Zekanı Geliştir</p>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                {/* User Level Progress */}
                                <div className="bg-[#161B22] border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-6 mb-8 shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden group">
                                    <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-32 h-32 bg-blue-500/10 rounded-full blur-3xl transform translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 group-hover:bg-blue-500/20 transition-all duration-700"></div>
                                    <div className="flex justify-between items-end mb-4 relative z-10">
                                        <div>
                                            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest block mb-1.5">Mevcut Seviye</span>
                                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                                                <Shield className="text-blue-400" size={24} />
                                                <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-white uppercase tracking-wider">Yarı Profesyonel</h3>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="text-right">
                                            <div className="text-4xl font-black text-white leading-none">{userIQ} <span className="text-sm text-blue-400 ml-1">IQ</span></div>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    {/* Progress Bar */}
                                    <div className="w-full bg-black/50 h-3 rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-white/5 relative z-10 mb-2">
                                        <motion.div 
                                            initial={{ width: 0 }}
                                            animate={{ width: `${(userIQ / 2000) * 100}%` }}
                                            transition={{ duration: 1.5, ease: "easeOut" }}
                                            className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 via-blue-400 to-[#39FF14] relative"
                                        >
                                            <div className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 right-0 w-4 bg-white/50 blur-sm"></div>
                                        </motion.div>
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="flex justify-between mt-2 text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-widest relative z-10">
                                        <span>Başlangıç</span>
                                        <span>Pro Seviye (2000 IQ)</span>
                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                {/* IQ Academy Content */}
                                <div className="space-y-6 flex-1 overflow-y-auto pb-10 hide-scrollbar">
                                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                                        <h4 className="text-xs font-black text-white uppercase tracking-widest">Önerilen Eğitim</h4>
                                        <span className="text-[9px] text-[#39FF14] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest bg-[#39FF14]/10 px-2 py-1 rounded-md">Yeni Eklendi</span>
                                    </div>

                                    {/* Featured: The "Next Move" Challenge */}
                                    <motion.div 
                                        whileHover={{ scale: 1.02 }}
                                        whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }}
                                        className="bg-[#0A0E14] rounded-[32px] border border-blue-500/30 p-6 relative overflow-hidden group shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] cursor-pointer"
                                        onClick={() => {
                                            setAcademyState('LESSON');
                                            setLessonPhase('ANIMATION');
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-600/20 via-transparent to-indigo-900/40 z-0"></div>
                                        
                                        {/* Animated Grid Background */}
                                        <div className="absolute inset-0 opacity-[0.03] z-0" style={{ backgroundImage: 'linear-gradient(#fff 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, #fff 1px, transparent 1px)', backgroundSize: '20px 20px' }}></div>

                                        <div className="absolute -top-10 -right-10 opacity-20 transform group-hover:scale-110 group-hover:rotate-12 transition-all duration-700 ease-out z-0">
                                            <Brain size={160} className="text-blue-400" />
                                        </div>
                                        
                                        <div className="relative z-10">
                                            <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
                                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                                    <span className="px-3 py-1 bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-lg text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.2em] shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(59,130,246,0.5)]">Modül 01</span>
                                                    <span className="px-3 py-1 bg-white/10 text-gray-300 rounded-lg text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10">10 Aşamalı Eğitim</span>
                                                </div>
                                                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-black/40 px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-white/10">
                                                    <Star size={10} className="text-yellow-400" />
                                                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-yellow-400">MAX +100 IQ</span>
                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                            <h3 className="text-3xl font-black text-white italic uppercase mb-3 leading-[1.1] tracking-tighter">Hücum <br/><span className="text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-400 to-[#39FF14]">Masterclass</span></h3>
                                            <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-8 font-medium leading-relaxed max-w-[85%]">
                                                Modern futbolda hücumu kilitlemek isteyen kapanan savunmaları açmanın en etkili yolları. 10 farklı taktiksel senaryo seni bekliyor.
                                            </p>
                                            
                                            <button 
                                                className="w-full py-4 bg-white text-black font-black rounded-2xl text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase transition-all shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(255,255,255,0.2)] flex items-center justify-center gap-3 overflow-hidden relative group/btn"
                                            >
                                                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[#39FF14] transform translate-y-full group-hover/btn:translate-y-0 transition-transform duration-300 ease-out z-0"></div>
                                                <span className="relative z-10 group-hover/btn:text-black transition-colors">Simülasyona Gir</span>
                                                <ChevronLeft className="rotate-180 relative z-10" size={16} />
                                            </button>
                                        </div>
                                    </motion.div>

                                    {/* Intelligence Skill Tree */}
                                    <div>
                                        <h4 className="text-xs font-black text-white uppercase tracking-widest mb-4 mt-8 flex items-center gap-2"><Layers size={14} className="text-blue-500" /> Yetenek Ağacı</h4>
                                        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                                            <div 
                                                onClick={() => {
                                                    if (userIQ >= 150) {
                                                        showToast("Scanning modülü projenin bir sonraki aşamasında aktif olacak!", "success");
                                                    } else {
                                                        showToast("Önce 150 IQ'ya ulaşmalısın!", "error");
                                                    }
                                                }}
                                                className={`bg-[#161B22] rounded-[24px] p-5 border border-white/5 relative overflow-hidden group transition-all ${userIQ < 150 ? 'cursor-not-allowed' : 'cursor-pointer hover:border-orange-500/30'}`}
                                            >
                                                {userIQ < 150 && (
                                                    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-[#050812]/80 backdrop-blur-sm z-10 transition-all opacity-100">
                                                        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
                                                            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-white/10 flex items-center justify-center border border-white/20">
                                                                <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="3" className="text-gray-400"><rect x="3" y="11" width="18" height="11" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M7 11V7a5 5 0 0 1 10 0v4"></path></svg>
                                                            </div>
                                                            <span className="text-[9px] font-black text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest">150 IQ GEREKİR</span>
                                                        </div>
                                                    </div>
                                                )}
                                                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-orange-500/10 flex items-center justify-center text-orange-400 mb-4 border border-orange-500/20">
                                                    <Eye size={24} />
                                                </div>
                                                <h4 className="text-sm font-black text-white uppercase italic mb-1 tracking-wider">Scanning</h4>
                                                <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-medium leading-tight">Çevre kontrolü ve önseziler.</p>
                                            </div>
                                            
                                            <div 
                                                onClick={() => {
                                                    if (userIQ >= 200) {
                                                        showToast("Off-the-ball modülü projenin bir sonraki aşamasında aktif olacak!", "success");
                                                    } else {
                                                        showToast("Önce 200 IQ'ya ulaşmalısın!", "error");
                                                    }
                                                }}
                                                className={`bg-[#161B22] rounded-[24px] p-5 border border-white/5 relative overflow-hidden group transition-all ${userIQ < 200 ? 'cursor-not-allowed' : 'cursor-pointer hover:border-purple-500/30'}`}
                                            >
                                                {userIQ < 200 && (
                                                    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-[#050812]/80 backdrop-blur-sm z-10 transition-all opacity-100">
                                                        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
                                                            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-white/10 flex items-center justify-center border border-white/20">
                                                                <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="3" className="text-gray-400"><rect x="3" y="11" width="18" height="11" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M7 11V7a5 5 0 0 1 10 0v4"></path></svg>
                                                            </div>
                                                            <span className="text-[9px] font-black text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest">200 IQ GEREKİR</span>
                                                        </div>
                                                    </div>
                                                )}
                                                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-purple-500/10 flex items-center justify-center text-purple-400 mb-4 border border-purple-500/20">
                                                    <Activity size={24} />
                                                </div>
                                                <h4 className="text-sm font-black text-white uppercase italic mb-1 tracking-wider">Off-the-ball</h4>
                                                <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-medium leading-tight">Topsuz alan koşuları ve sahte 9.</p>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        ) : (
                            /* THE INTERACTIVE LESSON MODULE */
                            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[#050812] z-50 flex flex-col p-6 pt-10 overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden">
                                {/* Lesson Header */}
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6 pt-2 shrink-0">
                                    <button 
                                        onClick={() => {
                                            setAcademyState('MENU');
                                            setCurrentStageIndex(0);
                                            setLessonPhase('ANIMATION');
                                        }} 
                                        className="w-12 h-12 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-white transition-all border border-white/10 shadow-lg shrink-0"
                                    >
                                        <X size={24} />
                                    </button>
                                    <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
                                        <span className="text-xs font-black text-gray-400 tracking-widest uppercase mb-2">Aşama {currentStageIndex + 1} / 10</span>
                                        <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                                            {ACADEMYS.map((_, i) => (
                                                <div key={i} className={`h-1 w-5 rounded-full ${i < currentStageIndex ? 'bg-[#39FF14]' : i === currentStageIndex ? 'bg-blue-500 animate-[pulse_1.5s_ease-in-out_infinite]' : 'bg-white/10'}`} />
                                            ))}
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="w-12 h-12 flex items-center justify-center bg-blue-500/10 rounded-full border border-blue-500/20 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(59,130,246,0.2)] shrink-0">
                                        <Brain size={24} className="text-blue-500" />
                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                {/* Lesson Content Wrapper */}
                                <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
                                    {lessonPhase === 'ANIMATION' && (
                                        <motion.div 
                                            key="phase1"
                                            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -50 }}
                                            className="flex-1 flex flex-col h-full"
                                        >
                                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                                                <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-blue-500 animate-pulse"></div>
                                                <h3 className="text-2xl font-black text-white italic uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none">1. GÖZLEM</h3>
                                            </div>
                                            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-400 mb-8 leading-relaxed max-w-[90%]">{currentScenario.d}</p>
                                            
                                            {/* Animated Pitch Scene */}
                                            <div className="relative w-full aspect-[4/3] bg-[#0B2815] rounded-[32px] border-4 border-[#161B22] overflow-hidden mb-6 shadow-[0_20px_50px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] flex-shrink-0">
                                                <div className="absolute inset-0 opacity-20" style={{ backgroundImage: 'repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, transparent 10%, rgba(0,0,0,0.5) 10%, rgba(0,0,0,0.5) 20%)' }}></div>
                                                
                                                {/* Pitch Lines - Final Third */}
                                                <div className="absolute top-[-5%] left-[20%] right-[20%] h-[35%] border-b-2 border-x-2 border-white/30"></div> 
                                                <div className="absolute top-[-5%] left-[35%] right-[35%] h-[15%] border-b-2 border-x-2 border-white/30"></div> 
                                                <div className="absolute top-[30%] left-[35%] right-[35%] h-[15%] border-b-2 border-white/30 rounded-b-full"></div> 
                                                
                                                {/* Vertical Lines for Lanes (Faint) */}

'border-white' : 'border-white/50'} text-white font-bold text-[10px] flex items-center justify-center z-30 shadow-[0_5px_15px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]`}

                                                {/* Space opened up indicator at Target Area */}

                                                    {currentScenario.o.map((opt, idx) => {
                                                        const isSelected = selectedQuizIdx === idx;
                                                        const showCorrect = quizAnswerStatus === 'CORRECT' && opt.c;
                                                        const showWrong = quizAnswerStatus === 'WRONG' && !opt.c && isSelected;
                                                        const isIdle = quizAnswerStatus === 'IDLE';

                                                        return (
                                                        <button 
                                                            key={idx}
                                                            onClick={() => {
                                                                if (quizAnswerStatus === 'CORRECT') return;
                                                                setSelectedQuizIdx(idx);
                                                                setQuizAnswerStatus(opt.c ? 'CORRECT' : 'WRONG');

                                                                showCorrect ? 'bg-[#39FF14]/15 border-[#39FF14] shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(57,255,20,0.2)] scale-[1.02]'

                                                        >
                                                            <div className={`w-12 h-12 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center font-black text-xl transition-colors ${
                                                                showCorrect ? 'bg-[#39FF14] text-black shadow-[0_0_15px_#39FF14]' 
                                                                : showWrong ? 'bg-red-500 text-white' 
                                                                : 'bg-white/5 text-gray-500 group-hover:bg-white/10 group-hover:text-white'
                                                            }`}>{['A','B','C'][idx]}</div>

                                                                showCorrect ? 'text-[#39FF14]' 
                                                                : showWrong ? 'text-red-100' 
                                                                : 'text-gray-300 group-hover:text-white'
                                                            }`}>{opt.t}</span>
                                                            {showWrong && <X className="text-red-500 absolute right-4" size={24} />}
                                                            {showCorrect && <motion.div initial={{ scale: 0 }} animate={{ scale: 1 }} className="absolute inset-0 border-2 border-[#39FF14] rounded-2xl pointer-events-none" />}

                                                    {quizAnswerStatus === 'CORRECT' && (

'bg-blue-600/50' : 'bg-red-600/50'} border-2 border-white/30 text-white/70 font-bold text-[10px] flex items-center justify-center z-20 shadow-lg`} style={{ left: `${player.ex}%`, top: `${player.ey}%`, transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)' }}>{player.i}</div>

                                                        const yTarget = currentScenario.trg.y - currentScenario.u.sy;
                                                        
                                                        // Require movement in general correct direction
                                                        const isCorrectDirX = (xTarget < 0 && info.offset.x < -15) || (xTarget > 0 && info.offset.x > 15) || Math.abs(xTarget) < 10;
                                                        const isCorrectDirY = (yTarget < 0 && info.offset.y < -15) || (yTarget > 0 && info.offset.y > 15) || Math.abs(yTarget) < 10;

'bg-[#39FF14] text-black shadow-[0_10px_20px_rgba(57,255,20,0.2)] hover:scale-[1.02]' : 'bg-white/5 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed'}`}

                                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                                                        <Activity className="text-blue-400" size={18} />

                                                initial={{ opacity:0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity:1, y: 0 }} transition={{delay: 1}}

                                                    setUserIQ(prev => prev + 10);
                                                    if (currentStageIndex < ACADEMYS.length - 1) {
                                                        setCurrentStageIndex(prev => prev + 1);
                                                        setLessonPhase('ANIMATION'); 
                                                        setQuizAnswerStatus('IDLE');
                                                        setDragSuccess(false);
                                                    } else {
                                                        showToast("Tebrikler! 10 Aşamalı Masterclass'ı bitirdin!", "success");
                                                        setAcademyState('MENU');

                                                        setQuizAnswerStatus('IDLE');
                                                        setDragSuccess(false);

                            </div>
                        )}
                    </motion.div>
                ) : viewMode === 'CURRENT' ? (
                    <motion.div 
                        key="current"
                        initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }}
                        animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
                        exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
                        className="flex-1 flex flex-col p-6 pb-32"
                    >
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-8">
                            <button onClick={() => setViewMode('SELECTION')} className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-white/5 flex items-center justify-center text-white shrink-0">
                                <ChevronLeft size={24} />
                            </button>
                            <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-white uppercase italic tracking-tighter">MODERN TRENDLER</h2>
                        </div>

                        <div className="space-y-6">
                            {/* Pro Analysis Card */}
                            <div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-600/10 to-orange-900/20 rounded-[32px] border border-amber-500/20 overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">
                                <div className="p-8">
                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
                                        <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 bg-amber-500 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
                                        <span className="text-xs font-black text-amber-500 uppercase tracking-widest">Haftalık Analiz</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <h3 className="text-3xl font-black text-white italic uppercase leading-none mb-4">Leverkusen'in<br/>3-4-2-1 Dominansı</h3>
                                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-400 font-medium mb-8 leading-relaxed max-w-[95%]">
                                        Xabi Alonso'nun dar alanda kurduğu elmas yapısı ve beklerin hücum katkısını amatör sahaya nasıl uyarlarsın?

                                        <button onClick={() => showToast("Analiz detayları yakında eklenecek!", "success")} className="flex-1 py-4 bg-amber-500 text-black font-black rounded-2xl text-xs tracking-widest uppercase hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98] transition-all">
                                            ANALİZİ OKU

                                <div onClick={() => showToast("Box Midfield detayları yakında eklenecek!", "success")} className="bg-[#161B22] rounded-[24px] p-6 border border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between group hover:border-white/20 transition-all cursor-pointer">
                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-5">
                                        <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-orange-500/10 text-orange-400 flex items-center justify-center group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform">
                                            <Layout size={28} />
                                        </div>
                                        <div>
                                            <h4 className="text-base font-black text-white uppercase italic">Box Midfields</h4>
                                            <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-widest mt-1">Orta saha kurguları</p>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    <ChevronLeft size={20} className="text-gray-600 rotate-180 group-hover:text-white transition-colors" />
                                </div>
                                <div onClick={() => showToast("Inverted Fullbacks detayları yakında eklenecek!", "success")} className="bg-[#161B22] rounded-[24px] p-6 border border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between group hover:border-white/20 transition-all cursor-pointer">
                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-5">
                                        <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400 flex items-center justify-center group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform">
                                            <Target size={28} />
                                        </div>
                                        <div>
                                            <h4 className="text-base font-black text-white uppercase italic">Inverted Fullbacks</h4>
                                            <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-widest mt-1">Modern bek rolleri</p>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    <ChevronLeft size={20} className="text-gray-600 rotate-180 group-hover:text-white transition-colors" />
                                </div>
                                <div onClick={() => showToast("Half-Spaces detayları yakında eklenecek!", "success")} className="bg-[#161B22] rounded-[24px] p-6 border border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between group hover:border-white/20 transition-all cursor-pointer">
                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-5">
                                        <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-400 flex items-center justify-center group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform">
                                            <Layers size={28} />
                                        </div>
                                        <div>
                                            <h4 className="text-base font-black text-white uppercase italic">Half-Spaces</h4>
                                            <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-widest mt-1">Yarım-alan kullanımı</p>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    <ChevronLeft size={20} className="text-gray-600 rotate-180 group-hover:text-white transition-colors" />
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </motion.div>
                ) : (
                    <motion.div 
                        key="studio"
                        initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
                        animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
                        exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
                        className="flex flex-col min-h-[calc(100vh-6rem)]"
                    >
                        {/* Header */}
                        <header className="px-6 py-4 flex justify-between items-center sticky top-0 bg-[#050812]/90 backdrop-blur-xl z-30 border-b border-white/5">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                                <button onClick={onBack} className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-white/5 flex items-center justify-center text-white hover:bg-white/10">
                                    <ChevronLeft size={20} />
                                </button>
                                <div>
                                    <h1 className="text-xl font-black text-white tracking-[0.2em] uppercase">TAKTİK STUDIO</h1>
                                    <p className="text-[10px] text-[#39FF14] font-mono uppercase">Kadro & Diziliş</p>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex gap-2">
                                <button 
                                    onClick={() => {
                                        setSaveTeamName(activeTactic.teamName || '');
                                        setSaveTacticName(activeTactic.name || '');
                                        setShowSaveModal(true);
                                    }}
                                    className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 to-teal-600 rounded-full text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(16,185,129,0.5)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(16,185,129,0.8)] transition-all"
                                >
                                    <Save size={14} /> KAYDET
                                </button>
                                <button 
                                    onClick={() => setShowExportModal(true)}
                                    className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 to-blue-600 rounded-full text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(147,51,234,0.5)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(147,51,234,0.8)] transition-all"
                                >
                                    <Send size={14} /> PAYLAŞ
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        </header>

            {/* Plan Selector */}
            <div className="px-6 pb-6 pt-2">
                <Reorder.Group 
                    axis="x" 
                    values={plans} 
                    onReorder={handleReorderPlans}
                    className="flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar items-center snap-x p-1"
                >
                    {plans.map((plan, index) => {
                        const isActive = activePlanIndex === index;
                        
                        const getGroupColorStyles = (color: 'DEFAULT'|'RED'|'NAVY'|'GREEN'|undefined, isAct: boolean) => {
                            let base = '';
                            switch(color) {
                                case 'RED': base = 'bg-gradient-to-br from-red-500/20 to-rose-900/40 border-red-500/80'; break;
                                case 'NAVY': base = 'bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-500/20 to-blue-900/40 border-indigo-500/80'; break;
                                case 'GREEN': base = 'bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-500/20 to-green-900/40 border-emerald-500/80'; break;
                                case 'DEFAULT':
                                default:
                                    base = 'bg-gradient-to-br from-[#39FF14]/20 to-emerald-900/40 border-[#39FF14]/80';
                                    break;
                            }
                            if (isAct) {
                                switch(color) {
                                    case 'RED': return base + ' shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(239,68,68,0.25)] ring-1 ring-red-500/50';
                                    case 'NAVY': return base + ' shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(99,102,241,0.25)] ring-1 ring-indigo-500/50';
                                    case 'GREEN': return base + ' shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(16,185,129,0.25)] ring-1 ring-emerald-500/50';
                                    case 'DEFAULT':
                                    default:
                                        return base + ' shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(57,255,20,0.25)] ring-1 ring-[#39FF14]/50';
                                }
                            }
                            return base + ' hover:brightness-110';
                        };

                        const getTextColorStyles = (color: 'DEFAULT'|'RED'|'NAVY'|'GREEN'|undefined, isAct: boolean) => {
                            if (!isAct) {
                                switch(color) {
                                    case 'RED': return 'text-red-500 hover:text-red-400';
                                    case 'NAVY': return 'text-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-300';
                                    case 'GREEN': return 'text-emerald-500 hover:text-emerald-400';
                                    case 'DEFAULT':
                                    default: return 'text-[#39FF14]/60 hover:text-[#39FF14]';
                                }
                            } else {
                                return 'text-white drop-shadow-[0_0_5px_rgba(255,255,255,0.5)]';
                            }
                        };

                        return (
                            <Reorder.Item 
                                key={plan.id}
                                value={plan}
                                dragConstraints={{ top: 0, bottom: 0 }}
                                dragElastic={0.2}
                                whileHover={{ scale: isActive ? 1 : 1.02 }}
                                whileDrag={{ scale: 1.05, zIndex: 50, cursor: 'grabbing', opacity: 0.95 }}
                                className={`relative snap-center flex-shrink-0 flex flex-col justify-between h-[80px] w-[140px] rounded-[20px] p-3 transition-colors duration-300 border cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing ${getGroupColorStyles(plan.groupColor, isActive)}`}
                            >
