const TournamentBracket: React.FC<TournamentBracketProps> = ({ onBack }) => {
  const [viewState, setViewState] = useState<'LIST' | 'CREATE' | 'MANAGE' | 'BRACKET'>('LIST');
  const [activeRound, setActiveRound] = useState(1);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');

  // Form States for Creation
  const [newTournament, setNewTournament] = useState<Partial<Tournament>>({
    name: '',
    format: 'SINGLE_ELIMINATION',
    participantsCount: 8,
    prize: '',
    startDate: '',
    location: '',
    registeredTeams: []
  });

  // Mock Tournaments List
  const [tournaments, setTournaments] = useState<Tournament[]>([
    {
      id: 'tour1',
      name: 'Boğaziçi Güz Kupası',
      status: 'ONGOING',
      format: 'SINGLE_ELIMINATION',
      participantsCount: 16,
      prize: '10.000₺ + Kupa',
      startDate: '2023-10-12',
      location: 'Güney Kampüs Saha',
      rounds: [
        { id: 1, name: 'Son 16' },
        { id: 2, name: 'Çeyrek Final' },
        { id: 3, name: 'Yarı Final' },
        { id: 4, name: 'Final' }
      ],
      registeredTeams: AVAILABLE_TEAMS,
      matches: [
        { id: 101, round: 1, team1: { ...AVAILABLE_TEAMS[0], score: 3 }, team2: { ...AVAILABLE_TEAMS[1], score: 1 }, status: 'COMPLETED', date: '12 Eki' },
        { id: 102, round: 1, team1: { ...AVAILABLE_TEAMS[2], score: 2, penalties: 4 }, team2: { ...AVAILABLE_TEAMS[3], score: 2, penalties: 5 }, status: 'COMPLETED', date: '12 Eki' },
        { id: 103, round: 1, team1: { ...AVAILABLE_TEAMS[4], score: null }, team2: { ...AVAILABLE_TEAMS[5], score: null }, status: 'UPCOMING', date: '14 Eki, 21:00' },
        { id: 104, round: 1, team1: { ...AVAILABLE_TEAMS[6], score: null }, team2: { ...AVAILABLE_TEAMS[7], score: null }, status: 'UPCOMING', date: '14 Eki, 22:00' },
        { id: 201, round: 2, team1: { ...AVAILABLE_TEAMS[0], score: null }, team2: { ...AVAILABLE_TEAMS[3], score: null }, status: 'UPCOMING', date: '18 Eki' },
        { id: 202, round: 2, team1: null, team2: null, status: 'PENDING', date: '19 Eki' },
      ]
    }
  ]);

  const [activeTournament, setActiveTournament] = useState<Tournament | null>(null);

  // Match Management States
  const [isMatchModalOpen, setIsMatchModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingMatch, setEditingMatch] = useState<Match | null>(null);
  const [matchFormData, setMatchFormData] = useState<Partial<Match>>({});

  const handleSaveMatch = () => {
    if (!activeTournament) return;
    
    let updatedMatches;
    if (editingMatch) {
      updatedMatches = activeTournament.matches.map(m => m.id === editingMatch.id ? { ...m, ...matchFormData } as Match : m);
    } else {
      const newMatch: Match = {
        id: Date.now(),
        round: matchFormData.round || activeRound,
        team1: matchFormData.team1 || null,
        team2: matchFormData.team2 || null,
        status: matchFormData.status || 'UPCOMING',
        date: matchFormData.date,
        location: matchFormData.location,
      };
      updatedMatches = [...activeTournament.matches, newMatch];
    }
    
    const updatedTournament = { ...activeTournament, matches: updatedMatches };
    setActiveTournament(updatedTournament);
    setTournaments(tournaments.map(t => t.id === updatedTournament.id ? updatedTournament : t));
    setIsMatchModalOpen(false);
  };

  const handleDeleteMatch = (matchId: number) => {
    if (!activeTournament) return;
    if (!window.confirm('Bu maçı silmek istediğinize emin misiniz?')) return;
    
    const updatedMatches = activeTournament.matches.filter(m => m.id !== matchId);
    const updatedTournament = { ...activeTournament, matches: updatedMatches };
    setActiveTournament(updatedTournament);
    setTournaments(tournaments.map(t => t.id === updatedTournament.id ? updatedTournament : t));
  };

  const handleCreateTournament = () => {
    // Generate bracket structure based on participant count
    const roundsCount = Math.log2(newTournament.participantsCount || 8);
    const rounds = Array.from({ length: roundsCount }, (_, i) => {
      const roundNum = i + 1;
      let name = `Tur ${roundNum}`;
      if (roundNum === roundsCount) name = 'Final';
      else if (roundNum === roundsCount - 1) name = 'Yarı Final';
      else if (roundNum === roundsCount - 2) name = 'Çeyrek Final';
      return { id: roundNum, name };
    });

    const created: Tournament = {
      id: `tour_${Date.now()}`,
      name: newTournament.name || 'İsimsiz Turnuva',
      status: 'DRAFT',
      format: newTournament.format as TournamentFormat,
      participantsCount: newTournament.participantsCount || 8,
      prize: newTournament.prize || '-',
      startDate: newTournament.startDate || '-',
      location: newTournament.location || '-',
      rounds,
      registeredTeams: newTournament.registeredTeams || [],
      matches: [] // Matches will be generated when tournament starts
    };

    setTournaments([created, ...tournaments]);
    setActiveTournament(created);
    setViewState('MANAGE');
  };

  const toggleTeamRegistration = (team: Team) => {
    if (!activeTournament) return;
    
    const isRegistered = activeTournament.registeredTeams.some(t => t.id === team.id);
    let updatedTeams;
    
    if (isRegistered) {
      updatedTeams = activeTournament.registeredTeams.filter(t => t.id !== team.id);
    } else {
      if (activeTournament.registeredTeams.length >= activeTournament.participantsCount) return; // Full
      updatedTeams = [...activeTournament.registeredTeams, team];
    }

    const updatedTournament = { ...activeTournament, registeredTeams: updatedTeams };
    setActiveTournament(updatedTournament);
    setTournaments(tournaments.map(t => t.id === updatedTournament.id ? updatedTournament : t));
  };

  const generateBracket = () => {
    if (!activeTournament) return;
    
    // Simple random seeding for demonstration
    const shuffledTeams = [...activeTournament.registeredTeams].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());
    const matches: Match[] = [];
    let matchIdCounter = 100;

    // Generate Round 1 matches
    for (let i = 0; i < activeTournament.participantsCount; i += 2) {
      matches.push({
        id: matchIdCounter++,
        round: 1,
        team1: shuffledTeams[i] || null,
        team2: shuffledTeams[i + 1] || null,
        status: (shuffledTeams[i] && shuffledTeams[i+1]) ? 'UPCOMING' : 'PENDING'
      });
    }

    // Generate subsequent rounds (empty slots)
    for (let r = 2; r <= activeTournament.rounds.length; r++) {
      const matchesInRound = activeTournament.participantsCount / Math.pow(2, r);
      for (let i = 0; i < matchesInRound; i++) {
        matches.push({
          id: matchIdCounter++,
          round: r,
          team1: null,
          team2: null,
          status: 'PENDING'
        });
      }
    }

    const updatedTournament = { 
      ...activeTournament, 
      status: 'ONGOING' as const,
      matches 
    };
    
    setActiveTournament(updatedTournament);
    setTournaments(tournaments.map(t => t.id === updatedTournament.id ? updatedTournament : t));
    setViewState('BRACKET');
    setActiveRound(1);
  };

  const renderListView = () => (
    <div className="flex-1 p-6 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button onClick={onBack} className="p-2 bg-white/5 rounded-full hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors">
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
          </button>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-black italic">Turnuvalar</h2>
        </div>
        <button 
          onClick={() => setViewState('CREATE')}
          className="bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-slate-950 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 transition-colors"
        >
          <Plus size={18} /> Yeni Oluştur
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-4">
        {tournaments.map(tour => (
          <div 
            key={tour.id} 
            onClick={() => {
              setActiveTournament(tour);
              setViewState(tour.status === 'DRAFT' || tour.status === 'REGISTRATION' ? 'MANAGE' : 'BRACKET');
            }}
            className="bg-[#161B22] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-5 cursor-pointer hover:border-emerald-500/50 transition-all group"
          >
            <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-4">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-black text-white group-hover:text-emerald-400 transition-colors">{tour.name}</h3>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">
                  <Calendar size={12} /> {tour.startDate}
                  <span className="text-slate-600">•</span>
                  <MapPin size={12} /> {tour.location}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold border ${
                tour.status === 'ONGOING' ? 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 border-amber-500/30' :
                tour.status === 'DRAFT' ? 'bg-slate-500/20 text-slate-400 border-slate-500/30' :
                'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/30'
              }`}>
                {tour.status === 'ONGOING' ? 'DEVAM EDİYOR' : tour.status === 'DRAFT' ? 'TASLAK' : 'TAMAMLANDI'}
              </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 pt-4 border-t border-white/5">
              <div>
                <span className="block text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-bold uppercase mb-1">Format</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
                  {tour.format === 'SINGLE_ELIMINATION' ? 'Tek Maç Eleme' : 'Grup + Eleme'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div>
                <span className="block text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-bold uppercase mb-1">Takımlar</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">{tour.registeredTeams.length} / {tour.participantsCount}</span>
              </div>
              <div>
                <span className="block text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-bold uppercase mb-1">Ödül</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-medium text-amber-400">{tour.prize}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  const renderCreateView = () => (
    <div className="flex-1 p-6 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-8">
        <button onClick={() => setViewState('LIST')} className="p-2 bg-white/5 rounded-full hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors">
          <ArrowLeft size={20} />
        </button>
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-black italic">Yeni Turnuva Oluştur</h2>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-6 max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        {/* Basic Info */}
        <div className="bg-[#161B22] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-6 space-y-4">
          <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Settings size={16} /> Temel Ayarlar
          </h3>
          
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-2">Turnuva Adı</label>
            <input 
              type="text" 
              value={newTournament.name}
              onChange={(e) => setNewTournament({...newTournament, name: e.target.value})}
              className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 transition-colors"
              placeholder="Örn: Güz Kupası 2024"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-2">Format</label>
              <div className="relative">
                <select 
                  value={newTournament.format}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewTournament({...newTournament, format: e.target.value as TournamentFormat})}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white appearance-none focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 transition-colors"
                >
                  <option value="SINGLE_ELIMINATION">Tek Maç Eleme</option>
                  <option value="DOUBLE_ELIMINATION">Çift Maç Eleme</option>
                  <option value="GROUP_STAGE">Grup Aşaması + Eleme</option>
                </select>
                <ChevronDown size={16} className="absolute right-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 pointer-events-none" />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-2">Takım Sayısı</label>
              <div className="relative">
                <select 
                  value={newTournament.participantsCount}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewTournament({...newTournament, participantsCount: parseInt(e.target.value)})}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white appearance-none focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 transition-colors"
                >
                  <option value={4}>4 Takım</option>
                  <option value={8}>8 Takım</option>
                  <option value={16}>16 Takım</option>
                  <option value={32}>32 Takım</option>
                </select>
                <ChevronDown size={16} className="absolute right-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 pointer-events-none" />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Details */}
        <div className="bg-[#161B22] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-6 space-y-4">
          <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Info size={16} /> Detaylar
          </h3>
          
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-2">Başlangıç Tarihi</label>
              <input 
                type="date" 
                value={newTournament.startDate}
                onChange={(e) => setNewTournament({...newTournament, startDate: e.target.value})}
                className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 transition-colors"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-2">Konum / Saha</label>
              <input 
                type="text" 
                value={newTournament.location}
                onChange={(e) => setNewTournament({...newTournament, location: e.target.value})}
                className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 transition-colors"
                placeholder="Örn: Merkez Saha"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-2">Ödül Havuzu</label>
            <input 
              type="text" 
              value={newTournament.prize}
              onChange={(e) => setNewTournament({...newTournament, prize: e.target.value})}
              className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 transition-colors"
              placeholder="Örn: 10.000₺ + Kupa"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <button 
          onClick={handleCreateTournament}
          disabled={!newTournament.name}
          className="w-full bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-600 disabled:bg-slate-800 disabled:text-slate-500 text-slate-950 font-black py-4 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-colors text-lg"
        >
          <Save size={20} /> Turnuvayı Kaydet ve Takım Ekle
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  const renderManageView = () => {
    if (!activeTournament) return null;
    const isFull = activeTournament.registeredTeams.length >= activeTournament.participantsCount;

    return (
      <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
        {/* Manage Header */}
        <div className="p-6 bg-[#161B22] border-b border-white/10 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
            <button onClick={() => setViewState('LIST')} className="p-2 bg-white/5 rounded-full hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors">
              <ArrowLeft size={20} />
            </button>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-black italic">{activeTournament.name}</h2>
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">Takım Kayıt Aşaması</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-900 p-4 rounded-xl border border-white/5">
            <div>
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase">Kayıtlı Takımlar</span>
              <div className="text-2xl font-black mt-1">
                <span className={isFull ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-white'}>{activeTournament.registeredTeams.length}</span>
                <span className="text-slate-600"> / {activeTournament.participantsCount}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            <button 
              onClick={generateBracket}
              disabled={!isFull}
              className={`px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 transition-all ${
                isFull 
                  ? 'bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-slate-950 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(16,185,129,0.3)]' 
                  : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-500 cursor-not-allowed'
              }`}
            >
              <Play size={18} /> Kuraları Çek ve Başlat
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Team Selection Area */}
        <div className="flex-1 p-6 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar flex gap-6">
          {/* Available Teams */}
          <div className="flex-1 space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-300">Davet Edilebilir Takımlar</h3>
              <div className="relative">
                <Search size={16} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500" />
                <input 
                  type="text" 
                  placeholder="Takım ara..."
                  value={searchQuery}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                  className="bg-slate-900 border border-white/10 rounded-lg pl-9 pr-4 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 w-64"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              {AVAILABLE_TEAMS.filter(t => t.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())).map(team => {
                const isRegistered = activeTournament.registeredTeams.some(t => t.id === team.id);
                return (
                  <div 
                    key={team.id}
                    onClick={() => toggleTeamRegistration(team)}
                    className={`p-4 rounded-xl border flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                      isRegistered 
                        ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500/50' 
                        : 'bg-[#161B22] border-white/5 hover:border-white/20'
                    } ${!isRegistered && isFull ? 'opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed' : ''}`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 flex items-center justify-center text-xl">
                        {team.logo}
                      </div>
                      <span className="font-bold">{team.name}</span>
                    </div>
                    {isRegistered ? (
                      <CheckCircle2 className="text-emerald-500" />
                    ) : (
                      <Plus className="text-slate-500" />
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Selected Teams Sidebar */}
          <div className="w-80 bg-[#161B22] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col h-full">
            <h3 className="font-bold text-emerald-400 mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
              <CheckCircle2 size={18} /> Onaylanan Takımlar
            </h3>
            
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-2 custom-scrollbar pr-2">
              <AnimatePresence>
                {activeTournament.registeredTeams.map(team => (
                  <motion.div 
                    key={team.id}
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
                    exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
                    className="bg-slate-900 border border-white/5 rounded-lg p-3 flex items-center justify-between group"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="text-lg">{team.logo}</span>
                      <span className="text-sm font-medium">{team.name}</span>
                    </div>
                    <button 
                      onClick={() => toggleTeamRegistration(team)}
                      className="text-slate-500 hover:text-rose-400 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-all"
                    >
                      <X size={16} />
                    </button>
                  </motion.div>
                ))}
                {activeTournament.registeredTeams.length === 0 && (
                  <div className="text-center py-8 text-slate-500 text-sm">
                    Henüz takım eklenmedi.
                  </div>
                )}
              </AnimatePresence>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  const renderBracketView = () => {
    if (!activeTournament) return null;
    const currentRoundMatches = activeTournament.matches.filter(m => m.round === activeRound);

    return (
      <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="pt-12 pb-6 px-6 bg-slate-900 border-b border-white/5 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
            <button onClick={() => setViewState('LIST')} className="p-2 -ml-2 hover:bg-white/5 rounded-full transition-colors">
              <ArrowLeft className="w-6 h-6 text-slate-300" />
            </button>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 rounded-full text-xs font-bold border border-amber-500/30">
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400 animate-pulse" />
              DEVAM EDİYOR
            </div>
          </div>

          <h1 className="text-3xl font-black italic tracking-tight mb-2">{activeTournament.name}</h1>
          
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 text-sm text-slate-400">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-slate-800/50 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-white/5">
              <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
              {activeTournament.participantsCount} Takım
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-slate-800/50 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-white/5">
              <Trophy className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" />
              {activeTournament.prize}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Round Navigation */}
        <div className="px-6 py-4 bg-slate-900/50 border-b border-white/5 overflow-x-auto scrollbar-hide shrink-0">
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            {activeTournament.rounds.map((round) => (
              <button
                key={round.id}
                onClick={() => setActiveRound(round.id)}
                className={`px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold whitespace-nowrap transition-all ${
                  activeRound === round.id 
                    ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-white shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/20' 
                    : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                {round.name}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Bracket Content */}
        <div className="flex-1 p-6 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
          <motion.div
            key={activeRound}
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
            className="space-y-4 max-w-3xl mx-auto"
          >
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-emerald-400">
                {activeTournament.rounds.find(r => r.id === activeRound)?.name} Maçları
              </h3>
              <button 
                onClick={() => {
                  setEditingMatch(null);
                  setMatchFormData({ round: activeRound, status: 'UPCOMING' });
                  setIsMatchModalOpen(true);
                }}
                className="bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-500/30 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-bold flex items-center gap-2 transition-colors"
              >
                <PlusCircle size={16} /> Yeni Maç Ekle
              </button>
            </div>

            {currentRoundMatches.map((match) => (
              <div key={match.id} className="bg-[#161B22] border border-white/5 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-lg">
                {/* Match Header */}
                <div className="px-4 py-3 bg-slate-900/80 flex justify-between items-center border-b border-white/5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Swords size={14}/> Maç #{match.id}</span>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <span className={match.status === 'COMPLETED' ? 'text-slate-500' : 'text-emerald-400'}>
                      {match.date || 'Tarih Bekleniyor'}
                    </span>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 border-l border-white/10 pl-3 ml-1">
                      <button 
                        onClick={() => {
                          setEditingMatch(match);
                          setMatchFormData(match);
                          setIsMatchModalOpen(true);
                        }}
                        className="p-1 hover:text-blue-400 transition-colors"
                        title="Düzenle"
                      >
                        <Edit2 size={14} />
                      </button>
                      <button 
                        onClick={() => handleDeleteMatch(match.id)}
                        className="p-1 hover:text-rose-400 transition-colors"
                        title="Sil"
                      >
                        <Trash2 size={14} />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Teams */}
                <div className="p-4 space-y-3">
                  {/* Team 1 */}
                  <div className={`flex items-center justify-between ${match.status === 'COMPLETED' && match.team1?.score! > match.team2?.score! ? 'opacity-100' : match.status === 'COMPLETED' ? 'opacity-50' : ''}`}>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 flex items-center justify-center text-xl shadow-inner border border-white/5">
                        {match.team1?.logo || '?'}
                      </div>
                      <span className={`font-bold ${match.team1 ? 'text-white' : 'text-slate-500 italic'}`}>
                        {match.team1?.name || 'TBD'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      {match.team1?.penalties && <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">({match.team1.penalties})</span>}
                      <span className="text-2xl font-black text-white w-8 text-center">
                        {match.team1?.score !== null && match.team1?.score !== undefined ? match.team1.score : '-'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Divider */}
                  <div className="h-px w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/10 to-transparent" />

                  {/* Team 2 */}
                  <div className={`flex items-center justify-between ${match.status === 'COMPLETED' && match.team2?.score! > match.team1?.score! ? 'opacity-100' : match.status === 'COMPLETED' ? 'opacity-50' : ''}`}>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 flex items-center justify-center text-xl shadow-inner border border-white/5">
                        {match.team2?.logo || '?'}
                      </div>
                      <span className={`font-bold ${match.team2 ? 'text-white' : 'text-slate-500 italic'}`}>
                        {match.team2?.name || 'TBD'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      {match.team2?.penalties && <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">({match.team2.penalties})</span>}
                      <span className="text-2xl font-black text-white w-8 text-center">
                        {match.team2?.score !== null && match.team2?.score !== undefined ? match.team2.score : '-'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Action Area */}
                {match.status === 'UPCOMING' && (
                  <div className="px-4 py-3 bg-slate-900/50 border-t border-white/5 flex justify-end">
                    <button 
                      onClick={() => {
                        setEditingMatch(match);
                        setMatchFormData(match);
                        setIsMatchModalOpen(true);
                      }}
                      className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-300 flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors bg-emerald-500/10 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg"
                    >
                      Skor Gir <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
            
            {currentRoundMatches.length === 0 && (
              <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-500 bg-[#161B22] rounded-2xl border border-white/5">
                <Swords className="w-16 h-16 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-20" />
                <p className="font-medium">Bu tur için eşleşmeler henüz belli değil.</p>
              </div>
            )}
          </motion.div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#0A0E14] text-white flex flex-col font-sans">
      {viewState === 'LIST' && renderListView()}
      {viewState === 'CREATE' && renderCreateView()}
      {viewState === 'MANAGE' && renderManageView()}
      {viewState === 'BRACKET' && renderBracketView()}

      {/* Match Management Modal */}
      {isMatchModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm">
          <div className="bg-[#161B22] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl w-full max-w-lg overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]">
            <div className="p-4 border-b border-white/10 flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900">
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-white">
                {editingMatch ? 'Maçı Düzenle' : 'Yeni Maç Ekle'}
              </h3>
              <button onClick={() => setIsMatchModalOpen(false)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white">
                <X size={20} />
              </button>
            </div>
            
            <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar space-y-4">
              {/* Teams */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-2">1. Takım</label>
                  <select 
                    value={matchFormData.team1?.id || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const team = AVAILABLE_TEAMS.find(t => t.id === e.target.value) || null;
                      setMatchFormData({...matchFormData, team1: team});
                    }}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-white text-sm focus:border-emerald-500 outline-none"
                  >
                    <option value="">Seçiniz...</option>
                    {AVAILABLE_TEAMS.map(t => (
                      <option key={t.id} value={t.id}>{t.name}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-2">2. Takım</label>
                  <select 
                    value={matchFormData.team2?.id || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const team = AVAILABLE_TEAMS.find(t => t.id === e.target.value) || null;
                      setMatchFormData({...matchFormData, team2: team});
                    }}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-white text-sm focus:border-emerald-500 outline-none"
                  >
                    <option value="">Seçiniz...</option>
                    {AVAILABLE_TEAMS.map(t => (
                      <option key={t.id} value={t.id}>{t.name}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Score & Status */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                <div className="col-span-1">
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-2">Durum</label>
                  <select 
                    value={matchFormData.status}
                    onChange={(e) => setMatchFormData({...matchFormData, status: e.target.value as MatchStatus})}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-white text-sm focus:border-emerald-500 outline-none"
                  >
                    <option value="PENDING">Bekliyor</option>
                    <option value="UPCOMING">Yaklaşan</option>
                    <option value="ONGOING">Canlı</option>
                    <option value="COMPLETED">Tamamlandı</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div className="col-span-1">
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-2">1. Takım Skor</label>
                  <input 
                    type="number" 
                    value={matchFormData.team1?.score ?? ''}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const val = e.target.value === '' ? null : parseInt(e.target.value);
                      setMatchFormData({
                        ...matchFormData, 
                        team1: matchFormData.team1 ? { ...matchFormData.team1, score: val } : null
                      });
                    }}
                    disabled={matchFormData.status === 'PENDING' || matchFormData.status === 'UPCOMING'}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-white text-sm focus:border-emerald-500 outline-none disabled:opacity-50"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="col-span-1">
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-2">2. Takım Skor</label>
                  <input 
                    type="number" 
                    value={matchFormData.team2?.score ?? ''}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const val = e.target.value === '' ? null : parseInt(e.target.value);
                      setMatchFormData({
                        ...matchFormData, 
                        team2: matchFormData.team2 ? { ...matchFormData.team2, score: val } : null
                      });
                    }}
                    disabled={matchFormData.status === 'PENDING' || matchFormData.status === 'UPCOMING'}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-white text-sm focus:border-emerald-500 outline-none disabled:opacity-50"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Date & Location */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-2">Tarih / Saat</label>
                  <input 
                    type="text" 
                    value={matchFormData.date || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => setMatchFormData({...matchFormData, date: e.target.value})}
                    placeholder="Örn: 14 Eki, 21:00"
                    className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-white text-sm focus:border-emerald-500 outline-none"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-2">Saha / Konum</label>
                  <input 
                    type="text" 
                    value={matchFormData.location || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => setMatchFormData({...matchFormData, location: e.target.value})}
                    placeholder="Örn: Merkez Saha"
                    className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-white text-sm focus:border-emerald-500 outline-none"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-4 border-t border-white/10 bg-slate-900 flex justify-end gap-3">
              <button 
                onClick={() => setIsMatchModalOpen(false)}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-bold text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition-colors"
              >
                İptal
              </button>
              <button 
                onClick={handleSaveMatch}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-slate-950 rounded-lg text-sm font-bold transition-colors flex items-center gap-2"
              >
                <Save size={16} /> Kaydet
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default TournamentBracket;

          <span className="text-[5px] sm:text-[6px] font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-widest mt-0.5">Maç</span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col justify-center items-center bg-[#0A0E14] rounded-xl border border-yellow-500/20 shadow-inner">
          <span className="text-sm sm:text-base font-black text-yellow-500 leading-none">4</span>
          <span className="text-[5px] sm:text-[6px] font-bold text-yellow-500/70 uppercase tracking-widest mt-0.5">MOTM</span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col justify-center items-center bg-[#0A0E14] rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/20 shadow-inner">
          <span className="text-sm sm:text-base font-black text-emerald-400 leading-none">8.5</span>
          <span className="text-[5px] sm:text-[6px] font-bold text-emerald-500/70 uppercase tracking-widest mt-0.5">Puan</span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col justify-center items-center bg-[#0A0E14] rounded-xl border border-purple-500/20 shadow-inner">
          <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-black text-purple-400 leading-none">3-1</span>
          <span className="text-[5px] sm:text-[6px] font-bold text-purple-500/70 uppercase tracking-widest mt-0.5">Son Maç</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
};

const ProfileScreen: React.FC<ProfileScreenProps> = ({ role, onBack, onNavigate, onOpenDiaryEntry, isPro = false }) => {
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'LOYALTY' | 'DIARY' | 'TEAMS' | 'COMMUNITIES' | 'FRIENDS'>('COMMUNITIES');
    const { userTeams, addTeam } = useAppStore();
    const [activeStatInfo, setActiveStatInfo] = useState<'played' | 'motm' | 'rating' | 'last' | 'upcoming' | null>(null);


    // Create Team Modal State
    const [showCreateTeamModal, setShowCreateTeamModal] = useState(false);
    const [createStep, setCreateStep] = useState(1);
    const [newTeamName, setNewTeamName] = useState('');
    const [selectedLogo, setSelectedLogo] = useState('🦅');
    const [selectedPlayers, setSelectedPlayers] = useState<Player[]>([]);

    // Step 3: Formation Editing State
    const [draggedPlayerId, setDraggedPlayerId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const pitchRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

    const { globalTexts, friends, acceptFriend, removeFriend, addPendingFriend, selectedFriendsForTeam, toggleSelectedFriendForTeam, clearSelectedFriendsForTeam } = useAppStore();

    // Friends UI State
    const [friendSearch, setFriendSearch] = useState('');
    const [activeFriendTag, setActiveFriendTag] = useState('Tümü');
    const [showQuickSquadModal, setShowQuickSquadModal] = useState(false);
    const [quickSquadName, setQuickSquadName] = useState('');
    const [myCode] = useState(() => Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8).toUpperCase());
    const [codeInput, setCodeInput] = useState('');
    const [codeCopied, setCodeCopied] = useState(false);
    const [codeAccepted, setCodeAccepted] = useState(false);
    const [acceptedFriendId, setAcceptedFriendId] = useState<string | null>(null);



    // Friend helpers
    const copyCode = () => {
        navigator.clipboard?.writeText(myCode).catch(() => {});
        setCodeCopied(true);
        setTimeout(() => setCodeCopied(false), 2000);
    };

    const handleShareLink = () => {
        const url = `https://oyna.app/invite?ref=${myCode}`;
        if (navigator.share) { navigator.share({ title: 'OYNA Davet Linki', text: 'OYNA\'ya katılmak için bağlantıya tıkla!', url }).catch(() => {}); }
        else { navigator.clipboard?.writeText(url).catch(() => {}); alert('Davet linki kopyalandı!'); }
    };

    const handleCodeSubmit = () => {
        if (codeInput.length < 6) return;
        setCodeAccepted(true);
        setTimeout(() => { setCodeInput(''); setCodeAccepted(false); }, 2500);
    };

    const handleAcceptFriend = (id: string) => {
        setAcceptedFriendId(id);
        setTimeout(() => { acceptFriend(id); setAcceptedFriendId(null); }, 1000);
    };

    const LOGO_OPTIONS = ['🦅', '🦁', '🦈', '🐂', '⚡', '🔥', '🛡️', '⚔️', '🐲'];

    const mockCardData: PlayerCardData = {
        overall: 88,
        tier: 'gold',
        stats: {
            pace: { value: 85, videoUrl: 'https://example.com/video1' },
            shooting: { value: 88, videoUrl: 'https://example.com/video2' },
            passing: { value: 82, videoUrl: null },
            dribbling: { value: 90, videoUrl: 'https://example.com/video3' },
            defense: { value: 45, videoUrl: null },
            physical: { value: 78, videoUrl: null }
        }
    };

    const togglePlayerSelection = (player: Player) => {
        if (selectedPlayers.find(p => p.id === player.id)) {
            setSelectedPlayers(selectedPlayers.filter(p => p.id !== player.id));
        } else {
            // Add with default coords based on index to prevent stacking
            const count = selectedPlayers.length;
            const defaultX = 50;
            const defaultY = 50 + (count * 5);
            setSelectedPlayers([...selectedPlayers, { ...player, x: defaultX, y: defaultY }]);
        }
    };

    const applyFormation = (type: '2-3-1' | '3-2-1') => {
        const newPlayers = [...selectedPlayers];
        // Basic logic to distribute first 7 players
        const formations: any = {
            '2-3-1': [
                { x: 50, y: 15 }, // FW
                { x: 20, y: 45 }, // LM
                { x: 50, y: 45 }, // CM
                { x: 80, y: 45 }, // RM
                { x: 30, y: 80 }, // LB
                { x: 70, y: 80 }, // RB
                { x: 50, y: 92 }  // GK
            ],
            '3-2-1': [
                { x: 50, y: 15 }, // FW
                { x: 35, y: 50 }, // CM
                { x: 65, y: 50 }, // CM
                { x: 20, y: 80 }, // LB
                { x: 50, y: 85 }, // CB
                { x: 80, y: 80 }, // RB
                { x: 50, y: 92 }  // GK
            ]
        };

        const coords = formations[type];
        newPlayers.forEach((p, i) => {
            if (coords[i]) {
                p.x = coords[i].x;
                p.y = coords[i].y;
            }
        });
        setSelectedPlayers(newPlayers);
    };

    const rafRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

    const handlePointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
        if (draggedPlayerId && pitchRef.current) {
            const rect = pitchRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
            const x = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100;
            const y = ((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100;

            const clampedX = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, x));
            const clampedY = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, y));

            if (rafRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
            rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                setSelectedPlayers(prev => prev.map(p =>
                    p.id === draggedPlayerId ? { ...p, x: clampedX, y: clampedY } : p
                ));
            });
        }
    };

    const handlePointerUp = () => {
        if (rafRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
        setDraggedPlayerId(null);
    };

    const handleCreateTeam = () => {
        const newTeam: Team = {
            id: `team-${Date.now()}`,
            name: newTeamName,
            logo: selectedLogo,
            colors: ['#000000', '#FFFFFF'], // Default colors
            wins: 0,
            losses: 0,
            playStyle: 'Dengeli',
            roster: selectedPlayers
        };
        addTeam(newTeam);
        setShowCreateTeamModal(false);
        setCreateStep(1);
        setNewTeamName('');
    };

    const handleQuickSquadCreate = () => {
        if (!quickSquadName) return;
        
        // Find selected players from friends and convert them to Player objects (mock stats)
        const squadPlayers: Player[] = selectedFriendsForTeam.map((id, index) => {
            const f = friends.find(fr => fr.id === id);
            return {
                id: f?.id || `sq-${Date.now()}-${index}`,
                name: f?.name || 'Oyuncu',
                avatar: f?.avatar || '',
                style: f?.style as any,
                rating: 80,
                position: f?.position || 'CM',
                x: 50,
                y: 50 + (index * 5)
            };
        });

        const newTeam: Team = {
            id: `team-${Date.now()}`,
            name: quickSquadName,
            logo: '🦅',
            colors: ['#000000', '#FFFFFF'],
            wins: 0,
            losses: 0,
            playStyle: 'Dengeli',
            roster: squadPlayers
        };
        
        addTeam(newTeam);
        clearSelectedFriendsForTeam();
        setShowQuickSquadModal(false);
        setQuickSquadName('');
        setActiveTab('TEAMS'); // Redirect to Team tab
    };

    return (
        <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#0A0E14] font-sans relative flex flex-col">

            {/* Create Team Modal */}
            {showCreateTeamModal && (
                <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center animate-in fade-in duration-200">
                    <div className="bg-[#161B22] w-full max-w-md h-[90vh] sm:h-auto rounded-t-[32px] sm:rounded-[32px] border-t sm:border border-white/10 p-0 shadow-2xl relative animate-in slide-in-from-bottom duration-300 flex flex-col">

                        {/* Modal Header */}
                        <div className="p-6 border-b border-white/5 flex justify-between items-center">
                            <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-white">YENİ TAKIM KUR</h3>
                            <button onClick={() => setShowCreateTeamModal(false)} className="p-2 bg-white/5 rounded-full text-gray-400 hover:text-white">
                                <X size={20} />
                            </button>
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar p-6">
                            {createStep === 1 ? (
                                <div className="space-y-6 animate-in slide-in-from-right duration-300">
                                    <div>
                                        <label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase mb-2 block">Takım İsmi</label>
                                        <input
                                            type="text"
                                            value={newTeamName}
                                            onChange={(e) => setNewTeamName(e.target.value)}
                                            placeholder="Örn: Yenilmezler FC"
                                            className="w-full bg-[#0A0E14] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-4 text-white font-bold outline-none focus:border-[#FFFF00] transition-colors"
                                            autoFocus
                                        />
                                    </div>

                                    <div>
                                        <label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase mb-3 block">Logo Seçimi</label>
                                        <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-3">
                                            {LOGO_OPTIONS.map(logo => (
                                                <button
                                                    key={logo}
                                                    onClick={() => setSelectedLogo(logo)}
                                                    className={`aspect-square rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center text-2xl border transition-all ${selectedLogo === logo ? 'bg-[#FFFF00]/10 border-[#FFFF00] scale-110 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,255,0,0.3)]' : 'bg-[#0A0E14] border-white/5 hover:border-white/20'}`}
                                                >
                                                    {logo}
                                                </button>
                                            ))}
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            ) : createStep === 2 ? (
                                <div className="space-y-4 animate-in slide-in-from-right duration-300">
                                    <div className="bg-[#0A0E14] rounded-2xl p-3 border border-white/5 flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                                        <Search size={18} className="text-gray-500" />
                                        <input type="text" placeholder="Arkadaş Ara..." className="bg-transparent w-full text-sm text-white outline-none" />
                                    </div>

                                    <div className="space-y-2">
                                        {MOCK_FRIENDS.map(friend => {
                                            const isSelected = selectedPlayers.some(p => p.id === friend.id);
                                            return (
                                                <div
                                                    key={friend.id}
                                                    onClick={() => togglePlayerSelection(friend)}
                                                    className={`flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl border cursor-pointer transition-all ${isSelected ? 'bg-green-500/10 border-green-500/30' : 'bg-[#0A0E14] border-white/5 hover:border-white/10'}`}
                                                >
                                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                                                        <img src={friend.avatar} className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gray-700" />
                                                        <div>
                                                            <p className="text-sm font-bold text-white">{friend.name}</p>
                                                            <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500">{friend.position} • {friend.style}</p>
                                                        </div>
                                                    </div>
                                                    <div className={`w-6 h-6 rounded-full border-2 flex items-center justify-center ${isSelected ? 'bg-green-500 border-green-500' : 'border-gray-600'}`}>
                                                        {isSelected && <CheckCircle2 size={14} className="text-black" />}
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>
                                            );
                                        })}
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            ) : (
                                // STEP 3: Formation / Tactics
                                <div className="space-y-4 animate-in slide-in-from-right duration-300">
                                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                                        <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase">Sahadaki Diziliş</h3>
                                        <div className="flex gap-2">
                                            <button onClick={() => applyFormation('2-3-1')} className="px-2 py-1 bg-[#161B22] border border-white/10 rounded text-[10px] font-bold text-white hover:bg-white/10">2-3-1</button>
                                            <button onClick={() => applyFormation('3-2-1')} className="px-2 py-1 bg-[#161B22] border border-white/10 rounded text-[10px] font-bold text-white hover:bg-white/10">3-2-1</button>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>

                                    <div
                                        ref={pitchRef}
                                        className="relative w-full aspect-[2/3] max-h-[50vh] bg-[#1B4332] rounded-[24px] border-4 border-[#161B22] shadow-[inset_0_0_60px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] overflow-hidden touch-none"
                                        onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
                                        onPointerUp={handlePointerUp}
                                        onPointerLeave={handlePointerUp}
                                    >
                                        {/* Grass Stripes */}
                                        <div className="absolute inset-0 opacity-10 pointer-events-none" style={{ backgroundImage: 'repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent, transparent 10%, rgba(0,0,0,0.2) 10%, rgba(0,0,0,0.2) 20%)' }}></div>

                                        {/* Markings */}
                                        <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none opacity-40">
                                            <svg viewBox="0 0 680 1050" preserveAspectRatio="none" className="w-full h-full" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                                <g stroke="white" strokeWidth="6" fill="none" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                                                    {/* Dış Çizgiler */}
                                                    <rect x="20" y="20" width="640" height="1010" />
                                                    {/* Orta Saha Çizgisi */}
                                                    <line x1="20" y1="525" x2="660" y2="525" />
                                                    {/* Orta Yuvarlak */}
                                                    <circle cx="340" cy="525" r="90" />
                                                    {/* Başlama Noktası */}
                                                    <circle cx="340" cy="525" r="4" fill="white" />

                                                    {/* Üst Ceza Sahası */}
                                                    <rect x="140" y="20" width="400" height="150" />
                                                    {/* Üst Altı Pas */}
                                                    <rect x="240" y="20" width="200" height="50" />
                                                    {/* Üst Penaltı Noktası */}
                                                    <circle cx="340" cy="120" r="4" fill="white" />
                                                    {/* Üst Ceza Sahası Yayı */}
                                                    <path d="M 270 170 A 90 90 0 0 0 410 170" />

                                                    {/* Alt Ceza Sahası */}
                                                    <rect x="140" y="880" width="400" height="150" />
                                                    {/* Alt Altı Pas */}
                                                    <rect x="240" y="980" width="200" height="50" />
                                                    {/* Alt Penaltı Noktası */}
                                                    <circle cx="340" cy="930" r="4" fill="white" />
                                                    {/* Alt Ceza Sahası Yayı */}
                                                    <path d="M 270 880 A 90 90 0 0 1 410 880" />

                                                    {/* Köşe Yayları */}
                                                    <path d="M 20 60 A 40 40 0 0 0 60 20" />
                                                    <path d="M 620 20 A 40 40 0 0 0 660 60" />
                                                    <path d="M 20 990 A 40 40 0 0 1 60 1030" />
                                                    <path d="M 660 1030 A 40 40 0 0 0 620 990" />
                                                </g>
                                            </svg>
                                        </div>

                                        {/* Players */}
                                        {selectedPlayers.map((player) => (
                                            <div
                                                key={player.id}
                                                className="absolute transform -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing z-10 hover:z-20"
                                                style={{ left: `${player.x}%`, top: `${player.y}%` }}
                                                onPointerDown={(e) => {
                                                    e.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
                                                    setDraggedPlayerId(player.id);
                                                }}
                                            >
                                                <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
                                                    <div className={`relative w-10 h-10 rounded-full border-2 shadow-lg overflow-hidden ${draggedPlayerId === player.id ? 'border-[#FFFF00] scale-110' : 'border-white'}`}>
                                                        <img src={player.avatar} alt={player.name} className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                                                    </div>
                                                    <div className="bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[8px] font-bold text-white whitespace-nowrap">
                                                        {player.name}
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                        ))}
                                    </div>
                                    <p className="text-center text-[10px] text-gray-500">Oyuncuları sürükleyerek pozisyonlarını ayarla.</p>
                                </div>
                            )}
                        </div>

                        <div className="p-6 border-t border-white/5 bg-[#161B22] relative z-10">
                            {createStep === 1 ? (
                                <button
                                    onClick={() => setCreateStep(2)}
                                    disabled={!newTeamName}
                                    className="w-full h-14 bg-[#FFFF00] text-black font-black text-lg rounded-2xl disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed hover:bg-yellow-300 transition-colors"
                                >
                                    DEVAM ET
                                </button>
                            ) : createStep === 2 ? (
                                <div className="flex gap-3">
                                    <button
                                        onClick={() => setCreateStep(1)}
                                        className="w-1/3 h-14 bg-[#0A0E14] text-white font-bold text-sm rounded-2xl border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/5"
                                    >
                                        GERİ
                                    </button>
                                    <button
                                        onClick={() => setCreateStep(3)}
                                        disabled={selectedPlayers.length === 0}
                                        className="flex-1 h-14 bg-[#FFFF00] text-black font-black text-lg rounded-2xl hover:bg-yellow-300 transition-colors shadow-lg shadow-yellow-900/20 disabled:opacity-50"
                                    >
                                        DİZİLİŞ AYARLA ({selectedPlayers.length})
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                            ) : (
                                <div className="flex gap-3">
                                    <button
                                        onClick={() => setCreateStep(2)}
                                        className="w-1/3 h-14 bg-[#0A0E14] text-white font-bold text-sm rounded-2xl border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/5"
                                    >
                                        GERİ
                                    </button>
                                    <button
                                        onClick={handleCreateTeam}
                                        className="flex-1 h-14 bg-[#FFFF00] text-black font-black text-lg rounded-2xl hover:bg-yellow-300 transition-colors shadow-lg shadow-yellow-900/20 flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                                    >
                                        <Layout size={18} /> TAKIMI OLUŞTUR
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                            )}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            )}

            {/* Quick Squad Creation Modal */}
            {showQuickSquadModal && (
                <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center animate-in fade-in duration-200">
                    <div className="bg-[#161B22] w-full max-w-sm rounded-[32px] border border-white/10 p-6 shadow-2xl animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-200 text-center">
                        <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-[#FFFF00]/10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4 border border-[#FFFF00]/20">
                            <Shield className="text-[#FFFF00]" size={32} />
                        </div>
                        <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-white mb-2">HIZLI TAKIM KUR</h3>
                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-6">Seçtiğin {selectedFriendsForTeam.length} arkadaşınla anında bir Squad oluştur.</p>
                        
                        <input
                            type="text"
                            value={quickSquadName}
                            onChange={(e) => setQuickSquadName(e.target.value)}
                            placeholder="Takım İsmi (Örn: Gece Tayfası)"
                            className="w-full bg-[#0A0E14] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-4 text-white font-bold outline-none focus:border-[#FFFF00] transition-colors mb-4 text-center"
                            autoFocus
                        />
                        
                        <div className="flex gap-3">
                            <button onClick={() => setShowQuickSquadModal(false)} className="flex-1 py-4 bg-[#0A0E14] rounded-2xl border border-white/10 text-white font-bold text-sm hover:bg-white/5">İPTAL</button>
                            <button onClick={handleQuickSquadCreate} disabled={!quickSquadName} className="flex-[2] py-4 bg-[#FFFF00] rounded-2xl text-black font-black text-sm disabled:opacity-50 hover:bg-yellow-300 transition-colors shadow-lg shadow-yellow-900/20">OLUŞTUR</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            )}

            {/* Top App Bar - Fixed */}
            <div className="p-6 bg-[#0A0E14] border-b border-white/5 flex justify-between items-center z-30 relative">
                <button
                    onClick={onBack}
                    className="w-11 h-11 flex items-center justify-center bg-[#161B22] rounded-full text-white border border-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 active:scale-95 transition-all"
                >
                    <ArrowLeft size={20} />
                </button>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <span
                        className="text-sm font-bold text-white tracking-widest uppercase select-none"
                    >
                        {globalTexts?.profileTitle || 'PROFİL'}
                    </span>
                    <button onClick={() => onNavigate && onNavigate('SETTINGS')} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-white">
                        <Settings size={20} />
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
                {/* Profile Header */}
                <div className="p-6 bg-[#0A0E14] border-b border-white/5">
                    <div className="flex flex-col items-center pb-8">
                        <PlayerCard
                            name="Burak Kaptan"
                            photo="/player_card_photo.png"
                            cardData={mockCardData}
                            onShare={() => {
                                if (navigator.share) {
                                    navigator.share({
                                        title: 'Oyna Player Card',
                                        text: 'Check out my stats on Oyna App!',
                                        url: window.location.href,
                                    }).catch(console.error);
                                } else {
                                    alert('Sharing is not supported on this browser.');
                                }
                            }}
                        />

                        <div className="flex gap-8 mt-16">
                            <div className="text-center">
                                <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase mb-1">TOPLAM MAÇ</p>
                                <p className="text-2xl font-black text-white">42</p>
                            </div>
                            <div className="w-px h-10 bg-white/10"></div>
                            <div className="text-center">
                                <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase mb-1">GÜVENİLİRLİK</p>
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1 text-green-400">
                                    <Shield size={16} fill="currentColor" />
                                    <span className="text-2xl font-black">%100</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="w-full mt-6 px-1">
                            <StatisticsSummaryBtn onClick={() => setActiveStatInfo('played')} />
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                {/* Tabs */}
                <div className="px-6 pt-4 pb-2 bg-[#0A0E14] border-b border-white/5">
                    <div className="flex gap-5 overflow-x-auto custom-scrollbar">
                        {[
                            { id: 'DIARY', label: 'Maç Günlüğü' },
                            { id: 'TEAMS', label: 'Takımlarım' },
                            { id: 'COMMUNITIES', label: 'Topluluklar' },

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Trophy, Star, TrendingUp, Zap, ChevronRight, Share2, Award, Crown, CheckCircle2, Lock, PenLine, Save, Shield } from 'lucide-react';
import { MATCH_HISTORY } from '../constants'; // Import just to mock structure

interface PostMatchReportProps {
  onBack: () => void;
}

const PostMatchReport: React.FC<PostMatchReportProps> = ({ onBack }) => {
  const [step, setStep] = useState<'SUMMARY' | 'NOTE' | 'SAVED'>('SUMMARY');
  const [note, setNote] = useState('');
  
  // Mock Data for current match
  const currentMatch = {
      score: '5-3',
      result: 'WIN',
      pitch: 'Arena Beşiktaş',
      date: 'Bugün',
      mvp: 'Burak'
  };

  const handleSaveNote = () => {
      // Simulate API Save
      if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(50);
      setStep('SAVED');
  };

  // --- SUB-VIEWS ---

  if (step === 'SUMMARY') {
      return (
          <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#0A0E14] flex flex-col p-6 relative overflow-hidden">
              <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-full h-1/2 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#1B4332] to-[#0A0E14] opacity-20 z-0"></div>

              <div className="relative z-10 flex-1 flex flex-col justify-center items-center text-center animate-in zoom-in duration-500">
                  <p className="text-[#FFFF00] font-black tracking-widest uppercase mb-4">MAÇ SONUCU</p>
                  <h1 className="text-7xl font-black text-white mb-2">{currentMatch.score}</h1>
                  <div className="bg-[#1B4332] text-green-400 px-4 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wide border border-green-500/30 mb-8">
                      GALİBİYET
                  </div>

                  <div className="w-full max-w-xs bg-[#161B22] border border-white/5 rounded-[24px] p-6 mb-8">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-4">
                          <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-yellow-500/10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-yellow-500">
                              <Trophy size={24} />
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-left">
                              <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase">MAÇIN ADAMI</p>
                              <p className="text-xl font-black text-white">{currentMatch.mvp}</p>
                          </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="h-px bg-white/5 w-full mb-4"></div>
                      <div className="text-left">
                          <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">Takım performansı harikaydı. Güvenilirlik puanın arttı.</p>
                      </div>
                  </div>

                  <button 
                    onClick={() => setStep('NOTE')}
                    className="w-full max-w-xs h-16 bg-[#FFFF00] text-black font-black text-lg rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center gap-3 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(255,215,0,0.2)] hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-95 transition-all"
                  >
                      <PenLine size={20} /> KİŞİSEL NOT EKLE
                  </button>
                  <button onClick={onBack} className="mt-4 text-gray-500 text-xs font-bold hover:text-white">Şimdi Değil</button>
              </div>
          </div>
      );
  }

  if (step === 'NOTE') {
      return (
          <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#0A0E14] flex flex-col p-6">
              <header className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-6">
                  <button onClick={() => setStep('SUMMARY')} className="p-3 bg-[#161B22] rounded-full text-white border border-white/5">
                      <ChevronRight size={20} className="rotate-180" />

                  <h1 className="text-xl font-black text-white">Maç Günlüğü</h1>

                        onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)}
                        autoFocus
                      />

                      <div className="mt-4 text-[10px] text-gray-600 flex items-center gap-2">
                          <Shield size={12} /> Sadece senin görebileceğin özel alan.
                      </div>
                  </div>

                  <button

                    className="w-full h-16 bg-[#EF4444] disabled:bg-gray-800 disabled:text-gray-500 text-white font-black text-lg rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(239,68,68,0.3)] hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-95 transition-all"
                  >
                      <Save size={20} /> KAYDET

              PROFİLE DÖN
          </button>
      </div>

};

  show: { opacity: 1, x: 0, scale: 1, transition: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 340, damping: 26 } },
