import React, { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Plus, Trash2, Edit3, Check, X, Star, UploadCloud, Loader2, Wallet, Activity, MapPin, Shield, Award, TrendingUp, Clock, Target } from 'lucide-react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store';
import { Goalkeeper, Referee, Pitch, UserRole } from '../../types';
import { useImageUpload } from '../../hooks/useImageUpload';

// ── Shared helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
const Input: React.FC<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>> = (p) => (
    <input {...p} className={`w-full h-11 bg-black/50 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 text-sm text-white font-medium focus:outline-none focus:border-red-500/50 transition-all ${p.className || ''}`} />
);
const TA: React.FC<React.TextareaHTMLAttributes<HTMLTextAreaElement>> = (p) => (
    <textarea {...p} className="w-full h-20 bg-black/50 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm text-white font-medium focus:outline-none focus:border-red-500/50 transition-all resize-none" />
);
const F: React.FC<{ label: string; children: React.ReactNode; hint?: string }> = ({ label, children, hint }) => (
    <div className="mb-3">
        <label className="block text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-widest mb-1.5">{label}</label>
        {children}
        {hint && <p className="text-[9px] text-gray-600 mt-1">{hint}</p>}
    </div>
);
const Sel: React.FC<React.SelectHTMLAttributes<HTMLSelectElement> & { children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children, ...p }) => (
    <select {...p} className="w-full h-11 bg-black/50 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-red-500/50">{children}</select>
);
const StatRow: React.FC<{ label: string; value: number; color?: string }> = ({ label, value, color = 'red' }) => (
    <div className="mb-2">
        <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] mb-1">
            <span className="text-gray-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wide">{label}</span>
            <span className={`text-${color}-400 font-black`}>{value}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="h-1.5 bg-white/5 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
            <div className={`h-full bg-${color}-500 rounded-full`} style={{ width: `${value}%` }} />
        </div>
    </div>
);

// ── Toast ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const useToast = () => {
    const [msg, setMsg] = useState<{ text: string; ok: boolean } | null>(null);
    const show = useCallback((text: string, ok = true) => { setMsg({ text, ok }); setTimeout(() => setMsg(null), 2300); }, []);
    const Toast = () => (
        <AnimatePresence>
            {msg && (
                <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -16 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
                    className={`fixed top-4 right-4 z-[300] px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-black shadow-2xl border backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center gap-2 ${msg.ok ? 'bg-green-900/90 border-green-500/30 text-green-300' : 'bg-red-900/90 border-red-500/30 text-red-300'}`}>
                    <Check size={12} />{msg.text}
                </motion.div>
            )}
        </AnimatePresence>
    );
    return { show, Toast };
};

// ── Photo Upload Area ─────────────────────────────────────────────
const PhotoArea: React.FC<{ url: string; onChange: (url: string) => void; folder: string; label?: string }> = ({ url, onChange, folder, label = 'Fotoğraf' }) => {
    const { uploadImage, uploading, progress } = useImageUpload(folder);
    return (
        <F label={label}>
            <div className="flex gap-3 items-center">
                <div className={`w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed flex-shrink-0 overflow-hidden transition-all ${uploading ? 'border-red-500/50 bg-red-900/10' : 'border-white/15 bg-black/30 hover:border-red-500/30'}`}>
                    {url ? <img src={url} className="w-full h-full object-cover" /> :
                        <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center">
                            <UploadCloud size={18} className="text-gray-600" />
                        </div>}
                </div>
                <div className="flex-1 space-y-2">
                    <label className={`flex items-center justify-center gap-2 h-10 rounded-xl border text-[11px] font-black uppercase cursor-pointer transition-all ${uploading ? 'border-red-500/30 text-red-400 cursor-wait' : 'border-white/10 bg-white/5 text-gray-300 hover:bg-red-500/10 hover:text-red-400 hover:border-red-500/30'}`}>
                        {uploading ? <><Loader2 size={12} className="animate-spin" />%{Math.round(progress)} Yükleniyor</> : <><UploadCloud size={12} />Cihazdan Seç</>}
                        <input type="file" className="hidden" accept="image/*" disabled={uploading}
                            onChange={async e => { const file = e.target.files?.[0]; if (file) { const u = await uploadImage(file); if (u) onChange(u); } }} />
                    </label>
                    <Input value={url} onChange={e => onChange(e.target.value)} placeholder="veya URL yapıştır..." />
                </div>
            </div>
        </F>
    );
};

// ── Modal Wrapper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
const M: React.FC<{ title: string; subtitle?: string; onClose: () => void; children: React.ReactNode; onSave: () => void; saving?: boolean }> = ({ title, subtitle, onClose, children, onSave, saving }) => (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4" onClick={onClose}>
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
            className="w-full max-w-xl bg-[#0D1117] border border-white/10 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col"
            onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="flex justify-between items-start px-5 py-4 border-b border-white/5 bg-[#121820] shrink-0">
                <div>
                    <h3 className="text-sm font-black text-white uppercase tracking-widest">{title}</h3>
                    {subtitle && <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 mt-0.5">{subtitle}</p>}
                </div>
                <button onClick={onClose} className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-gray-400 hover:text-white flex items-center justify-center mt-0.5"><X size={15} /></button>
            </div>
            <div className="overflow-y-auto p-5 flex-1 custom-scrollbar space-y-1">{children}</div>
            <div className="p-4 border-t border-white/5 bg-[#121820] shrink-0 flex gap-3">
                <button onClick={onClose} className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/5 transition-all">İptal</button>
                <button onClick={onSave} disabled={!!saving}
                    className="flex-1 h-11 bg-gradient-to-r from-red-600 to-purple-700 rounded-xl text-white font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center justify-center gap-2 hover:opacity-90 transition-all disabled:opacity-50">
                    {saving ? <><Loader2 size={13} className="animate-spin" />Kaydediliyor...</> : <><Check size={13} />KAYDET & YAYINLA</>}
                </button>
            </div>
        </motion.div>
    </div>
);

// ── Stat Section Header ────────────────────────────────────────────
const SH: React.FC<{ icon: React.ReactNode; label: string; color?: string }> = ({ icon, label, color = 'gray' }) => (
    <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-black text-${color}-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-3 mt-5 first:mt-0`}>
        {icon}<span>{label}</span>
        <div className="flex-1 h-px bg-white/5" />
    </div>
);

// GOALKEEPER TAB

export const GoalkeeperTab: React.FC = () => {
    const { adminGoalkeepers, addGoalkeeper, updateGoalkeeper, deleteGoalkeeper } = useAppStore();
    const [modal, setModal] = useState<{ show: boolean; gk?: Goalkeeper }>({ show: false });
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    const { show: toast, Toast } = useToast();

    const blank = () => ({
        name: '', age: '', fee: '', bio: '', style: 'Shot-Stopper', height: '',
        avatar: '', isElite: false, rating: '4.5', matchCount: '0', totalEarnings: '0',
        cleanSheets: '0', savePercentage: '85', penaltySaveRate: '30',
        reflexes: '80', diving: '80', positioning: '80', distribution: '75', location: 'İstanbul'
    });
    const [f, setF] = useState(blank());

    const openAdd = () => { setF(blank()); setModal({ show: true }); };
    const openEdit = (gk: Goalkeeper) => {
        setF({
            name: gk.name, age: String(gk.age), fee: String(gk.fee), bio: gk.bio,
            style: gk.style, height: gk.height, avatar: gk.avatar, isElite: gk.isElite ?? false,
            rating: String(gk.rating), matchCount: String(gk.matchCount ?? 0),
            totalEarnings: String((gk.matchCount ?? 0) * gk.fee),
            cleanSheets: String(gk.stats?.cleanSheets ?? 0), savePercentage: String(gk.stats?.savePercentage ?? '85'),
            penaltySaveRate: String(gk.stats?.penaltySaveRate ?? '30'),
            reflexes: String(gk.skills?.reflexes ?? 80), diving: String(gk.skills?.diving ?? 80),
            positioning: String(gk.skills?.positioning ?? 80), distribution: String(gk.stats?.distribution ?? 75),
            location: (gk.preferredZones ?? ['İstanbul'])[0] ?? 'İstanbul'
        } as any);
        setModal({ show: true, gk });
    };

    const save = async () => {
        if (!f.name) return;
        setSaving(true);
        const base: Goalkeeper = {
            id: modal.gk?.id || `gk-${Date.now()}`,
            name: f.name, age: +f.age || 0, fee: +f.fee || 0, bio: f.bio,
            style: f.style, height: f.height,
            avatar: f.avatar || `https://i.pravatar.cc/150?u=${Date.now()}`,
            isElite: (f as any).isElite, rating: +f.rating, matchCount: +f.matchCount,
            coordinates: { lat: 41.058, lng: 29.002 },
            preferredZones: [f.location],
            recentAwards: '',
            stats: { savePercentage: f.savePercentage, cleanSheets: +f.cleanSheets, penaltySaveRate: f.penaltySaveRate, reflexes: +f.reflexes, diving: +f.diving, positioning: +f.positioning, distribution: +f.distribution, oneOnOne: 80, aerialReach: 80 },
            skills: { reflexes: +f.reflexes, diving: +f.diving, handling: 80, positioning: +f.positioning, kicking: +f.distribution, speed: 75 },
            equipment: { gloves: '', boots: '', jersey: '' }, reviews: []
        };
        if (modal.gk) await updateGoalkeeper(base);
        else await addGoalkeeper(base);
        setSaving(false);
        toast(`✅ ${f.name} ${modal.gk ? 'güncellendi' : 'eklendi'} ve Firebase\'e kaydedildi`);
        setModal({ show: false });
    };

    return (
        <div>
            <Toast />
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-5">
                <h2 className="text-xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter">Kaleciler <span className="text-red-400 text-sm">({adminGoalkeepers.length})</span></h2>
                <button onClick={openAdd} className="h-10 px-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-red-600 to-purple-700 rounded-xl text-white font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center gap-2 hover:opacity-90 transition-all">
                    <Plus size={14} /> YENİ KALECİ
                </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
                {adminGoalkeepers.map(gk => (
                    <div key={gk.id} className="bg-[#161B22] border border-white/5 rounded-2xl p-4 hover:border-white/10 transition-all">
                        {/* Card header */}
                        <div className="flex gap-3">
                            <div className="relative flex-shrink-0">
                                <img src={gk.avatar} className="w-16 h-16 rounded-xl object-cover border border-white/10 bg-gray-800" referrerPolicy="no-referrer" />
                                {gk.isElite && <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-5 h-5 bg-yellow-500 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[8px]">⭐</span>}
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-0.5">
                                    <p className="font-black text-white uppercase">{gk.name}</p>
                                    {gk.isElite && <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 text-[8px] font-black rounded">ELITE</span>}
                                </div>
                                <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 mb-2">{gk.style} • {gk.age} yaş • {gk.height}</p>
                                {/* Key stats inline */}
                                <div className="flex gap-3 text-[10px]">
                                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-yellow-400"><Star size={9} fill="currentColor" /><span className="font-black">{gk.rating}</span></span>
                                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-green-400"><Wallet size={9} /><span className="font-black">₺{gk.fee}/maç</span></span>
                                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-blue-400"><Activity size={9} /><span className="font-black">{gk.matchCount ?? 0} maç</span></span>
                                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-purple-400"><Shield size={9} /><span className="font-black">%{gk.stats?.savePercentage ?? '-'}</span></span>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 shrink-0">
                                <button onClick={() => openEdit(gk)} className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-blue-500/20"><Edit3 size={13} /></button>
                                <button onClick={() => { deleteGoalkeeper(gk.id); toast(`🗑️ ${gk.name} silindi`); }} className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-red-500/10 text-red-400 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-red-500/20"><Trash2 size={13} /></button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        {/* Earnings summary */}
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 mt-3">
                            {[
                                { label: 'Toplam Kazanç', value: `₺${((gk.matchCount ?? 0) * gk.fee).toLocaleString('tr')}`, color: 'text-green-400' },
                                { label: 'Gol Yememe', value: `${gk.stats?.cleanSheets ?? 0} maç`, color: 'text-blue-400' },
                                { label: 'Penaltı Kurtarma', value: `%${gk.stats?.penaltySaveRate ?? '-'}`, color: 'text-purple-400' },
                            ].map(s => (
                                <div key={s.label} className="bg-black/30 rounded-xl p-2 text-center border border-white/5">
                                    <p className="text-[8px] text-gray-600 uppercase mb-0.5">{s.label}</p>
                                    <p className={`text-xs font-black ${s.color}`}>{s.value}</p>
                                </div>
                            ))}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                ))}
            </div>

            <AnimatePresence>
                {modal.show && (
                    <M title={modal.gk ? `Kaleci Düzenle` : 'Yeni Kaleci Ekle'} subtitle={modal.gk?.name} onClose={() => setModal({ show: false })} onSave={save} saving={saving}>
                        <SH icon={<UploadCloud size={12} />} label="Fotoğraf & Kimlik" color="red" />
                        <PhotoArea url={(f as any).avatar || ''} onChange={url => setF(prev => ({ ...prev, avatar: url }))} folder="goalkeepers" />
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                            <F label="İsim Soyisim"><Input value={f.name} onChange={e => setF({ ...f, name: e.target.value })} placeholder="Tam adı..." /></F>
                            <F label="Boy"><Input value={f.height} onChange={e => setF({ ...f, height: e.target.value })} placeholder="1.90m" /></F>
                            <F label="Yaş"><Input type="number" value={f.age} onChange={e => setF({ ...f, age: e.target.value })} /></F>
                            <F label="Oyun Stili">
                                <Sel value={f.style} onChange={e => setF({ ...f, style: e.target.value })}>
                                    <option>Shot-Stopper</option><option>Sweeper</option><option>Pençe</option><option>Komutan</option><option>Refleks</option>
                                </Sel>
                            </F>
                        </div>

export const RefereeTab: React.FC = () => {
    const { adminReferees, addReferee, updateReferee, deleteReferee } = useAppStore();
    const [modal, setModal] = useState<{ show: boolean; ref?: Referee }>({ show: false });
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    const { show: toast, Toast } = useToast();

    const blank = () => ({
        name: '', fee: '', bio: '', style: 'Otoriter', level: 'Bölgesel', avatar: '',
        isElite: false, rating: '4.5', matchCount: '0', avgCards: '3.5',
        avgDistance: '10', authority: '85', fitness: '85', communication: '85',
        location: 'İstanbul'
    });
    const [f, setF] = useState(blank());

    const openAdd = () => { setF(blank()); setModal({ show: true }); };
    const openEdit = (ref: Referee) => {
        setF({
            name: ref.name, fee: String(ref.fee), bio: ref.bio, style: ref.style,
            level: ref.level, avatar: ref.avatar, isElite: ref.isElite ?? false,
            rating: String(ref.rating), matchCount: String(ref.matchCount ?? 0),
            avgCards: String(ref.stats?.avgCards ?? 3.5), avgDistance: String((ref.stats?.avgDistance ?? '10km').replace('km', '')),
            authority: String(ref.stats?.authority ?? 85), fitness: String(ref.stats?.fitness ?? 85),
            communication: String(ref.stats?.communication ?? 85),
            location: (ref.preferredZones ?? ['İstanbul'])[0] ?? 'İstanbul'
        } as any);
        setModal({ show: true, ref });
    };

    const save = async () => {
        if (!f.name) return;
        setSaving(true);
        const base: Referee = {
            id: modal.ref?.id || `ref-${Date.now()}`,
            name: f.name, fee: +f.fee || 0, bio: f.bio, style: f.style, level: f.level,
            avatar: f.avatar || `https://i.pravatar.cc/150?u=${Date.now()}`,
            isElite: (f as any).isElite, rating: +f.rating, matchCount: +f.matchCount,
            coordinates: { lat: 41.058, lng: 29.002 }, preferredZones: [f.location],
            stats: { avgCards: +f.avgCards, avgDistance: `${f.avgDistance}km`, authority: +f.authority, fitness: +f.fitness, communication: +f.communication },
            reviews: []
        };
        if (modal.ref) await updateReferee(base);
        else await addReferee(base);
        setSaving(false);
        toast(`✅ ${f.name} ${modal.ref ? 'güncellendi' : 'eklendi'} ve Firebase'e kaydedildi`);
        setModal({ show: false });
    };

    return (
        <div>
            <Toast />
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-5">
                <h2 className="text-xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter">Hakemler <span className="text-red-400 text-sm">({adminReferees.length})</span></h2>
                <button onClick={openAdd} className="h-10 px-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-red-600 to-purple-700 rounded-xl text-white font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center gap-2 hover:opacity-90 transition-all">
                    <Plus size={14} /> YENİ HAKEM
                </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
                {adminReferees.map(ref => (
                    <div key={ref.id} className="bg-[#161B22] border border-white/5 rounded-2xl p-4 hover:border-white/10 transition-all">
                        <div className="flex gap-3">
                            <div className="relative flex-shrink-0">
                                <img src={ref.avatar} className="w-16 h-16 rounded-xl object-cover border border-white/10 bg-gray-800" referrerPolicy="no-referrer" />
                                {ref.isElite && <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-5 h-5 bg-blue-500 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[8px]">⚡</span>}
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-0.5">
                                    <p className="font-black text-white uppercase">{ref.name}</p>
                                    {ref.isElite && <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 text-[8px] font-black rounded">ELITE</span>}
                                </div>
                                <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 mb-2">{ref.level} • {ref.style}</p>
                                <div className="flex gap-3 text-[10px]">
                                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-yellow-400"><Star size={9} fill="currentColor" /><span className="font-black">{ref.rating}</span></span>
                                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-green-400"><Wallet size={9} /><span className="font-black">₺{ref.fee}/maç</span></span>
                                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-blue-400"><Activity size={9} /><span className="font-black">{ref.matchCount ?? 0} maç</span></span>
                                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-red-400"><MapPin size={9} /><span className="font-black">{(ref.preferredZones ?? ['?'])[0]}</span></span>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 shrink-0">
                                <button onClick={() => openEdit(ref)} className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-blue-500/20"><Edit3 size={13} /></button>
                                <button onClick={() => { deleteReferee(ref.id); toast(`🗑️ ${ref.name} silindi`); }} className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-red-500/10 text-red-400 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-red-500/20"><Trash2 size={13} /></button>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                                { label: 'Oran. Mesafe', value: `${ref.stats?.avgDistance ?? '-'}`, color: 'text-purple-400' },
                            ].map(s => (

                                </div>
                            ))}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                ))}
            </div>

            <AnimatePresence>
                {modal.show && (
                    <M title={modal.ref ? 'Hakem Düzenle' : 'Yeni Hakem Ekle'} subtitle={modal.ref?.name} onClose={() => setModal({ show: false })} onSave={save} saving={saving}>
                        <SH icon={<UploadCloud size={12} />} label="Fotoğraf & Kimlik" color="blue" />
                        <PhotoArea url={(f as any).avatar || ''} onChange={url => setF(prev => ({ ...prev, avatar: url }))} folder="referees" />
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                            <F label="İsim Soyisim"><Input value={f.name} onChange={e => setF({ ...f, name: e.target.value })} /></F>
                            <F label="Kategori/Seviye">
                                <Sel value={f.level} onChange={e => setF({ ...f, level: e.target.value })}>
                                    <option>Başlangıç</option><option>Bölgesel</option><option>Ulusal</option><option>Süper Lig</option><option>FIFA</option>
                                </Sel>
                            </F>
                            <F label="Yönetim Stili">
                                <Sel value={f.style} onChange={e => setF({ ...f, style: e.target.value })}>
                                    <option>Otoriter</option><option>İletişimci</option><option>Sert</option><option>Dengeli</option>
                                </Sel>
                            </F>
                            <F label="Konum / Bölge"><Input value={f.location} onChange={e => setF({ ...f, location: e.target.value })} placeholder="İstanbul..." /></F>

export const PitchTab: React.FC = () => {
    const { adminPitches, addPitch, updatePitch, deletePitch } = useAppStore();
    const [modal, setModal] = useState<{ show: boolean; pitch?: Pitch }>({ show: false });
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    const { show: toast, Toast } = useToast();

    const blank = () => ({ name: '', district: '', location: '', pricePerPerson: '', totalPrice: '', image: '', amenities: '', lighting: '80', grassQuality: '80' });
    const [f, setF] = useState(blank());

    const openAdd = () => { setF(blank()); setModal({ show: true }); };
    const openEdit = (p: Pitch) => {
        setF({ name: p.name, district: p.district, location: p.location, pricePerPerson: String(p.pricePerPerson), totalPrice: String(p.totalPrice), image: p.image, amenities: p.amenities.join(', '), lighting: String(p.lighting), grassQuality: String(p.grassQuality) });
        setModal({ show: true, pitch: p });
    };

    const save = async () => {
        if (!f.name) return;
        setSaving(true);
        const id = modal.pitch?.id || `pitch-${Date.now()}`;
        const base: Pitch = { id, name: f.name, district: f.district, location: f.location, pricePerPerson: +f.pricePerPerson || 0, totalPrice: +f.totalPrice || 0, image: f.image || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1529900748604-07564a03e7a6?auto=format&fit=crop&q=80&w=1000', images: [], distance: '0 km', rating: 4.5, googleRating: 4.4, googleReviews: 0, amenities: f.amenities.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean), lighting: +f.lighting || 80, grassQuality: +f.grassQuality || 80, lockerRoomQuality: 80, goalQuality: 80, occupancy: 50, coordinates: { lat: 41.058, lng: 29.002 }, slots: [{ time: '19:00', status: 'available' }, { time: '21:00', status: 'available' }] };
        if (modal.pitch) await updatePitch({ ...modal.pitch, ...base });
        else await addPitch(base);
        setSaving(false);
        toast(`✅ ${f.name} ${modal.pitch ? 'güncellendi' : 'eklendi'}`);
        setModal({ show: false });
    };

    return (
        <div>
            <Toast />
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-5">
                <h2 className="text-xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter">Sahalar <span className="text-red-400 text-sm">({adminPitches.length})</span></h2>
                <button onClick={openAdd} className="h-10 px-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-red-600 to-purple-700 rounded-xl text-white font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center gap-2 hover:opacity-90 transition-all">
                    <Plus size={14} /> YENİ SAHA
                </button>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
                {adminPitches.map(p => (
                    <div key={p.id} className="bg-[#161B22] border border-white/5 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden hover:border-white/10 transition-all">
                        <div className="relative h-20">
                            <img src={p.image} className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-black/85 to-transparent flex items-center p-4 gap-3">
                                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                                    <p className="text-sm font-black text-white uppercase truncate">{p.name}</p>
                                    <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 mt-0.5">{p.district} • ₺{p.pricePerPerson}/kişi • ⭐{p.rating}</p>
                                    <div className="flex gap-2 mt-1">
                                        <span className="text-[9px] text-green-400">🌿 {p.grassQuality}%</span>
                                        <span className="text-[9px] text-yellow-400">💡 {p.lighting}%</span>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                                    <button onClick={() => openEdit(p)} className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-blue-500/30 backdrop-blur-sm"><Edit3 size={13} /></button>
                                    <button onClick={() => { deletePitch(p.id); toast(`🗑️ ${p.name} silindi`); }} className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-red-500/30 backdrop-blur-sm"><Trash2 size={13} /></button>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                ))}
            </div>
            <AnimatePresence>
                {modal.show && (
                    <M title={modal.pitch ? 'Saha Düzenle' : 'Yeni Saha Ekle'} subtitle={modal.pitch?.name} onClose={() => setModal({ show: false })} onSave={save} saving={saving}>
                        <PhotoArea url={f.image} onChange={url => setF(prev => ({ ...prev, image: url }))} folder="pitches" label="Saha Görseli" />
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                            <F label="Saha Adı"><Input value={f.name} onChange={e => setF({ ...f, name: e.target.value })} /></F>
                            <F label="İlçe"><Input value={f.district} onChange={e => setF({ ...f, district: e.target.value })} /></F>
                            <F label="Kişi Başı (₺)"><Input type="number" value={f.pricePerPerson} onChange={e => setF({ ...f, pricePerPerson: e.target.value })} /></F>
                            <F label="Toplam (₺)"><Input type="number" value={f.totalPrice} onChange={e => setF({ ...f, totalPrice: e.target.value })} /></F>
                            <F label="Aydınlatma (0-100)"><Input type="number" value={f.lighting} onChange={e => setF({ ...f, lighting: e.target.value })} /></F>
                            <F label="Zemin (0-100)"><Input type="number" value={f.grassQuality} onChange={e => setF({ ...f, grassQuality: e.target.value })} /></F>
                        </div>
                        <F label="Tam Adres"><Input value={f.location} onChange={e => setF({ ...f, location: e.target.value })} /></F>
                        <F label="Olanaklar (virgülle)"><Input value={f.amenities} onChange={e => setF({ ...f, amenities: e.target.value })} placeholder="Duş, Otopark, Kafe..." /></F>
                    </M>
                )}
            </AnimatePresence>
        </div>

// ── Toast ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const useToast = () => {
    const [msg, setMsg] = useState<{ text: string; ok: boolean } | null>(null);
    const show = useCallback((text: string, ok = true) => { setMsg({ text, ok }); setTimeout(() => setMsg(null), 2300); }, []);
    const Toast = () => (
        <AnimatePresence>
            {msg && (
                <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -16 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
                    className={`fixed top-4 right-4 z-[300] px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-black shadow-2xl border backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center gap-2 ${msg.ok ? 'bg-green-900/90 border-green-500/30 text-green-300' : 'bg-red-900/90 border-red-500/30 text-red-300'}`}>
                    <Check size={12} />{msg.text}
                </motion.div>
            )}
        </AnimatePresence>
    );
    return { show, Toast };
};

// ── Photo Upload Zone ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const AvatarUpload: React.FC<{ url: string; onChange: (url: string) => void }> = ({ url, onChange }) => {
    const { uploadImage, uploading, progress } = useImageUpload('users');
    return (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-4">
            <div className="relative flex-shrink-0">
                {url
                    ? <img src={url} className="w-20 h-20 rounded-2xl object-cover border-2 border-white/10" />
                    : <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-red-600 to-purple-700 flex items-center justify-center text-white font-black text-2xl">?</div>
                }
                <label className="absolute inset-0 rounded-2xl bg-black/50 opacity-0 hover:opacity-100 transition-all flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer">
                    {uploading
                        ? <><Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin text-white" /><span className="text-[9px] text-white mt-1">%{Math.round(progress)}</span></>
                        : <><UploadCloud size={14} className="text-white" /><span className="text-[9px] text-white mt-1">Yükle</span></>
                    }
                    <input type="file" className="hidden" accept="image/*" disabled={uploading}
                        onChange={async e => { const f = e.target.files?.[0]; if (f) { const u = await uploadImage(f); if (u) onChange(u); } }} />
                </label>
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1">
                <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 mb-2 font-bold uppercase tracking-widest">Avatar URL</p>
                <Input value={url} onChange={e => onChange(e.target.value)} placeholder="https://..." />
            </div>
        </div>
    );
};

// ── Toggle Switch ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const Toggle: React.FC<{ value: boolean; onChange: () => void; label: string; desc?: string; danger?: boolean; color?: string }> = ({ value, onChange, label, desc, danger, color = 'green' }) => (
    <div onClick={onChange} className={`flex items-center justify-between p-3.5 rounded-xl border cursor-pointer transition-all mb-2 ${danger ? 'border-red-900/30 bg-red-900/10 hover:bg-red-900/15' : 'border-white/5 bg-black/20 hover:bg-white/5'}`}>
        <div>
            <p className={`text-sm font-bold ${danger ? 'text-red-400' : 'text-white'}`}>{label}</p>
            {desc && <p className="text-[9px] text-gray-500 mt-0.5">{desc}</p>}
        </div>
        <div className={`w-11 h-6 rounded-full flex items-center transition-all px-1 flex-shrink-0 ml-4 ${value ? (danger ? 'bg-red-600' : `bg-${color}-500`) : 'bg-white/10'}`}>
            <div className={`w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-all ${value ? 'translate-x-5' : ''}`} />
        </div>
    </div>
);

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export const UsersTab: React.FC = () => {
    const { adminUsers, updateUser, banUser, unbanUser, toggleUserPro, verifyUser, addUser } = useAppStore();
    const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
    const [detailModal, setDetailModal] = useState<{ open: boolean; user: AdminUser | null }>({ open: false, user: null });
    const [editModal, setEditModal] = useState<{ open: boolean; user: AdminUser | null }>({ open: false, user: null });
    const [addModal, setAddModal] = useState(false);
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    const { show: toast, Toast } = useToast();

    const blankNew = () => ({
        name: '', email: '', phone: '', role: UserRole.PLAYER as UserRole,
        wallet: '0', rating: '4.0', matchCount: '0', joinDate: new Date().toLocaleDateString('tr'),
        avatar: '', isPro: false, isVerified: false, isBanned: false
    });
    const [newF, setNewF] = useState(blankNew());
    const [editF, setEditF] = useState<AdminUser | null>(null);

    const filtered = adminUsers.filter(u =>
        u.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
        u.email.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())
    );

    const handleAdd = async () => {
        if (!newF.name || !newF.email) return;
        setSaving(true);
        await addUser({
            id: `u-${Date.now()}`, name: newF.name, email: newF.email, phone: newF.phone,
            avatar: newF.avatar || `https://i.pravatar.cc/150?u=${Date.now()}`,
            role: newF.role, rating: +newF.rating || 4.0, isVerified: newF.isVerified,
            isBanned: newF.isBanned, isPro: newF.isPro,
            joinDate: newF.joinDate || new Date().toLocaleDateString('tr'),
            matchCount: +newF.matchCount || 0, wallet: +newF.wallet || 0
        });
        setSaving(false);
        toast(`✅ ${newF.name} eklendi`);
        setAddModal(false);
        setNewF(blankNew());
    };

    const handleSaveEdit = async () => {
        if (!editF) return;
        setSaving(true);
        await updateUser(editF);
        setSaving(false);
        toast(`✅ ${editF.name} güncellendi`);
        setEditModal({ open: false, user: null });
    };

    const handleBan = async (u: AdminUser) => {
        if (u.isBanned) {
            await fbBanUser(u.id, false);
            unbanUser(u.id);
            toast(`✅ ${u.name} yasağı kaldırıldı`);
        } else {
            await fbBanUser(u.id, true);
            banUser(u.id);
            toast(`🚫 ${u.name} banlandı`, false);
        }
    };

    const handlePro = async (u: AdminUser) => {
        await fbToggleUserPro(u.id, !u.isPro);
        toggleUserPro(u.id);
        toast(u.isPro ? `📉 ${u.name} PRO kaldırıldı` : `⭐ ${u.name} PRO yapıldı`);
    };

    const openEdit = (u: AdminUser) => { setEditF({ ...u }); setEditModal({ open: true, user: u }); };

    const ModalFooter = ({ onSave }: { onSave: () => void }) => (
        <div className="flex gap-3 pt-1">
            <button onClick={() => { setAddModal(false); setEditModal({ open: false, user: null }); }} className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/5 transition-all">İptal</button>
            <button onClick={onSave} disabled={saving} className="flex-1 h-11 bg-gradient-to-r from-red-600 to-purple-700 rounded-xl text-white font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center justify-center gap-2 hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-50">
                {saving ? <><Loader2 size={13} className="animate-spin" />Kaydediliyor...</> : <><Check size={13} />KAYDET & YAYINLA</>}
            </button>
        </div>
    );

    return (
        <div>
            <Toast />
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
                <h2 className="text-xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter">Kullanıcılar <span className="text-red-400 text-sm">({adminUsers.length})</span></h2>
                <button onClick={() => { setNewF(blankNew()); setAddModal(true); }}
                    className="h-10 px-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-red-600 to-purple-700 rounded-xl text-white font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center gap-2 hover:opacity-90 transition-all">
                    <Plus size={14} /> YENİ KULLANICI
                </button>
            </div>

            <input value={search} onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)} placeholder="İsim veya e-posta ile ara..."
                className="w-full h-11 bg-black/50 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 text-sm text-white mb-4 focus:outline-none focus:border-red-500/50 transition-all" />

            <div className="space-y-2">
                {filtered.map(u => {
                    const rc = roleConfig[u.role] || roleConfig[UserRole.PLAYER];
                    return (
                        <div key={u.id} className={`bg-[#161B22] border rounded-2xl p-4 transition-all ${u.isBanned ? 'border-red-900/40 opacity-70' : 'border-white/5 hover:border-white/10'}`}>
                            {/* User header */}
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                                <div className="relative flex-shrink-0">
                                    <img src={u.avatar} className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl object-cover border border-white/10 bg-gray-800" referrerPolicy="no-referrer" />
                                    {u.isBanned && <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-xl bg-red-900/70 flex items-center justify-center"><Ban size={14} className="text-red-400" /></div>}
                                    {u.isPro && !u.isBanned && <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-4 h-4 bg-purple-500 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[7px] font-black text-white">P</span>}
                                </div>
                                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                                        <p className="text-sm font-black text-white">{u.name}</p>
                                        <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[8px] font-black rounded uppercase ${rc.bg} ${rc.color}`}>{u.role}</span>
                                        {u.isPro && <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-400 text-[8px] font-black rounded">PRO</span>}
                                        {u.isVerified && <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-teal-500/20 text-teal-400 text-[8px] font-black rounded">✓</span>}
                                    </div>
                                    <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 truncate mt-0.5">{u.email}</p>
                                </div>
                                {/* Rating + wallet quick view */}
                                <div className="text-right shrink-0">
                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 justify-end">
                                        <Star size={10} className="text-yellow-400 fill-yellow-400" />
                                        <span className="text-xs font-black text-white">{u.rating}</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <span className="text-[10px] text-yellow-400 font-mono font-black">₺{u.wallet.toLocaleString('tr')}</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            {/* Stats row */}
                            <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 mt-3">
                                {[
                                    { label: 'Maç', value: u.matchCount, icon: Activity },
                                    { label: 'Cüzdan', value: `₺${u.wallet.toLocaleString('tr')}`, icon: Wallet, green: true },
                                    { label: 'Katılım', value: u.joinDate, icon: Calendar },
                                    { label: 'Rating', value: u.rating, icon: Star, yellow: true },
                                ].map(s => (
                                    <div key={s.label} className="bg-black/30 rounded-xl p-2 text-center border border-white/5">
                                        <p className="text-[8px] text-gray-600 uppercase mb-0.5">{s.label}</p>
                                        <p className={`text-xs font-black ${s.green ? 'text-yellow-400' : s.yellow ? 'text-yellow-400' : 'text-white'}`}>{s.value}</p>
                                    </div>
                                ))}
                            </div>

                            {/* Actions */}
                            <div className="flex gap-1.5 mt-3 flex-wrap">
                                <button onClick={() => openEdit(u)} className="flex-1 min-w-0 h-8 rounded-lg bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400 hover:bg-blue-500/20 text-[10px] font-black uppercase flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-all">
                                    <Edit3 size={11} /> Düzenle
                                </button>
                                {!u.isVerified && (
                                    <button onClick={() => { verifyUser(u.id); toast(`✅ ${u.name} doğrulandı`); }} className="flex-1 min-w-0 h-8 rounded-lg bg-teal-500/10 text-teal-400 hover:bg-teal-500/20 text-[10px] font-black uppercase flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-all">
                                        <UserCheck size={11} /> Doğrula
                                    </button>
                                )}
                                <button onClick={() => handlePro(u)} className="flex-1 min-w-0 h-8 rounded-lg bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-400 hover:bg-purple-500/20 text-[10px] font-black uppercase flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-all">
                                    {u.isPro ? <><ZapOff size={11} />PRO Kaldır</> : <><Zap size={11} />PRO Yap</>}
                                </button>
                                <button onClick={() => handleBan(u)} className={`flex-1 min-w-0 h-8 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-black uppercase flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-all ${u.isBanned ? 'bg-green-500/10 text-green-400 hover:bg-green-500/20' : 'bg-red-500/10 text-red-400 hover:bg-red-500/20'}`}>
                                    {u.isBanned ? <><Check size={11} />Yasağı Kaldır</> : <><Ban size={11} />Banla</>}
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    );
                })}
            </div>

            {/* ── ADD MODAL ── */}
            <AnimatePresence>
                {addModal && (
                    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4" onClick={() => setAddModal(false)}>
                        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
                            className="w-full max-w-xl bg-[#0D1117] border border-white/10 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col"
                            onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
                            <div className="flex justify-between items-center px-5 py-4 border-b border-white/5 bg-[#121820] shrink-0">
                                <div>
                                    <h3 className="text-sm font-black text-white uppercase tracking-widest">Yeni Kullanıcı Ekle</h3>
                                    <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 mt-0.5">Firebase'e direkt kullanıcı ekle</p>
                                </div>
                                <button onClick={() => setAddModal(false)} className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-white/5 text-gray-400 hover:text-white flex items-center justify-center"><X size={15} /></button>
                            </div>
                            <div className="overflow-y-auto p-5 flex-1 custom-scrollbar">
                                <AvatarUpload url={newF.avatar} onChange={url => setNewF(prev => ({ ...prev, avatar: url }))} />
                                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                                    <F label="İsim Soyisim"><Input value={newF.name} onChange={e => setNewF({ ...newF, name: e.target.value })} placeholder="Tam adı..." /></F>
                                    <F label="Kayıt Tarihi"><Input value={newF.joinDate} onChange={e => setNewF({ ...newF, joinDate: e.target.value })} /></F>
                                </div>
                                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                                    <F label="E-posta"><Input value={newF.email} onChange={e => setNewF({ ...newF, email: e.target.value })} /></F>
                                    <F label="Telefon"><Input value={newF.phone} onChange={e => setNewF({ ...newF, phone: e.target.value })} placeholder="+90 5xx..." /></F>
                                </div>
                                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                                    <F label="Rol">
                                        <Sel value={newF.role} onChange={e => setNewF({ ...newF, role: e.target.value as UserRole })}>
                                            {Object.values(UserRole).map(r => <option key={r} value={r}>{r}</option>)}
                                        </Sel>
                                    </F>
                                    <F label="Cüzdan Bakiyesi (₺)"><Input type="number" value={newF.wallet} onChange={e => setNewF({ ...newF, wallet: e.target.value })} className="text-yellow-400 font-mono" /></F>
                                </div>
                                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                                    <F label="Rating (0-5)" hint="Başlangıç puanı"><Input type="number" step="0.1" min="0" max="5" value={newF.rating} onChange={e => setNewF({ ...newF, rating: e.target.value })} /></F>
                                    <F label="Başlangıç Maç Sayısı"><Input type="number" value={newF.matchCount} onChange={e => setNewF({ ...newF, matchCount: e.target.value })} /></F>
                                </div>
                                <div className="mt-2 space-y-2">
                                    <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-black uppercase tracking-widest mb-2">Hesap Özellikleri</p>
                                    <Toggle label="PRO Üyelik" desc="Özel maçlar ve indirimler" value={newF.isPro} onChange={() => setNewF(p => ({ ...p, isPro: !p.isPro }))} color="purple" />
                                    <Toggle label="Doğrulanmış Hesap" desc="Mavi tik rozeti" value={newF.isVerified} onChange={() => setNewF(p => ({ ...p, isVerified: !p.isVerified }))} color="teal" />
                                    <Toggle label="Hesabı Banla" desc="Kullanıcı sisteme giremez" value={newF.isBanned} onChange={() => setNewF(p => ({ ...p, isBanned: !p.isBanned }))} danger />
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div className="p-4 border-t border-white/5 bg-[#121820] shrink-0">
                                <ModalFooter onSave={handleAdd} />
                            </div>
                        </motion.div>
                    </div>
                )}
            </AnimatePresence>

            {/* ── EDIT MODAL ── */}
            <AnimatePresence>
                {editModal.open && editF && (
                    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4" onClick={() => setEditModal({ open: false, user: null })}>
                        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
                            className="w-full max-w-xl bg-[#0D1117] border border-white/10 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col"
                            onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
                            <div className="flex justify-between items-center px-5 py-4 border-b border-white/5 bg-[#121820] shrink-0">
                                <div>
                                    <h3 className="text-sm font-black text-white uppercase tracking-widest">Kullanıcı Düzenle</h3>
                                    <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 mt-0.5">{editF.name} — ID: {editF.id}</p>
                                </div>
                                <button onClick={() => setEditModal({ open: false, user: null })} className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-white/5 text-gray-400 hover:text-white flex items-center justify-center"><X size={15} /></button>
                            </div>
                            <div className="overflow-y-auto p-5 flex-1 custom-scrollbar">
                                <AvatarUpload url={editF.avatar} onChange={url => setEditF(prev => prev ? { ...prev, avatar: url } : null)} />
                                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                                    <F label="İsim Soyisim"><Input value={editF.name} onChange={e => setEditF(p => p ? { ...p, name: e.target.value } : null)} /></F>
                                    <F label="Kayıt Tarihi"><Input value={editF.joinDate} onChange={e => setEditF(p => p ? { ...p, joinDate: e.target.value } : null)} /></F>
                                </div>
                                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                                    <F label="E-posta"><Input value={editF.email} onChange={e => setEditF(p => p ? { ...p, email: e.target.value } : null)} /></F>
                                    <F label="Telefon"><Input value={editF.phone} onChange={e => setEditF(p => p ? { ...p, phone: e.target.value } : null)} /></F>
                                </div>
                                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                                    <F label="Rol">
                                        <Sel value={editF.role} onChange={e => setEditF(p => p ? { ...p, role: e.target.value as UserRole } : null)}>
                                            {Object.values(UserRole).map(r => <option key={r} value={r}>{r}</option>)}
                                        </Sel>
                                    </F>
                                    <F label="Rating (0-5)"><Input type="number" step="0.1" min="0" max="5" value={editF.rating} onChange={e => setEditF(p => p ? { ...p, rating: +e.target.value } : null)} /></F>
                                </div>
                                {/* Wallet */}
                                <div className="p-4 bg-black/30 rounded-2xl border border-yellow-500/20 mb-3">
                                    <p className="text-[9px] font-black text-yellow-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-3 flex items-center gap-2"><Wallet size={11} /> CÜZDAN KONTROLÜ</p>
                                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 items-end">
                                        <F label="Bakiye (₺)" hint="Net tutar">
                                            <Input type="number" value={editF.wallet} onChange={e => setEditF(p => p ? { ...p, wallet: +e.target.value } : null)} className="text-yellow-400 font-mono text-base" />
                                        </F>
                                        <div className="flex gap-1.5 pb-3">
                                            <button onClick={() => setEditF(p => p ? { ...p, wallet: p.wallet + 100 } : null)} className="flex-1 h-11 bg-green-500/15 text-green-400 border border-green-500/20 rounded-xl text-xs font-black hover:bg-green-500/25 transition-all">+₺100</button>
                                            <button onClick={() => setEditF(p => p ? { ...p, wallet: p.wallet + 500 } : null)} className="flex-1 h-11 bg-green-500/15 text-green-400 border border-green-500/20 rounded-xl text-xs font-black hover:bg-green-500/25 transition-all">+₺500</button>
                                            <button onClick={() => setEditF(p => p ? { ...p, wallet: 0 } : null)} className="flex-1 h-11 bg-red-500/15 text-red-400 border border-red-500/20 rounded-xl text-xs font-black hover:bg-red-500/25 transition-all">0</button>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                {/* Match stats */}
                                <F label="Tamamlanan Maç Sayısı" hint="Profilde görüntülenir">
                                    <Input type="number" value={editF.matchCount} onChange={e => setEditF(p => p ? { ...p, matchCount: +e.target.value } : null)} />
                                </F>
                                {/* Status toggles */}
                                <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
                                    <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-black uppercase tracking-widest mb-2">Hesap Durumları</p>
                                    <Toggle label="PRO Üyelik" desc="Özel maçlar ve indirimler" value={editF.isPro} onChange={() => setEditF(p => p ? { ...p, isPro: !p.isPro } : null)} color="purple" />
                                    <Toggle label="Doğrulanmış Hesap" desc="Mavi tik rozeti" value={editF.isVerified} onChange={() => setEditF(p => p ? { ...p, isVerified: !p.isVerified } : null)} color="teal" />
                                    <Toggle label="Hesabı Banla" desc="Kullanıcı sisteme giremez, aktif rezervasyonları iptal edilir" value={editF.isBanned} onChange={() => setEditF(p => p ? { ...p, isBanned: !p.isBanned } : null)} danger />
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div className="p-4 border-t border-white/5 bg-[#121820] shrink-0">
                                <ModalFooter onSave={handleSaveEdit} />
                            </div>
                        </motion.div>
                    </div>
                )}
            </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
    );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import {
    ChevronLeft, Activity, MapPin, Shield, Scale,
    Users, Bell, Settings, Type, Zap, Swords, Radio
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store';
import AdminLogin from './AdminLogin';
import { GoalkeeperTab, RefereeTab, PitchTab } from './EntityTabs';
import { UsersTab } from './UsersTab';
import { MatchesTab, NotificationsTab } from './MatchNotifTabs';
import { SettingsTab, ContentTab, MetricsTab } from './SettingsContentTabs';
import GodViewPanel from './GodViewPanel';

interface Props { onBack: () => void; }

type TabId = 'GOD_VIEW' | 'METRICS' | 'PITCHES' | 'GOALKEEPERS' | 'REFEREES' | 'MATCHES' | 'USERS' | 'NOTIFICATIONS' | 'CONTENT' | 'SETTINGS';

const TABS: { id: TabId; label: string; icon: React.FC<any>; group: string }[] = [
    { id: 'GOD_VIEW', label: 'God View', icon: Radio, group: 'KOMUTA' },
    { id: 'METRICS', label: 'Genel', icon: Activity, group: 'ÖZET' },
    { id: 'PITCHES', label: 'Sahalar', icon: MapPin, group: 'VERİLER' },

    { id: 'SETTINGS', label: 'Ayarlar', icon: Settings, group: 'SİSTEM' },
];

const GROUPS = ['KOMUTA', 'ÖZET', 'VERİLER', 'YÖNETİM', 'SİSTEM'];

const AdminPanel: React.FC<Props> = ({ onBack }) => {
    const [unlocked, setUnlocked] = useState(false);
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<TabId>('GOD_VIEW');
    const { appSettings } = useAppStore();

    if (!unlocked) return <AdminLogin onUnlock={() => setUnlocked(true)} onBack={onBack} />;

    // God View renders full-screen without chrome
    if (activeTab === 'GOD_VIEW') {
        return <GodViewPanel onBack={() => setActiveTab('METRICS')} onNavigate={(tab) => setActiveTab(tab as TabId)} />;
    }

    const renderTab = () => {
        switch (activeTab) {
            case 'METRICS': return <MetricsTab />;
            case 'PITCHES': return <PitchTab />;
            case 'GOALKEEPERS': return <GoalkeeperTab />;
            case 'REFEREES': return <RefereeTab />;
            case 'MATCHES': return <MatchesTab />;
            case 'USERS': return <UsersTab />;
            case 'NOTIFICATIONS': return <NotificationsTab />;
            case 'CONTENT': return <ContentTab />;
            case 'SETTINGS': return <SettingsTab />;
        }
    };

    return (
        <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#050812] text-white font-sans flex flex-col">
            {/* Rainbow top bar */}
            <div className="h-0.5 w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-red-600 via-purple-600 to-blue-600 shrink-0" />

            {/* Header */}
            <header className="px-5 py-4 flex items-center justify-between bg-[#161B22]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/5 sticky top-0 z-30 shrink-0">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <button onClick={onBack} className="w-10 h-10 flex items-center justify-center bg-white/5 rounded-full border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10 transition-all text-gray-400 hover:text-white">
                        <ChevronLeft size={20} />
                    </button>
                    <div>
                        <h1 className="text-lg font-black tracking-tighter uppercase flex items-center gap-2">
                            <Zap className="text-red-500" size={18} /> PATRON PANELİ
                        </h1>
                        <p className="text-[9px] text-red-400 font-mono font-bold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase flex items-center gap-1">
                            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-red-500 animate-pulse" />
                            {appSettings.maintenanceMode ? 'BAKIM MODU AKTİF' : 'CANLI BACKEND BAĞLANTISI'}
                        </p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right">
                    <p className="text-[9px] text-gray-500 font-mono uppercase tracking-widest">{appSettings.appName} OS v3.0</p>
                    <p className="text-[9px] text-gray-600 font-mono">Master Yetki</p>
                </div>
            </header>

            <div className="flex flex-1 overflow-hidden">
                {/* ── Sidebar ─────────────────────────────── */}
                <aside className="w-52 bg-[#161B22]/50 border-r border-white/5 flex flex-col overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar shrink-0 hidden md:flex">
                    {GROUPS.map(group => {
                        const groupTabs = TABS.filter(t => t.group === group);
                        return (
                            <div key={group} className="px-3 pt-5 pb-1">
                                <p className="text-[9px] text-gray-600 font-black uppercase tracking-widest px-2 mb-2">{group}</p>
                                {groupTabs.map(({ id, label, icon: Icon }) => {
                                    const active = activeTab === id;
                                    return (
                                        <button
                                            key={id}
                                            onClick={() => setActiveTab(id)}
                                            className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl mb-0.5 transition-all text-left ${active ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-red-500/20 to-transparent border-l-2 border-red-500 text-white pl-2.5' : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5'}`}
                                        >
                                            <Icon size={15} className={active ? 'text-red-400' : ''} />
                                            <span className="text-xs font-black tracking-wide uppercase">{label}</span>
                                        </button>
                                    );
                                })}
                            </div>
                        );
                    })}
                </aside>

                {/* ── Mobile horizontal tab strip ────────── */}
                <div className="md:hidden fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-[#161B22]/95 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-white/5 z-40 flex overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar px-2 py-2 gap-1">
                    {TABS.map(({ id, label, icon: Icon }) => {
                        const active = activeTab === id;
                        return (
                            <button key={id} onClick={() => setActiveTab(id)}
                                className={`shrink-0 flex flex-col items-center gap-0.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl transition-all ${active ? 'bg-red-500/20 text-red-400' : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-white'}`}>
                                <Icon size={16} />
                                <span className="text-[8px] font-black uppercase whitespace-nowrap">{label}</span>
                            </button>
                        );
                    })}
                </div>

                {/* ── Main content ─────────────────────────── */}
                <main className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar p-5 md:p-8 pb-24 md:pb-8">
                    <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
                        <motion.div key={activeTab} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -8 }} transition={{ duration: 0.15 }}>
                            {renderTab()}
                        </motion.div>
                    </AnimatePresence>
                </main>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
};

export default AdminPanel;

const Input: React.FC<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>> = (p) => (
    <input {...p} className="w-full h-11 bg-black/50 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 text-sm text-white font-medium focus:outline-none focus:border-red-500/50 transition-all" />
);
const F: React.FC<{ label: string; children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ label, children }) => (
    <div className="mb-4"><label className="block text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-widest mb-1.5">{label}</label>{children}</div>
);
const Toggle: React.FC<{ value: boolean; onChange: () => void; label: string; desc?: string; danger?: boolean }> = ({ value, onChange, label, desc, danger }) => (
    <div className={`flex items-center justify-between p-4 rounded-2xl border mb-2 ${danger ? 'border-red-900/30 bg-red-900/10' : 'border-white/5 bg-black/20'}`}>
        <div>
            <p className={`text-sm font-black ${danger ? 'text-red-400' : 'text-white'}`}>{label}</p>
            {desc && <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 mt-0.5">{desc}</p>}
        </div>
        <div onClick={onChange} className={`w-12 h-7 rounded-full flex items-center cursor-pointer transition-all ${value ? (danger ? 'bg-red-600' : 'bg-green-500') : 'bg-white/10'}`}>
            <div className={`w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-all mx-1 ${value ? 'translate-x-5' : ''}`} />
        </div>
    </div>
);

// ── In-app Toast for Settings ────────────────────────────────────────
const useToast = () => {
    const [msg, setMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const show = useCallback((m: string) => { setMsg(m); setTimeout(() => setMsg(null), 2500); }, []);
    const Toast = () => (
        <AnimatePresence>
            {msg && (
                <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20, x: '-50%' }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, x: '-50%' }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
                    className="fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 z-[200] px-5 py-3 bg-green-900/90 border border-green-500/30 rounded-xl text-green-300 text-sm font-black backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center gap-2 shadow-2xl">
                    <Check size={14} className="text-green-400" />{msg}
                </motion.div>
            )}
        </AnimatePresence>
    );
    return { show, Toast };
};

export const ContentTab: React.FC = () => {
    const { globalTexts, setGlobalText } = useAppStore();
    const [local, setLocal] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
    const { show, Toast } = useToast();

    useEffect(() => { if (globalTexts) setLocal({ ...globalTexts }); }, [globalTexts]);

    const save = () => {
        Object.entries(local).forEach(([k, v]) => setGlobalText(k, String(v)));
        show('✅ Tüm metinler Firebase\'e güncellendi!');
    };

    const keyLabel: Record<string, string> = {
        dashboardTitle: 'Ana Sayfa Başlığı',
        dashboardSubtitle: 'Ana Sayfa Alt Başlık',
        communityViewTitle: 'Topluluklar Başlığı',
        profileTitle: 'Profil Başlığı',
        matchDiscoveryTitle: 'Maç Bul Başlığı',
        marketplaceGkTitle: 'Kaleci Kiralama Başlığı',
        marketplaceRefTitle: 'Hakem Kiralama Başlığı',
        pitchDiscoveryTitle: 'Saha Kiralama Başlığı',
        opponentFinderTitle: 'Rakip Bul Başlığı',
        walletTitle: 'Cüzdan Başlığı',
        studioTitle: 'Taktik Studio Başlığı',
    };

    return (
        <div>
            <Toast />
            <div className="flex justify-between items-end mb-6">
                <div>
                    <h2 className="text-xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter mb-1">Metin Editörü</h2>
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Tüm ekran başlık ve yazılarını canlı değiştir</p>
                </div>
                <button onClick={save} className="h-10 px-5 bg-gradient-to-r from-red-600 to-purple-700 rounded-xl text-white font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center gap-2 hover:opacity-90 transition-all">
                    <Save size={14} /> YAYINLA
                </button>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-[#161B22] border border-white/5 rounded-3xl p-5">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    {Object.entries(local).map(([key, value]) => (
                        <div key={key}>
                            <label className="block text-[10px] text-red-300 font-mono tracking-widest mb-1.5">{keyLabel[key] || key}</label>
                            <textarea
                                value={value}
                                onChange={e => setLocal({ ...local, [key]: e.target.value })}
                                className="w-full h-16 bg-black/50 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm text-white font-bold focus:outline-none focus:border-red-500/50 resize-none transition-all"
                            />

    );

// METRICS TAB

export const MetricsTab: React.FC = () => {
    const { adminPitches, adminGoalkeepers, adminReferees, adminMatches, adminUsers, adminNotifications, updateAppSettings, appSettings } = useAppStore();
    const activeUsers = adminUsers.filter(u => !u.isBanned).length;
    const proUsers = adminUsers.filter(u => u.isPro).length;
    const { show, Toast } = useToast();
    const [dangerOps, setDangerOps] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});

    const runDangerOp = async (label: string, action: () => Promise<void> | void) => {
        setDangerOps(prev => ({ ...prev, [label]: true }));
        await Promise.resolve(action());
        setTimeout(() => {
            setDangerOps(prev => ({ ...prev, [label]: false }));
            show(`✅ ${label} başarıyla tamamlandı`);
        }, 1500);
    };

    const stats = [
        { label: 'Aktif Saha', value: adminPitches.length, icon: MapPin, color: 'green' },
        { label: 'Kaleci', value: adminGoalkeepers.length, icon: Shield, color: 'emerald' },
        { label: 'Hakem', value: adminReferees.length, icon: Scale, color: 'blue' },
        { label: 'Aktif Maç', value: adminMatches.length, icon: Activity, color: 'yellow' },
        { label: 'Kullanıcı', value: activeUsers, icon: Users, color: 'purple' },
        { label: 'Pro Üye', value: proUsers, icon: Activity, color: 'red' },
    ];

    const totalRevenue = adminMatches.reduce((acc, m) => acc + m.price, 0);
    const commissionEarned = Math.round(totalRevenue * appSettings.commissionRate / 100);

    return (
        <div className="space-y-6">
            <Toast />
            <h2 className="text-xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter">Kontrol Paneli</h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                {stats.map(({ label, value, icon: Icon, color }) => (
                    <div key={label} className="bg-[#161B22] border border-white/5 rounded-2xl p-5 relative overflow-hidden group">
                        <Icon size={18} className={`text-${color}-400 mb-3 opacity-50`} />
                        <p className="text-[9px] text-gray-500 font-bold tracking-widest uppercase mb-1">{label}</p>
                        <p className="text-3xl font-black text-white">{value}</p>
                    </div>
                ))}
            </div>

            {/* Revenue summary */}
            <div className="bg-[#161B22] border border-white/5 rounded-3xl p-5">
                <h3 className="text-xs font-black text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-4 flex items-center gap-2"><Activity size={14} /> GELİR ÖZETİ</h3>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                    {[['Toplam Ciro', `₺${totalRevenue.toLocaleString('tr')}`], ['Komisyon (%' + appSettings.commissionRate + ')', `₺${commissionEarned.toLocaleString('tr')}`], ['Net Gelir', `₺${(totalRevenue - commissionEarned).toLocaleString('tr')}`]].map(([l, v]) => (
                        <div key={l as string} className="bg-black/30 rounded-xl p-3 border border-white/5 text-center">
                            <p className="text-[9px] text-gray-500 uppercase mb-1">{l}</p>
                            <p className="text-lg font-black text-white">{v}</p>
                        </div>
                    ))}
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* System health */}
            <div className="bg-[#161B22] border border-white/5 rounded-3xl p-5">
                <h3 className="text-xs font-black text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-4 flex items-center gap-2"><Database size={14} /> SİSTEM SAĞLIĞI</h3>
                <div className="space-y-2 font-mono text-xs">
                    {[
                        { label: 'Firestore DB', status: 'ONLINE', latency: '12ms', ok: true },
                        { label: 'Auth Service', status: 'ONLINE', latency: '8ms', ok: true },
                        { label: 'Storage Bucket', status: 'ONLINE', latency: '24ms', ok: true },
                        { label: 'Payment Gateway', status: 'DEGRADED', latency: '145ms', ok: false },
                    ].map(({ label, status, latency, ok }) => (
                        <div key={label} className="flex justify-between items-center bg-black/30 p-3 rounded-lg border border-white/5">
                            <span className="text-gray-400">{label}</span>
                            <span className={ok ? 'text-green-400' : 'text-yellow-400'} >
                                <span className={`inline-block w-2 h-2 rounded-full mr-2 animate-pulse ${ok ? 'bg-green-400' : 'bg-yellow-400'}`} />
                                {status} ({latency})
                            </span>
                        </div>
                    ))}
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* Danger zone */}
            <div className="bg-red-900/10 border border-red-900/30 rounded-3xl p-5">
                <h3 className="text-xs font-black text-red-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-4 flex items-center gap-2"><AlertTriangle size={14} /> TEHLİKELİ BÖLGE</h3>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    {[
                        { label: 'Önbelleği Temizle', icon: RefreshCw, action: () => { /* clear local state caches */ } },
                        { label: 'DB Senkronizasyonu', icon: Database, action: () => updateAppSettings({ ...appSettings }) },
                        { label: 'Config Deploy', icon: Terminal, action: () => { /* force-write all settings */ } },
                    ].map(({ label, icon: Icon, action }) => (
                        <button key={label}
                            onClick={() => runDangerOp(label, action)}
                            disabled={!!dangerOps[label]}
                            className={`px-4 h-10 rounded-xl text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2 border transition-all ${dangerOps[label] ? 'bg-yellow-900/30 text-yellow-400 border-yellow-500/30 cursor-wait' : 'bg-white/5 hover:bg-red-500/10 hover:text-red-400 text-white border-white/10'}`}>
                            <Icon size={13} className={dangerOps[label] ? 'animate-spin' : ''} /> {dangerOps[label] ? 'Çalışıyor...' : label}
                        </button>
                    ))}
                </div>
                <p className="text-[9px] text-gray-600 mt-3">⚠️ Bu işlemler geri alınamaz. Sorumlu kullanın.</p>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
};

'bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 border-yellow-500/30' : 'bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border-red-500/30'}`}>{pitch.status}</span>
                    <span className="font-mono">{pitch.fill}/{pitch.total} oyuncu</span>
                </div>
                <div className="w-full h-2 bg-white/10 rounded-full mt-3 overflow-hidden">
                    <div className={`h-full rounded-full ${pitch.fill / pitch.total >= 0.9 ? 'bg-green-500' : pitch.fill / pitch.total >= 0.6 ? 'bg-yellow-500' : 'bg-red-500'}`} style={{ width: `${(pitch.fill / pitch.total) * 100}%` }} />
                </div>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-center">
                {[['Doluluk', `${Math.round((pitch.fill / pitch.total) * 100)}%`], ['Kalan Yer', String(pitch.total - pitch.fill)], ['Durum', pitch.status]].map(([l, v]) => (
                    <div key={l} className="bg-black/30 rounded-xl p-3 border border-white/5">
                        <p className="text-[8px] text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-widest mb-1">{l}</p>
                        <p className="text-sm font-black text-white">{v}</p>
                    </div>
                ))}
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 pt-2">
                <ActionBtn label="Sahayı Düzenle" color="bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400 border-blue-500/20 hover:bg-blue-500/20" icon={<Edit3 size={12} />} onClick={() => { onNavigate('PITCHES'); onClose(); }} />
                <ActionBtn label="Maça Müdahale" color="bg-yellow-500/10 text-yellow-400 border-yellow-500/20" icon={<AlertTriangle size={12} />} onClick={() => { onNavigate('MATCHES'); onClose(); }} />
                <ActionBtn label="Sahayı Sil" color="bg-red-500/10 text-red-400 border-red-500/20 hover:bg-red-500/20" icon={<Trash2 size={12} />} onClick={onClose} />
            </div>
        </div>
    </ModalShell>
);

                    </>
