// ── PUSH NOTIFICATION MODAL ────────────────────────────────────────
export const PushModal: React.FC<{ target?: string; onClose: () => void }> = ({ target, onClose }) => {
    const { addNotification } = useAppStore();
    const [title, setTitle] = useState(target ? `📢 ${target} Maç Duyurusu` : '');
    const [body, setBody] = useState(target ? `${target} için hızlı hareket et! Sınırlı yer kaldı.` : '');
    const [audience, setAudience] = useState('ALL');
    const [sent, setSent] = useState(false);

    const doSend = () => {
        if (!title || !body) return;
        addNotification({ id: `push-${Date.now()}`, title, body, type: 'INFO', targetAudience: audience as any, sentAt: new Date().toLocaleString('tr'), isActive: true });
        setSent(true);
        setTimeout(onClose, 1400);
    };

    return (
        <ModalShell title="BİLDİRİM GÖNDER" onClose={onClose}>
            {sent ? (
                <div className="text-center py-8">
                    <div className="text-4xl mb-3">📲</div>
                    <p className="text-green-400 font-black text-sm">Bildirim gönderildi!</p>
                </div>
            ) : (
                <div className="space-y-3">
                    <div><label className="text-[9px] text-gray-400 font-black uppercase tracking-widest block mb-1.5">Başlık</label>
                        <input value={title} onChange={e => setTitle(e.target.value)} className="w-full h-11 bg-black/50 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-red-500/50" /></div>
                    <div><label className="text-[9px] text-gray-400 font-black uppercase tracking-widest block mb-1.5">Mesaj</label>
                        <textarea value={body} onChange={e => setBody(e.target.value)} rows={3} className="w-full bg-black/50 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-red-500/50 resize-none" /></div>
                    <div><label className="text-[9px] text-gray-400 font-black uppercase tracking-widest block mb-1.5">Hedef Kitle</label>
                        <select value={audience} onChange={e => setAudience(e.target.value)} className="w-full h-11 bg-black/50 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 text-sm text-white focus:outline-none">
                            <option value="ALL">Herkes</option><option value="CAPTAIN">Kaptanlar</option><option value="GK">Kaleciler</option><option value="REFEREE">Hakemler</option><option value="PRO">Pro Üyeler</option>
                        </select></div>
                    <button onClick={doSend} className="w-full h-12 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-blue-700 rounded-xl text-white font-black uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center justify-center gap-2 mt-2 hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(59,130,246,0.3)] transition-all">
                        <Send size={14} /> GÖNDER
                    </button>
                </div>
            )}
        </ModalShell>
    );
};

// ── ADD PLAYER MODAL ───────────────────────────────────────────────
export const AddPlayerModal: React.FC<{ matchId: string; onClose: () => void }> = ({ matchId, onClose }) => {
    const { adminUsers } = useAppStore();
    const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
    const [added, setAdded] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const available = adminUsers.filter(u => !u.isBanned && (u.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) || u.email.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())));

    const doAdd = (user: typeof adminUsers[0]) => {
        setAdded(user.name);
        setTimeout(onClose, 1400);
    };

    return (
        <ModalShell title={`OYUNCU EKLE — ${matchId}`} onClose={onClose} wide>
            {added ? (
                <div className="text-center py-8"><div className="text-4xl mb-3">✅</div><p className="text-green-400 font-black">{added} maça eklendi</p></div>
            ) : (
                <div className="space-y-3">
                    <input value={search} onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)} placeholder="Oyuncu ara..." className="w-full h-11 bg-black/50 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-red-500/50" />
                    <div className="space-y-2 max-h-72 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
                        {available.map(u => (
                            <div key={u.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 bg-black/30 rounded-xl border border-white/5 hover:border-white/10 transition-all">
                                <img src={u.avatar} className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-gray-800 object-cover" referrerPolicy="no-referrer" />
                                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                                    <p className="text-sm font-black text-white truncate">{u.name}</p>
                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1"><Star size={9} className="text-yellow-400 fill-yellow-400" /><span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">{u.rating} • {u.matchCount} maç</span></div>
                                </div>
                                <button onClick={() => doAdd(u)} className="h-9 px-4 bg-green-500/15 text-green-400 border border-green-500/25 hover:bg-green-500/25 rounded-xl text-[10px] font-black uppercase transition-all flex items-center gap-1">
                                    <UserPlus size={11} /> Ekle
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                </div>
            )}
        </ModalShell>
    );
};

// ── REVENUE MODAL ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const RevenueModal: React.FC<{ onClose: () => void }> = ({ onClose }) => {

    return (
        <ModalShell title="GELİR ANALİZİ" onClose={onClose} wide>
            <div className="space-y-3">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">

                        <div key={l} className="bg-black/30 rounded-2xl p-4 border border-white/5 text-center">
                            <p className="text-[8px] text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-widest mb-1">{l}</p>
                            <p className="text-xl font-black text-white">{v}</p>
                        </div>
                    ))}
                </div>
                <div className="bg-black/30 rounded-2xl p-4 border border-white/5">
                    <p className="text-[9px] text-gray-400 font-black uppercase tracking-widest mb-3">Maç Bazında Gelir</p>
                    {adminMatches.slice(0, 5).map(m => (
                        <div key={m.id} className="flex justify-between py-1.5 border-b border-white/5 last:border-0 text-xs">
                            <span className="text-gray-400">{m.title}</span>
                            <span className="font-black text-white">₺{m.price}</span>
                        </div>
                    ))}
                </div>
            </div>
        </ModalShell>
    );
};

--- FILE: ./views/admin/GodViewDataTables.tsx ---
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useAppStore, AdminUser } from '../../store';
import { Edit2, Search, Trash2, ShieldOff, Shield, Star, StarOff, CheckCircle, XCircle, Wallet } from 'lucide-react';
import { Pitch, Goalkeeper, Referee } from '../../types';
import { fbDeleteGoalkeeper, fbDeleteReferee, fbBanUser, fbToggleUserPro, fbVerifyUser } from '../../firebaseMutations';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';

interface GodViewDataTablesProps {
    activeTab: 'SAHALAR' | 'KULLANICILAR' | 'KALECİLER' | 'HAKEMLER';
    onEditPitch: (pitch: Pitch) => void;
    onEditUser: (user: AdminUser) => void;
    onEditGk: (gk: Goalkeeper) => void;
    onEditRef: (ref: Referee) => void;
    onDeletePitch: (id: string) => void;
    onDeleteUser: (id: string) => void;
    onDeleteGk: (id: string) => void;
    onDeleteRef: (id: string) => void;
    onAddPitch?: () => void;
}

// ── Mini In-table Toast ── 
const useToast = () => {
    const [msg, setMsg] = useState<{ text: string; ok: boolean } | null>(null);
    const show = (text: string, ok = true) => { setMsg({ text, ok }); setTimeout(() => setMsg(null), 2200); };
    const Toast = () => (
        <AnimatePresence>
            {msg && (
                <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
                    className={`fixed top-4 right-4 z-[300] px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-black shadow-2xl border ${msg.ok ? 'bg-green-900/90 border-green-500/30 text-green-300' : 'bg-red-900/90 border-red-500/30 text-red-300'}`}>
                    {msg.text}
                </motion.div>
            )}
        </AnimatePresence>
    );
    return { show, Toast };
};

export const GodViewDataTables: React.FC<GodViewDataTablesProps> = ({
    activeTab,
    onEditPitch,
    onEditUser,
    onEditGk,
    onEditRef,
    onDeletePitch,
    onDeleteUser,
    onDeleteGk,
    onDeleteRef,
    onAddPitch,
}) => {
    const { adminPitches, adminUsers, adminGoalkeepers, adminReferees } = useAppStore();
    const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
    const { show, Toast } = useToast();

    const handleDeleteGk = async (id: string, name: string) => {
        if (!window.confirm(`"${name}" silinsin mi?`)) return;
        await fbDeleteGoalkeeper(id);
        onDeleteGk(id);
        show(`✅ ${name} silindi`);
    };
    const handleDeleteRef = async (id: string, name: string) => {
        if (!window.confirm(`"${name}" silinsin mi?`)) return;
        await fbDeleteReferee(id);
        onDeleteRef(id);
        show(`✅ ${name} silindi`);
    };
    const handleBanToggle = async (user: AdminUser) => {
        const next = !user.isBanned;
        await fbBanUser(user.id, next);
        show(next ? `🚫 ${user.name} banlandı` : `✅ ${user.name} banı kaldırıldı`, !next);
    };
    const handleProToggle = async (user: AdminUser) => {
        const next = !user.isPro;
        await fbToggleUserPro(user.id, next);
        show(next ? `⭐ ${user.name} PRO yapıldı` : `📉 ${user.name} PRO kaldırıldı`);
    };
    const handleVerify = async (user: AdminUser) => {
        await fbVerifyUser(user.id);
        show(`✅ ${user.name} doğrulandı`);
    };

    // ─── PITCHES TABLE ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    const GradeBadge = ({ g }: { g?: 'A' | 'B' | 'C' }) => {
        if (!g) return <span className="text-gray-600 text-[10px]">—</span>;
        const colors = { A: 'bg-green-500/20 text-green-400 border-green-500/30', B: 'bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 border-yellow-500/30', C: 'bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border-red-500/30' };
        return <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg font-black text-[11px] border ${colors[g]}`}>{g}</span>;
    };
    const renderPitches = () => {
        const data = adminPitches.filter(p => p.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()));
        return (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-left text-sm text-gray-300">
                    <thead className="text-[10px] uppercase bg-[#1A1F26] text-gray-400 sticky top-0">
                        <tr>
                            <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Görsel</th>
                            <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Saha Adı</th>
                            <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Bölge</th>
                            <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Kişi Başı ₺</th>
                            <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Toplam ₺</th>
                            <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Rating</th>
                            <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-center">Işık</th>
                            <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-center">Zemin</th>
                            <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-center">Soyunma</th>
                            <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-right">Aksiyonlar</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                        {data.map(pitch => (
                            <tr key={pitch.id} className="border-b border-white/5 hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors">
                                <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                    <img src={pitch.image} alt={pitch.name} className="w-10 h-10 rounded object-cover border border-white/10" />
                                </td>
                                <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-white">{pitch.name}</td>
                                <td className="px-4 py-3">{pitch.district || pitch.location.split(',')[0]}</td>
                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-red-400 font-mono">₺{pitch.pricePerPerson}</td>
                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-red-400 font-mono">₺{pitch.totalPrice}</td>
                                <td className="px-4 py-3 flex items-center gap-1 mt-2">⭐ {pitch.rating}</td>
                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center"><GradeBadge g={pitch.lightingGrade} /></td>
                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center"><GradeBadge g={pitch.grassGrade} /></td>
                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center"><GradeBadge g={pitch.lockerRoomGrade} /></td>
                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                                    <button onClick={() => onEditPitch(pitch)} title="Düzenle" className="p-1.5 text-blue-400 hover:bg-blue-500/20 rounded mr-2 transition-colors"><Edit2 size={14} /></button>
                                    <button onClick={() => { if (window.confirm(`"${pitch.name}" silinsin mi?`)) { onDeletePitch(pitch.id); show(`🗑️ ${pitch.name} silindi`); } }} title="Sil" className="p-1.5 text-red-500 hover:bg-red-500/20 rounded transition-colors"><Trash2 size={14} /></button>
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        ))}
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        );
    };

    // ─── USERS TABLE ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    const renderUsers = () => {
        const data = adminUsers.filter(u => u.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) || u.email.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()));
        return (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-left text-sm text-gray-300">
                    <thead className="text-[10px] uppercase bg-[#1A1F26] text-gray-400 sticky top-0">
                        <tr>
                            <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Avatar</th>
                            <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">İsim & Roller</th>
                            <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Email</th>
                            <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Cüzdan</th>
                            <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Statü</th>
                            <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-right">Aksiyonlar</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                        {data.map(user => (
                            <tr key={user.id} className={`border-b border-white/5 hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors ${user.isBanned ? 'opacity-60' : ''}`}>
                                <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                    <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-red-600 to-orange-500 flex items-center justify-center text-white font-bold text-xs shadow-lg">
                                        {user.name.charAt(0)}
                                    </div>
                                </td>
                                <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                    <div className="font-medium text-white">{user.name}</div>
                                    <div className="text-[10px] flex gap-1 mt-1">
                                        <span className="bg-white/10 px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-gray-400">{user.role}</span>
                                    </div>
                                </td>
                                <td className="px-4 py-3">{user.email}</td>
                                <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-yellow-400 font-mono text-xs">
                                        <Wallet size={11} /> ₺{user.wallet.toLocaleString('tr')}
                                    </span>
                                </td>
                                <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                    <div className="flex gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                                        {user.isPro && <span className="text-yellow-500 bg-yellow-500/10 px-2 rounded text-[10px] font-bold border border-yellow-500/20">PRO</span>}
                                        {user.isVerified && <span className="text-blue-400 bg-blue-500/10 px-2 rounded text-[10px] font-bold border border-blue-500/20">✓ DOĞRULANMIŞ</span>}
                                        {user.isBanned
                                            ? <span className="text-red-500 bg-red-500/10 px-2 rounded text-[10px] font-bold border border-red-500/20">BANNED</span>
                                            : <span className="text-green-500 bg-green-500/10 px-2 rounded text-[10px] font-bold border border-green-500/20">AKTİF</span>}
                                    </div>
                                </td>
                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                                    <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                                        <button onClick={() => onEditUser(user)} title="Düzenle" className="p-1.5 text-blue-400 hover:bg-blue-500/20 rounded transition-colors"><Edit2 size={14} /></button>
                                        <button onClick={() => handleBanToggle(user)} title={user.isBanned ? 'Banı Kaldır' : 'Banla'} className={`p-1.5 rounded transition-colors ${user.isBanned ? 'text-green-400 hover:bg-green-500/20' : 'text-red-400 hover:bg-red-500/20'}`}>
                                            {user.isBanned ? <Shield size={14} /> : <ShieldOff size={14} />}
                                        </button>
                                        <button onClick={() => handleProToggle(user)} title={user.isPro ? 'PRO Kaldır' : 'PRO Yap'} className={`p-1.5 rounded transition-colors ${user.isPro ? 'text-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-500/20' : 'text-yellow-400 hover:bg-yellow-500/20'}`}>
                                            {user.isPro ? <StarOff size={14} /> : <Star size={14} />}
                                        </button>
                                        {!user.isVerified && (
                                            <button onClick={() => handleVerify(user)} title="Doğrula" className="p-1.5 text-blue-400 hover:bg-blue-500/20 rounded transition-colors"><CheckCircle size={14} /></button>
                                        )}
                                        <button onClick={() => { if (window.confirm(`"${user.name}" silinsin mi?`)) { onDeleteUser(user.id); show(`🗑️ ${user.name} silindi`); } }} title="Sil" className="p-1.5 text-red-500 hover:bg-red-500/20 rounded transition-colors"><Trash2 size={14} /></button>
                                    </div>
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        ))}
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        );
    };

    // ─── GOALKEEPERS & REFEREES TABLE ──────────────────────────────
    const renderServiceProviders = (type: 'GK' | 'REF') => {
        const rawData = type === 'GK' ? adminGoalkeepers : adminReferees;
        const data = rawData.filter((item: any) => item.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()));

        return (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-left text-sm text-gray-300">
                    <thead className="text-[10px] uppercase bg-[#1A1F26] text-gray-400 sticky top-0">
                        <tr>
                            <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Avatar</th>
                            <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">İsim</th>
                            <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Stil & Seviye</th>
                            <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Maç Ücreti</th>
                            <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Rating</th>
                            <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-right">Aksiyonlar</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                        {data.map((item: any) => (
                            <tr key={item.id} className="border-b border-white/5 hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors">
                                <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                    <img src={item.avatar} alt={item.name} className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full object-cover border border-white/10" />
                                </td>
                                <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-white">
                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                        {item.name}
                                        {item.isElite && <span className="text-yellow-500 text-[10px] bg-yellow-500/20 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-yellow-500/20">ELITE</span>}
                                    </div>
                                </td>
                                <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                    <div className="text-xs text-gray-400">{type === 'GK' ? item.style : item.level}</div>
                                </td>
                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-green-400 font-mono">₺{item.fee}</td>
                                <td className="px-4 py-3">⭐ {item.rating}</td>
                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                                    <button onClick={() => type === 'GK' ? onEditGk(item) : onEditRef(item)} title="Düzenle" className="p-1.5 text-blue-400 hover:bg-blue-500/20 rounded mr-2 transition-colors"><Edit2 size={14} /></button>
                                    <button
                                        onClick={() => type === 'GK' ? handleDeleteGk(item.id, item.name) : handleDeleteRef(item.id, item.name)}
                                        title="Sil"
                                        className="p-1.5 text-red-500 hover:bg-red-500/20 rounded transition-colors">
                                        <Trash2 size={14} />
                                    </button>
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        ))}
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        );
    };

    return (
        <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-[#0D1117] rounded-xl border border-white/10 overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">
            <Toast />
            {/* Header & Toolbar */}
            <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-white/10 bg-[#121820] flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
                <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-white tracking-wide">
                    <span className="text-red-500 mr-2">VERİTABANI:</span>
                    {activeTab} ({
                        activeTab === 'SAHALAR' ? adminPitches.length :
                            activeTab === 'KULLANICILAR' ? adminUsers.length :
                                activeTab === 'KALECİLER' ? adminGoalkeepers.length :
                                    adminReferees.length
                    })
                </h2>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    {activeTab === 'SAHALAR' && onAddPitch && (
                        <button onClick={onAddPitch}
                            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 h-8 bg-gradient-to-r from-green-600 to-emerald-700 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-black text-white uppercase tracking-widest hover:opacity-90 transition-all shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(34,197,94,0.3)]">
                            <span className="text-lg leading-none">+</span> YENİ SAHA
                        </button>
                    )}
                    <div className="relative">
                        <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-500" size={14} />
                        <input
                            type="text"
                            placeholder="İsim ile ara..."
                            value={searchTerm}
                            onChange={e => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                            className="pl-9 pr-4 py-1.5 bg-black/40 border border-white/10 rounded-lg text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-red-500/50 w-64 transition-all"
                        />
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* Table Content Area */}
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar bg-[#0A0D12]">
                {activeTab === 'SAHALAR' && renderPitches()}
                {activeTab === 'KULLANICILAR' && renderUsers()}
                {activeTab === 'KALECİLER' && renderServiceProviders('GK')}
                {activeTab === 'HAKEMLER' && renderServiceProviders('REF')}
            </div>
        </div>
    );
};

import React, { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Pitch, Goalkeeper, Referee } from '../../types';
import { AdminUser, useAppStore } from '../../store';
import * as FB from '../../firebaseMutations';
import { X, Save, Image as ImageIcon, UploadCloud, Loader2, Check, Wallet, Star, Shield, Phone, Mail, AlertTriangle, Plus, Zap } from 'lucide-react';
import { useImageUpload } from '../../hooks/useImageUpload';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';

interface ModalProps { onClose: () => void; }

// ── Shared components ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const FI: React.FC<{ label: string; children: React.ReactNode; hint?: string }> = ({ label, children, hint }) => (
    <div>
        <label className="block text-[10px] font-black text-gray-400 mb-1.5 uppercase tracking-widest">{label}</label>
        {children}
        {hint && <p className="text-[9px] text-gray-600 mt-1">{hint}</p>}
    </div>
);
const I: React.FC<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>> = (p) => (
    <input {...p} className={`w-full bg-black/50 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm text-white focus:border-red-500/40 focus:outline-none transition-all ${p.className || ''}`} />
);
const Sel: React.FC<React.SelectHTMLAttributes<HTMLSelectElement> & { children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children, ...p }) => (
    <select {...p} className="w-full bg-black/50 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm text-white focus:border-red-500/40 focus:outline-none transition-all">
        {children}
    </select>
);
const Toggle: React.FC<{ label: string; desc?: string; value: boolean; onChange: () => void; danger?: boolean }> = ({ label, desc, value, onChange, danger }) => (
    <div onClick={onChange} className={`flex items-center justify-between p-3.5 rounded-xl border cursor-pointer transition-all ${danger ? 'border-red-900/30 bg-red-900/10 hover:bg-red-900/15' : 'border-white/5 bg-black/20 hover:bg-white/5'}`}>
        <div>
            <p className={`text-sm font-bold ${danger ? 'text-red-400' : 'text-white'}`}>{label}</p>
            {desc && <p className="text-[9px] text-gray-500 mt-0.5">{desc}</p>}
        </div>
        <div className={`w-11 h-6 rounded-full flex items-center transition-all flex-shrink-0 ml-4 ${value ? (danger ? 'bg-red-600' : 'bg-green-500') : 'bg-white/10'}`}>
            <div className={`w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-all mx-1 ${value ? 'translate-x-5' : ''}`} />
        </div>
    </div>
);

// ── Photo Upload Zone ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const PhotoUploadZone: React.FC<{ currentUrl: string; onChanged: (url: string) => void; folder: string; round?: boolean }> = ({ currentUrl, onChanged, folder, round }) => {
    const { uploadImage, uploading, progress } = useImageUpload(folder);
    return (
        <div className={`relative group border-2 border-dashed rounded-2xl transition-all overflow-hidden ${uploading ? 'border-red-500/50 bg-red-900/10' : 'border-white/10 bg-black/30 hover:border-white/25 hover:bg-black/50'}`}
            style={{ height: round ? 120 : 140 }}>
            {currentUrl && (
                <img src={currentUrl} className={`absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover transition-opacity ${uploading ? 'opacity-30' : 'opacity-60 group-hover:opacity-80'}`} />
            )}
            <label className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer z-10">
                {uploading ? (
                    <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
                        <Loader2 size={22} className="text-red-400 animate-spin" />
                        <span className="text-xs font-black text-red-400">% {Math.round(progress)} Yükleniyor...</span>
                    </div>
                ) : (
                    <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1 text-center px-4">
                        <UploadCloud size={22} className={`transition-colors ${currentUrl ? 'text-white/60 group-hover:text-white' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-red-400'}`} />
                        <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold transition-colors ${currentUrl ? 'text-white/60 group-hover:text-white' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-gray-300'}`}>
                            {currentUrl ? 'Resmi Değiştir' : 'Fotoğraf Yükle'}
                        </span>
                    </div>
                )}
                <input type="file" className="hidden" accept="image/*" disabled={uploading}
                    onChange={async (e) => {
                        const file = e.target.files?.[0];
                        if (file) { const url = await uploadImage(file); if (url) onChanged(url); }
                    }} />
            </label>
        </div>
    );
};

// ── Success Toast ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const useToast = () => {
    const [msg, setMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const showOk = useCallback((m: string) => { setMsg(m); setTimeout(() => setMsg(null), 2200); }, []);
    const Toast = () => (
        <AnimatePresence>
            {msg && (
                <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20, x: '-50%' }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, x: '-50%' }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
                    className="fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 z-[400] px-5 py-3 bg-green-900/90 border border-green-500/30 rounded-xl text-green-300 text-sm font-black backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center gap-2 shadow-2xl">
                    <Check size={14} /> {msg}
                </motion.div>
            )}
        </AnimatePresence>
    );
    return { showOk, Toast };
};

// ── Modal Shell ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const Shell: React.FC<{ title: string; onClose: () => void; children: React.ReactNode; footer: React.ReactNode }> = ({ title, onClose, children, footer }) => (
    <motion.div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4"
        initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
        onClick={onClose}>
        <motion.div className="bg-[#0D1117] border border-white/10 w-full max-w-2xl rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]"
            initial={{ y: 40, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ y: 0, opacity: 1 }} exit={{ y: 40, opacity: 0 }}
            onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="p-5 border-b border-white/10 flex justify-between items-center bg-[#121820] rounded-t-3xl shrink-0">
                <h2 className="text-sm font-black text-white tracking-widest uppercase">{title}</h2>
                <button onClick={onClose} className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-gray-400 hover:text-white flex items-center justify-center transition-all"><X size={15} /></button>
            </div>
            <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar flex-1 space-y-5">{children}</div>
            <div className="p-4 border-t border-white/10 bg-[#121820] rounded-b-3xl shrink-0">{footer}</div>
        </motion.div>
    </motion.div>
);

// ── Grade Picker ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const GRADE_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
    A: 'bg-green-500/20 text-green-400 border-green-500/50 hover:bg-green-500/30',
    B: 'bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 border-yellow-500/50 hover:bg-yellow-500/30',
    C: 'bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border-red-500/50 hover:bg-red-500/30',
};
const GRADE_ACTIVE: Record<string, string> = {
    A: 'bg-green-500 text-white border-green-400 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(34,197,94,0.5)]',
    B: 'bg-yellow-500 text-white border-yellow-400 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(234,179,8,0.5)]',
    C: 'bg-red-500 text-white border-red-400 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(239,68,68,0.5)]',
};
const GradePicker: React.FC<{ label: string; desc?: string; value?: 'A' | 'B' | 'C'; onChange: (g: 'A' | 'B' | 'C') => void }> = ({ label, desc, value, onChange }) => (
    <div>
        <label className="block text-[10px] font-black text-gray-400 mb-2 uppercase tracking-widest">{label}</label>
        {desc && <p className="text-[9px] text-gray-600 mb-2">{desc}</p>}
        <div className="flex gap-2">
            {(['A', 'B', 'C'] as const).map(g => (
                <button key={g} onClick={() => onChange(g)}
                    className={`flex-1 h-10 rounded-xl font-black text-base border-2 transition-all ${
                        value === g ? GRADE_ACTIVE[g] : (GRADE_COLORS[g] + ' border-opacity-30')
                    }`}>
                    {g}
                </button>
            ))}
        </div>
        {value && (
            <p className="text-[9px] mt-1.5 font-mono text-gray-500">
                {value === 'A' ? '✅ Mükemmel' : value === 'B' ? '⚠️ Orta' : '❌ Yetersiz'}
            </p>
        )}
    </div>
);

// PITCH DEEP EDIT

export const DeepEditPitchModal: React.FC<ModalProps & { pitch: Pitch }> = ({ pitch, onClose }) => {
    const [edit, setEdit] = useState<Pitch>(pitch);
    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    const { showOk, Toast } = useToast();

    const handleSave = async () => {
        setSaving(true);
        await FB.fbUpdatePitch(edit);
        setSaving(false);
        showOk('✅ Saha Firebase\'e kaydedildi');
        setTimeout(onClose, 1000);
    };

    return (
        <AnimatePresence>

                        <button onClick={onClose} className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 hover:text-white border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/5 transition-all">İptal</button>
                        <button onClick={handleSave} disabled={saving} className="flex items-center gap-2 px-6 py-2.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-red-600 to-purple-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black transition-all disabled:opacity-50 hover:opacity-90">
                            {saving ? <><Loader2 size={13} className="animate-spin" /> Kaydediliyor...</> : <><Save size={13} /> DEĞİŞİKLİKLERİ YAYINLA</>}
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <FI label="Saha Görseli">
                    <PhotoUploadZone currentUrl={edit.image} onChanged={url => setEdit({ ...edit, image: url })} folder="pitches" />
                    <I className="mt-2" placeholder="veya URL yapıştır..." value={edit.image} onChange={e => setEdit({ ...edit, image: e.target.value })} />

                {/* Identity */}

                <FI label="Tam Adres"><I value={edit.location} onChange={e => setEdit({ ...edit, location: e.target.value })} /></FI>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                        <FI label="Kişi Başı Fiyat (₺)"><I type="number" value={edit.pricePerPerson} onChange={e => setEdit({ ...edit, pricePerPerson: +e.target.value })} className="text-red-400 font-mono" /></FI>
                        <FI label="Toplam Saha Fiyatı (₺)"><I type="number" value={edit.totalPrice} onChange={e => setEdit({ ...edit, totalPrice: +e.target.value })} className="text-red-400 font-mono" /></FI>
                    </div>
                    <button onClick={() => setEdit({ ...edit, totalPrice: edit.pricePerPerson * 14 })}
                        className="mt-2 text-[10px] text-purple-400 hover:text-purple-300 transition-colors font-bold">
                        ↻ Toplam Fiyatı Otomatik Hesapla (×14 oyuncu)
                    </button>
                </div>

                {/* Quality */}
                <div className="p-4 bg-black/30 rounded-2xl border border-white/5">
                    <p className="text-[9px] font-black text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-3 flex items-center gap-2"><Star size={11} /> SAHA KALİTESİ (SAYISAL)</p>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                        <FI label="Rating (0-5)" hint="Yıldız puanı"><I type="number" step="0.1" min="0" max="5" value={edit.rating} onChange={e => setEdit({ ...edit, rating: +e.target.value })} /></FI>
                        <FI label="Zemin (0-100)" hint="Çim kalitesi"><I type="number" min="0" max="100" value={edit.grassQuality} onChange={e => setEdit({ ...edit, grassQuality: +e.target.value })} /></FI>
                        <FI label="Işıklandırma (0-100)" hint="Aydınlatma"><I type="number" min="0" max="100" value={edit.lighting} onChange={e => setEdit({ ...edit, lighting: +e.target.value })} /></FI>
                    </div>
                </div>

                {/* A/B/C Grades */}
                <div className="p-4 bg-black/30 rounded-2xl border border-purple-500/20">
                    <p className="text-[9px] font-black text-purple-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-4 flex items-center gap-2"><Zap size={11} className="text-purple-400" /> A/B/C PUAN SİSTEMİ</p>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">

--- FILE: ./services/matchService.ts ---
import { collection, addDoc, onSnapshot, query, where, Timestamp, updateDoc, doc, arrayUnion, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db } from '../firebase';

export interface Match {
  id?: string;
  pitchId: string;
  pitchName: string;
  captainId: string;
  captainName: string;
  date: string;
  time: string;
  status: 'OPEN' | 'CONFIRMED' | 'COMPLETED' | 'CANCELLED';
  gkId?: string;
  refId?: string;
  applicants?: Array<{
    uid: string;
    displayName: string;
    role: 'GOALKEEPER' | 'REFEREE';
    photoURL?: string;
    status: 'PENDING' | 'REJECTED';
  }>;
  createdAt?: any;
}

// ============================================================================
// 1. OYUNCU (KAPTAN) UYGULAMASI FONKSİYONLARI
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Oyuncu uygulaması bir maç oluşturduğunda çalışır.
 * Bu maç, Kaleci ve Hakem uygulamasında "Açık Maçlar" olarak görünür.
 */
export const createMatch = async (matchData: Omit<Match, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'status' | 'applicants'>) => {
  try {
    const docRef = await addDoc(collection(db, 'matches'), {
      ...matchData,
      status: 'OPEN',
      applicants: [],
      createdAt: Timestamp.now()
    });
    return docRef.id;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Maç oluşturulurken hata oluştu: ", error);
    throw error;
  }
};

/**
 * Kaptan, kendisine başvuran bir kaleciyi veya hakemi onayladığında çalışır.
 */
export const approveApplicant = async (matchId: string, applicantUid: string, role: 'GOALKEEPER' | 'REFEREE') => {
  try {
    const matchRef = doc(db, 'matches', matchId);
    const updateData: any = {};
    
    if (role === 'GOALKEEPER') updateData.gkId = applicantUid;
    else if (role === 'REFEREE') updateData.refId = applicantUid;
    
    // Maçı onaylanmış duruma getir (Eğer hem kaleci hem hakem gerekiyorsa mantık genişletilebilir)
    updateData.status = 'CONFIRMED';

    await updateDoc(matchRef, updateData);
    console.log(`${role} onaylandı: `, applicantUid);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Başvuru onaylanırken hata oluştu: ", error);
    throw error;
  }
};


// ============================================================================
// 2. KALECİ / HAKEM UYGULAMASI FONKSİYONLARI
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Kaleci veya Hakem bir maça başvurmak istediğinde çalışır.
 * Kaptan uygulamasındaki "Başvurular" listesine düşer.
 */
export const applyToMatch = async (matchId: string, user: { uid: string, displayName: string, role: 'GOALKEEPER' | 'REFEREE', photoURL?: string }) => {
  try {
    const matchRef = doc(db, 'matches', matchId);
    await updateDoc(matchRef, {
      applicants: arrayUnion({
        ...user,
        status: 'PENDING'
      })
    });
    console.log("Maça başvuru yapıldı: ", matchId);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Maça başvururken hata oluştu: ", error);
    throw error;
  }
};

/**
 * Kaleci ve Hakemlerin "Açık Maçları" canlı olarak görmesini sağlar.
 */
export const subscribeToOpenMatches = (callback: (matches: Match[]) => void) => {
  const q = query(
    collection(db, 'matches'), 
    where('status', '==', 'OPEN')
  );

  const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(q, (querySnapshot) => {
    const matches: Match[] = [];
    querySnapshot.forEach((doc) => {
      matches.push({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() } as Match);
    });
    callback(matches);
  }, (error) => {
    console.error("Maçları dinlerken hata oluştu: ", error);
  });

  return unsubscribe;
};


--- FILE: ./services/pitchService.ts ---
import { collection, addDoc, onSnapshot, query, where, Timestamp, deleteDoc, doc, updateDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db } from '../firebase';

export interface PitchSlot {
  id?: string;
  pitchId: string;
  date: string; // YYYY-MM-DD
  time: string; // HH:MM
  status: 'AVAILABLE' | 'BOOKED';
  price: number;
  createdAt?: any;
}

// ============================================================================
// 1. TESİS UYGULAMASININ KULLANACAĞI FONKSİYONLAR (YAZMA İŞLEMLERİ)
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Tesis sahibi yeni bir müsait saat eklediğinde bu fonksiyon çalışır.
 * Veriyi ortak veritabanı olan Firestore'a yazar.
 */
export const addAvailableSlot = async (slotData: Omit<PitchSlot, 'id' | 'createdAt'>) => {
  try {
    const docRef = await addDoc(collection(db, 'pitch_slots'), {
      ...slotData,
      createdAt: Timestamp.now()
    });
    console.log("Yeni saat eklendi, ID: ", docRef.id);
    return docRef.id;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Saat eklenirken hata oluştu: ", error);
    throw error;
  }
};

/**
 * Tesis sahibi bir saati sildiğinde veya iptal ettiğinde çalışır.
 */
export const removeSlot = async (slotId: string) => {
  try {
    await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'pitch_slots', slotId));
    console.log("Saat silindi: ", slotId);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Saat silinirken hata oluştu: ", error);
    throw error;
  }
};


/**
 * Oyuncu uygulaması bir saati kiraladığında (rezervasyon yaptığında) çalışır.
 * Saatin durumunu 'BOOKED' olarak günceller.
 */
export const bookSlot = async (slotId: string, userId: string) => {
  try {
    const slotRef = doc(db, 'pitch_slots', slotId);
    await updateDoc(slotRef, {
      status: 'BOOKED',
      bookedBy: userId,
      bookedAt: Timestamp.now()
    });
    console.log("Saat kiralandı: ", slotId);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Saat kiralanırken hata oluştu: ", error);
    throw error;
  }
};

// ============================================================================
// 2. OYUNCU UYGULAMASININ KULLANACAĞI FONKSİYONLAR (DİNLEME İŞLEMLERİ)
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Oyuncu uygulaması bu fonksiyonu çağırarak bir tesisin müsait saatlerini
 * "CANLI" (Real-time) olarak dinlemeye başlar.
 * Tesis uygulaması "addAvailableSlot" ile yeni bir saat eklediği an, 
 * bu fonksiyon otomatik olarak tetiklenir ve oyuncunun ekranı güncellenir.
 */
export const subscribeToPitchSlots = (pitchId: string, callback: (slots: PitchSlot[]) => void) => {
  // Sadece 'AVAILABLE' olan ve bu tesise ait saatleri getir
  const q = query(
    collection(db, 'pitch_slots'), 
    where('pitchId', '==', pitchId),
    where('status', '==', 'AVAILABLE')
  );

  // onSnapshot: Firestore'daki değişiklikleri anlık olarak yakalar
  const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(q, (querySnapshot) => {
    const slots: PitchSlot[] = [];
    querySnapshot.forEach((doc) => {
      slots.push({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() } as PitchSlot);
    });
    
    // Yeni veriyi callback ile React componentine (arayüze) gönder
    callback(slots);
  }, (error) => {
    console.error("Saatleri dinlerken hata oluştu: ", error);
  });

  // Dinlemeyi durdurmak için bu fonksiyonu döndürüyoruz (useEffect cleanup için)
  return unsubscribe;
};

import { collection, doc, getDoc, getDocs, setDoc, updateDoc, query, where, orderBy, limit, DocumentData, runTransaction, arrayUnion, arrayRemove } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db } from '../firebase';
import { IUser, IMatch, ITeam, Pitch, Referee, Goalkeeper, UserRole } from '../types';

// ==========================================
// USERS
// ==========================================
export const getUserProfile = async (uid: string): Promise<IUser | null> => {
  try {
    const docRef = doc(db, 'users', uid);
    const docSnap = await getDoc(docRef);
    if (docSnap.exists()) {
      return { id: docSnap.id, ...docSnap.data() } as IUser;
    }
    return null;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error fetching user profile:", error);
    return null;
  }
};

export const updateUserProfile = async (uid: string, data: Partial<IUser>): Promise<boolean> => {
  try {
    const docRef = doc(db, 'users', uid);
    await updateDoc(docRef, data as DocumentData);
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error updating user profile:", error);
    return false;
  }
};

export const createUserProfile = async (uid: string, email: string, displayName: string): Promise<IUser | null> => {
    try {
      const userRef = doc(db, 'users', uid);
      const newUser: Omit<IUser, 'id'> = {
        name: displayName,
        email: email,
        roles: [UserRole.PLAYER],
        communities: [],
        fairPlayScore: 100,
        elo: 1000
      };
      await setDoc(userRef, newUser);
      return { id: uid, ...newUser };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error creating user profile:", error);
      return null;
    }
  };

// ==========================================
// MATCHES
// ==========================================
export const getActiveMatches = async (): Promise<IMatch[]> => {
  try {
    const q = query(collection(db, 'matches'), where('status', 'in', ['PENDING', 'WAITING_APPROVAL']));
    const querySnapshot = await getDocs(q);
    return querySnapshot.docs.map(doc => ({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() } as IMatch));
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error fetching matches:", error);
    return [];
  }
};

export const getMatchById = async (matchId: string): Promise<IMatch | null> => {
  try {
    const docRef = doc(db, 'matches', matchId);
    const docSnap = await getDoc(docRef);
    if (docSnap.exists()) {
      return { id: docSnap.id, ...docSnap.data() } as IMatch;
    }
    return null;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error fetching match:", error);
    return null;
  }
};

export const createMatch = async (matchData: Omit<IMatch, 'id'>): Promise<string | null> => {
    try {
        const docRef = doc(collection(db, 'matches'));
        await setDoc(docRef, matchData);
        return docRef.id;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Error creating match:", error);
        return null;
    }
};
